fdroid:de.baumann.browser.name: FOSS Browser
fdroid:de.baumann.browser.summary: A fully free (as in freedom) open source browser for Android.
fdroid:de.baumann.browser.description:
"FOSS Browser" is a fully free (as in freedom) open source Android browser: privacy-friendly with a modern user interface. - Your privacy - your data.
 Project Homepage with further info: https://codeberg.org/Gaukler_Faun/FOSS_Browser 
-------------------------------------------------
 UI/Handling 
-------------------------------------------------
FOSS Browser uses the latest Material You design libraries. Following system day/night mode and a wallpaper based theme are just two features of this new library. The UI is optimized for one-hand-use. All UI-elements are at the bottom of the screen.
More features:
• Keep screen on.
• Open links in background.
• Restore tabs on restart.
-------------------------------------------------
 Privacy 
-------------------------------------------------
FOSS Browser uses profiles to protect your privacy. For each profile you can enable or disable: AdBlock, JavaScript, cookies, fingerprint protection and much more. Profiles can also be saved for domains ("github.com" ⇒ Trusted website). This saved domains always overwrite the current profile. So, for example, "github.com" will always open with the trusted profile, even if you are browsing in the protected mode.
More privacy features:
• Build in AdBlock, which updates automatically. You can decide which content to block. AdBlock hosts are taken from Steven Black - AbBlock hosts: https://github.com/StevenBlack/hosts.
• Third-part-cookies can not be disabled.
• Enable or disable Android-autofill.
• Delete browser data (on app exit).
• Choose between different search engines (or set a custom one).
• FOSS Browser itself doesn't collect any data
-------------------------------------------------
 Bookmarks filter 
-------------------------------------------------
Organize your bookmarks with filters. You can set custom names for each filter. Long press the bookmark icon in the toolbar to get fast access to your favorite bookmarks.
-------------------------------------------------
 Gestures 
-------------------------------------------------
You can assign nearly twenty different gestures to the toolbar and the toolbar buttons. Each in four directions. You can also trigger events by long pressing the toolbar buttons. So you have up to ten different gestures to control FOSS Browser. Supported is for example: load last website, switch tab, reload, open bookmarks, ... and many more.
-------------------------------------------------
 Backups 
-------------------------------------------------
Backup all your important data (bookmarks, history, trusted websites and so on) on your SD-card. You can also back up FOSS Browser settings. Backups can even be restored on a fresh install or an other device (if you copy the backup files to the new device).

fdroid:info.metadude.android.rc3.schedul.description:
Conference program app for the JahresEndVeranstaltungen (JEV)
https://events.ccc.de/2022/11/28/dezentral-2022/#dezentral-2022-events
There will be no Congress and no centrally organised rC3 this year.
This is a challenge that the community was happy to accept. Various
groups are organising decentralised events with talks, workshops and
other things in the usual Congress season. Parts of these events can
be visited in person and other parts can be followed online.
We have prepared an overview of all these events, sorted by (physical)
location. All broadcasts will be viewable on media.ccc.de live and as
recordings later.
Please remember that the individual groups are organising these events
autonomously and are individually responsible for their own content.
 Features 
* View program by day and rooms (side by side)
* Custom grid layout for smartphones (try landscape mode 🙃) and tablets
* Read detailed descriptions (speaker names, start time, room name, links, ...) of events
* Add events to favorites list
* Export favorites list
* Setup alarms for individual events
* Add events to your personal calendar
* Share a website link to an event with others
* Keep track of program changes
* Automatic program updates (configurable in settings)
* Vote and leave comments on talks and workshops
* Integration with the Engelsystem project https://engelsystem.de - Online tool for coordinating helpers and shifts on large events
* Integration with the Chaosflix https://github.com/NiciDieNase/chaosflix - Android app for https://media.ccc.de , share Fahrplan favorites with Chaosflix to import them as bookmarks
🔤 Supported languages 
(Event descriptions excluded)
* Dutch
* English
* French
* German
* Italian
* Japanese
* Polish
* Portuguese
* Russian
* Spanish
* Swedish
💡 Questions regarding the content can only be answered by the
content teams of the individual events. This app simply
offers a way to consume and personalize the aggregated schedule
of all the events.
💣 Bug reports are very welcome. It would be awesome if you
can describe how to reproduce the particular error. The issue
tracker can be found here:
 https://github.com/EventFahrplan/EventFahrplan/issues

fdroid:io.github.cuso4deposit.regexcross.name: Regex Crossword
fdroid:io.github.cuso4deposit.regexcross.summary: Offline regex-crossword puzzles in hexagon and rectangle grids.
fdroid:io.github.cuso4deposit.regexcross.description:
Regex Crossword is an offline puzzle game. Every line of the grid is a regular
expression; fill the cells so that each line, read in its own direction,
matches its clue exactly (a whole-string match).
Features:
* Three difficulties: Easy (rectangle 5x5), Medium and Hard (hexagon). Puzzles
 are generated on your device from a seed, so the number of levels is
 unlimited.
* The hexagonal board has three colour-coded reading directions (X, Y, Z); the
 rectangle board uses rows and columns. Each clue shows its reading direction
 and start cell.
* Tap a cell and use the on-screen keyboard. Pencil-mark notes, per-cell hints,
 "givens" (letters a clue writes down literally), undo/redo, and a per-level
 timer.
* Progress is saved automatically for every level.
Hard levels are pre-generated with a solver so that their answer is unique.
No accounts. No ads. No network access. No permissions.
Regex Crossword is free software under the MIT licence. The hexagonal "A
Regular Crossword" form was popularised by Dan Gulotta (based on an idea by
Palmer Mebane) in MIT Mystery Hunt 2013. This app is an independent
implementation and includes neither the original puzzle nor its text.
Source code: https://github.com/CuSO4Deposit/regex-crossword

fdroid:io.github.yamin8000.dooz.name: Dooz
fdroid:io.github.yamin8000.dooz.summary: A Tic-Tac-Tao clone, a simple pen-and-paper game
fdroid:io.github.yamin8000.dooz.description:
I created this implementation using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android devices.
 Features 
Technical
 Jetpack Compose
 Material3 and Dynamic Color
 Game 
 Variable game board grid size from three-by-three to nine-by-nine (Larger than nine-by-nine is simply ridiculous and unplayable in mobile phones)
 Variable game ai difficulty (easy, medium, hard)
Variations
Simple Game
The Simple game is the most simple variation of Tic-tac-tao with a three-by-three grid with two players. The player who succeeds in placing three of their marks in horizontal, vertical, or diagonal is the winner.
Simple Game AI
Currently, in hard mode, AI uses a strategy rather than an AI search algorithm like MinMax. This strategy consists of these steps: Win, Block, Fork, Block Fork, Center Play, Corner Play, and Side Play.
In Easy difficulty, AI plays a random empty cell in the grid. In Medium difficulty, AI chooses between Easy difficulty and Hard difficulty for each move based on a 50/50 chance.
 Strategy's source 
Flexible Strategy Use in Young Children's Tic-Tac-Toe by Kevin Crowley, Robert S. Siegler

fdroid:org.adaway.name: AdAway
fdroid:org.adaway.summary: A free and Open Source ad blocker for Android.
fdroid:org.adaway.description:
A Free and Open Source ad blocker for Android.
The application is available for rooted and non-rooted devices.
Using rooted device, the application update your system hosts file that contains a list of mappings between host names and IP addresses.
Using non-rooted device, the application use the VPN feature to block outgoing connections to ads and trackers.
So when an app requests an ad or a tracker from a host in that file, this request is redirected to the local IP 127.0.0.1, which does nothing.
You can download predefined ads and blocker lists as hosts files from within the app to incorporate. It is also possible to use your own files and to add certain hosts to allowed and blocked lists.
There are options to run a local web server to respond to blocked host names and to direct requests to the IP address of your choosing instead.

fdroid:org.freemaps.datum.name: Datum
fdroid:org.freemaps.datum.summary: Offline topo, satellite and public land maps. No account, no ads, no tracking.
fdroid:org.freemaps.datum.description:
A fully offline topographic, satellite and trail map for Android, built for the moment you lose signal and still need to know where you are.
Download a region before you leave and everything keeps working with no connection: the map, GPS position, waypoints, route planning and track recording. Satellite imagery, USGS topographic contours, trails, public land ownership, borders and street labels are all cached on the device rather than fetched on demand.
Features:
* Seven map layers that can be reordered, hidden, and given independent transparency, so contours can be read through imagery
* Public land ownership from the BLM Surface Management Agency dataset, showing BLM, Forest Service, state, tribal and private land
* USGS topographic contours labelled in feet, plus OpenTopoMap in metres
* Waypoints with thirteen icon types, undo and redo
* Route planning, either point by point or by connecting waypoints, with trimming and turn by turn navigation
* Track recording with live distance and elapsed time
* Sessions, so each trip's waypoints, routes and tracks stay separate
* Layer presets that can be saved and shared, containing settings only and no locations
Your data is written to a folder you choose as standard GPX files as you create them, so it opens in other outdoor applications with no export step, and nothing is locked in a proprietary format. Timestamps are left out of shared files by default, because a path shows where a trail goes while timestamps also show what hours you were out.
There is no account, no advertising, no analytics and no server.
Note on the anti-feature flag: the satellite imagery layer is served by Esri, a proprietary service. Every other layer comes from public domain government or openly licensed sources. Place search uses Nominatim. All network access is initiated by the user; nothing is contacted in the background.

fdroid:org.jarsi.devicewatch.name: Device Watch

fdroid:org.jarsi.devicewatch.description:
Device Watch is an Android device monitor with a home-screen widget, per-app usage insights and an interactive screensaver for charging or docked use. It works completely offline: the app has no internet permission, and every number is real data read from Android and kernel sources — when a value is not available with the permissions granted, the app shows a dash instead of a fabricated value.
Features:
* Resizable home-screen widget: battery, memory, CPU, storage, Wi-Fi, mobile network, data usage, uptime, today's screen time and last update time; compact 2×2 widget with data-period labels; 1×1 widget with one figure of your choice
* Quick Settings tiles and live notification figures of your choice: battery, battery power, temperatures, data today, uptime, CPU load, memory, storage
* Floating figure: a small card with one to three of those figures over other apps, full-screen games and video included, brought up and taken down from Quick Settings
* Data counters per calendar day or per one-month billing cycle with a configurable start day
* Tabbed dashboard: Home (live battery ring, usage counters, system meters and live network traffic), Apps (usage insights), Device (hardware, SIM, Wi-Fi, camera and audio details) and Settings
* Screen-time donut of your most-used apps, top data consumers and a last-opened list with per-app uninstall
* Usage counters with a private 62-day daily history kept on the device: app screen time, screen-on time, unlocks, filtered notification count, restarts, charging sessions and used storage
* Battery history and charging sessions for 14 days, with temperatures and charging rates
* Optional charge reminders, mobile-data quota warnings and alerts for a hot battery, low storage or fast battery drain
* CSV exports and a self-contained HTML report with charts, search and date filters
* On-device notification log with 7-day retention
* Since-charge view: elapsed time, battery drop, average drain and per-app screen time since the battery was last charged full or unplugged
* Optional extended access through Shizuku or root, off by default: the real CPU load, chip temperatures, graphics load, the battery's own wear figures, and Android's battery statistics since the last charge (drain with the screen on and off, each app's share, what kept the phone awake)
* With root: a Kernel page (each group of processor cores with its speed, limit and range, heat throttling, GPU speeds, zRAM, kernel version, SELinux, temperature sensors) and processor profiles — Power saving, Balanced, Stock (full speed) or Custom per group of cores — that set only each group's top speed limit and return the phone's own limits on Stock, when root is switched off and at every restart unless you choose otherwise
* Privacy log with extended access: Android's own record of which apps used the camera, the microphone and the location, when, for how long and from the background or not, and on Android 17 which requests were refused — shown, never stored
* System apps page with extended access: remove preinstalled apps you do not use, for this user only, with a question before every removal, a warning for the apps the phone depends on, and Restore for a removed app; the apps the phone cannot do without cannot be removed from here
* Interactive screensaver with a large clock, the phone's name, next alarm, icons of unread notifications, charging power in watts, battery-tinted background, optional night dimming, an optional start as soon as charging begins and a battery-full notification
The app uploads nothing. Android backup carries settings only, excluding history, notification content and delivered-alert flags. You can choose to share CSV/HTML exports, including notification text, through another app.

fdroid:org.ojrandom.paiesque.name: PAIesque
fdroid:org.ojrandom.paiesque.summary: Privacy-first fitness tracker with end-to-end encrypted group sharing
fdroid:org.ojrandom.paiesque.description:
PAIesque is a privacy-first fitness tracker and live location sharer. Everything runs locally; sharing between users happens through your own server, not through Google, Strava, or any cloud provider.
 Record heart rate and GPS directly from BLE chest straps and other heart rate sensors. No companion app required. Multiple sensors can be recorded in parallel, and sessions are saved as GPX and CSV for use in other tools.
 Analyze your training on an interactive map and zoomable chart. View live metrics while a recording is active, or inspect past sessions by date range. The map track is colored by heart rate zone.
 Share live status and completed recordings with a group through a simple self-hosted PHP server. See other group members on the map in real time and browse their past sessions the same way you browse your own. Shared payloads are end-to-end encrypted; the server stores opaque blobs and cannot read them. If you don't have a heart rate sensor, the app also works as a pure GPS location sharer — no account, no third-party service, just your own server.
 Training-load metrics come from published formulas. Each formula in the app carries an evidence label so you know what is peer-reviewed, what is a professional convention, and what is a heuristic:
• TRIMP methods — Banister, iTRIMP, and LT-TRIMP.
• EWMA & ACWR — rolling load and injury-risk monitoring.
• Recovery metrics — RHR and HRV (RMSSD) from your sleep window.
• Polarized training — zone distribution and achievement tracking.
The app also includes a PAI-like score inspired by the Personal Activity Intelligence concept. It is not the official PAI algorithm — the official PAI is proprietary and commercially licensed by Mio Global. Values will differ from commercial implementations.
 Data sources. Heart rate can be recorded directly from BLE chest straps and other heart rate sensors, without any companion app. If your wearable needs a companion app to sync, Health Connect handles the import. Gadgetbridge is a natural companion for users of open-source wearables — it syncs heart rate from many devices into Health Connect, and PAIesque reads from there. Garmin Connect, Polar Flow, and other proprietary companion apps also work via Health Connect. No app-specific integration is required for any of them.
 Privacy is the default. No accounts, no cloud uploads, no analytics, no tracking. Data stays on your device; sharing happens only if you explicitly configure a server.

winget-run-community:IDRIX.VeraCrypt.name: VeraCrypt
winget-run-community:IDRIX.VeraCrypt.summary:
VeraCrypt is a software for establishing and maintaining an on-the-fly-encrypted volume (data storage device). On-the-fly encryption means that data is automatically
encrypted right before it is saved and decrypted right after it is loaded, without any user intervention. No data stored on an encrypted volume can be read (decrypted)
without using the correct password/keyfile(s) or correct encryption keys. Entire file system is encrypted (e.g., file names, folder names, contents of every file,
free space, meta data, etc). Files can be copied to and from a mounted VeraCrypt volume just like they are copied to/from any normal disk (for example, by simple
drag-and-drop operations). Files are automatically being decrypted on the fly (in memory/RAM) while they are being read or copied from an encrypted VeraCrypt volume.
Similarly, files that are being written or copied to the VeraCrypt volume are automatically being encrypted on the fly (right before they are written to the disk) in RAM.
Note that this does not mean that the whole file that is to be encrypted/decrypted must be stored in RAM before it can be encrypted/decrypted. There are no extra memory
(RAM) requirements for VeraCrypt.

flathub:io.github.quantum_mutnauq.fast_r.name: Fast Reader
flathub:io.github.quantum_mutnauq.fast_r.summary: Reading one word at a time
flathub:io.github.quantum_mutnauq.fast_r.description:
Fast Reader helps you to read more quickly, by showing only one word after the other. Therefor
 the eyes don’t have to move from word to word, that reduce the speed of reading. To read the text
 you only have to copy the text into the big field in the middle and to start it. You can choose
 two different basic settings. Either you can choose the next word bei using the button „→“ or you
 can use the „Time based next word“. By this setting can be the duration of the word chosen. The
 selection is processed with a factor so that longer words are not displayed too short. This dynamic
 setting ensures that longer and more complex words are given more time to provide a natural and
 fluid reading experience. Reading can be started via the “Read” button. Experienced readers can
 even have more than one word displayed at once. This increases the reading speed even further.
 This program offers individual settings to improve reading:
 Background colour
 Font colour
 Font and size
 Reading progress in the text
 used to highlight which words took a particularly long time and which were read quickly.
 In the "Advanced settings for time-based next word", you can extend the display time for longer
 words. Here, you can set the duration of the time and from how many characters this time should
 be used. Additionally, you can also specify a delay at the start, so that the first word remains
 on the screen for a longer period.
 Customizable Settings: Tailor your reading experience by adjusting settings like background
 color, text color, font size, and display of progress indicators.
 Text Input: Easily input text into the application through a dedicated text entry field.
 Word-by-Word Display: The text is broken down into individual words, presented one at a time,
 facilitating focused reading.
 Navigation Options: Seamlessly navigate through the text using intuitive navigation buttons
 or convenient keyboard shortcuts.
 Progress Indicators: Keep track of your reading progress with helpful indicators displaying
 your current position in the text and overall progress.
 Time-Based Word predictions: You can set a variable time calculate by a formal for the display
 of each word. The formula for calculating the word display time is: "Time-Per-Word × (Cube Root
 of Word-Length)". This dynamic adjustment ensures that longer, more complex words are allotted
 more time, providing a natural and responsive reading experience.
 Statistic Collection: Generates statistics for you, showing how long you took to read each
 word.
 Colorize Statistics: Makes the statistics colorful (optional), allowing you to quickly see
 how long you took per word and identify which words were very slow or fast.

fedora-packages:byteman/byteman.name: byteman
fedora-packages:byteman/byteman.description: Byteman is a tool which simplifies tracing and testing of Java programs. Byteman allows you to insert extra Java code into your application, either as it is loaded during JVM startup or even after it has already started running. The injected code is allowed to access any of your data and call any application methods, including where they are private. You can inject code almost anywhere you want and there is no need to prepare the original source code in advance nor do you have to recompile, repackage or redeploy your application. In fact you can remove injected code and reinstall different code while the application continues to execute.

fedora-packages:golang-gopkg-yaml-1/comp.description: The yaml package enables Go programs to comfortably encode and decode YAML values. It was developed within Canonical as part of the juju project, and is based on a pure Go port of the well-known libyaml C library to parse and generate YAML data quickly and reliably. The yaml package supports most of YAML 1.1 and 1.2, including support for anchors, tags, map merging, etc. Multi-document unmarshalling is not yet implemented, and base-60 floats from YAML 1.1 are purposefully not supported since they're a poor design and are gone in YAML 1.2. This package provides symbolic links that alias the following Go import paths to gopkg.in/yaml.v1: – gopkg.in/v1/yaml Aliasing Go import paths via symbolic links or http redirects is fragile. If your Go code depends on this package, you should patch it to import directly gopkg.in/yaml.v1.

A brief introduction to Algorithmic Differentiation (AD) can be found at http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Automatic_differentiation The documentation for the 2026 version https://cppad.readthedocs.io/stable-2026 The documentation for the most recent version of cppad can be found at https://cppad.readthedocs.io/latest

firefox-addons:2902339.name: Prod — Block Distractions & Boost Productivity
firefox-addons:2902339.description:
Prod is a simple, powerful productivity extension that helps you stay focused by blocking distracting websites and removing addictive elements (like YouTube recommended feeds). Whether you’re working, studying, or simply trying to avoid time‐sink rabbit holes, Prod lets you take control of your online experience.
Key Features
Hide Distractions
- Turn off recommended videos, comments, or Shorts on YouTube.
- Silence clutter.
Block Sites
- Instantly block major distractions like YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and adult sites.
- Add your own custom URLs to the block list.
- If you visit a blocked site, you’ll be redirected to a sleek “Blocked by Prod” page.
Greyscale Mode
- Transform the entire web into a calmer, colorless environment.
- Perfect for those who need fewer visual triggers when working or studying.
Minimalist UI
- A clean interface with toggle switches for each feature—no clutter, no confusion.
- Quickly turn Prod on/off or tweak settings right from the extension popup.
Timer
- Set a custom timer to keep yourself on task and lock certain settings until time’s up.
Why Prod?
- Stay Focused: By blocking out distracting elements, you can devote your attention to what really matters.
- Improve Productivity: Reduce the temptation to scroll, watch, or click endlessly.
- Easy to Use: No complicated setup—just toggle on the features you want.
- Free + Sponsors: We’re working with select sponsors to keep Prod free for everyone.
Privacy & Permissions
- Prod stores your block lists and settings locally in your browser—no personal data is sent to our servers (unless you choose to share it).
- We only request the permissions we need to hide or block content on specific sites.
Support & Feedback
- Homepage URL: prodextension.com 
- Support: support@focus.studio
- Join our community Discord for bug reports, feature requests, and general discussion.
How to Use
- Install Prod from the Chrome Web Store.
- Pin the extension in your browser toolbar for quick access.
- Open the Prod popup to enable/disable features like Hide Recommended, Block Sites, or Greyscale.
- Adjust your custom block list if you want to add more sites.
- Get back to your tasks with fewer distractions!
Updates & Roadmap

firefox-addons:858909.summary: Fast and easy way to copy web components, HTML widgets and parts of website design.
firefox-addons:858909.description:
Web Design Pirate is a Firefox DevTools extension that allows you to select an HTML node, and then gives you only the CSS styles that you need to render the full component (subtree).
Optionally, for copying wrapper-style components it also allows you to specify the level of inner HTML content that can be thrown away (to further reduce the number of needed CSS styles).

Extension pour le site Nstools
Analyser et tester rapidement les Dns, le Whois, les serveurs Web et Smtp d'un nom de domaine ou d'une adresse IP grâce à nstools.fr . Outil en ligne d'analyse la configuration technique d'un nom de domaine ou d'une adresse IP, effectue des tests nslookup sur les whois, DNS, MX, serveur web.
 NStools.fr est un outil gratuit permettant de vérifier simplement et rapidement la configuration d’un nom de domaine et de ses DNS. NS.tools effectue une analyse complète de l’arbre DNS depuis la racine, les Tld et les serveurs NS du domaine, afin de définir les serveurs DNS faisant autorité. L’outil testera aussi le paramétrage, la sécurité et la synchronisation des serveurs DNS. Des analyses sont également effectuées sur les whois, les MX, et le site web du domaine. bluejetty:00127230:ios.description:
Wedding Planner is the perfect companion to have while preparing for your big day. It's packed with a personalized checklist of all the essential to-dos for you and your partner's "I dos." You'll feel so much more at ease to know what has been done and what still needs to be done - there's no better app to use for all your wedding needs, so start planning with Wedding Planner today!

• Sync & Backup: Invite your partner to participate or simply back up your data for peace of mind.

• Budget: Set a budget and get an estimate of how much to spend on each expense.
• Journal: Keep a wedding journal for all the days leading up to the wedding - these are memories worth saving.
• Day-of: Plan the timeline of events on your wedding day and easily share it with vendors, friends, and family.
• Contacts: Put all your important wedding contacts in one place and organize them by category.
• Apple Watch: Check off your to-dos and view your wedding countdown and photo on Apple Watch!
• And more!
In addition to the free features listed above, we also offer Wedding Planner Premium as a subscription. Wedding Planner Premium subscribers will have access to an ad-free experience and unlimited storage.

TOP SKINCARE AND NUTRITION TIPS

bluejetty:00099947:ios.description:

QR Code Integration: Add new authenticator entries instantly by scanning QR codes with your device’s camera.
Cross-Device Compatibility: Enjoy full synchronization and access to your MFA and TOTP codes on multiple devices.
Download Authenticator now to strengthen your online security with simple, reliable, and powerful multi-factor authentication (MFA).
Your trusted all-in-one auth solution — fast, secure, and always in sync.

* Featured in: USA Today, Wall Street Journal, Forbes, GQ, Men's Journal *
** Built by Stanford-trained PhD in Neuroscience & PhD/Professor of Counseling Psychology from Cal State Fullerton **
*** Brought to you by the founding team members of the Calm app ***
Overcome stress, build confidence & unlock your potential, all in one free app.
Whether it's stress from relationships, lack of confidence at work, anxiety about finances, or struggles with unhealthy habits, your first line of defense is Mental — an evidenced-based AI coaching & self-improvement app.
Available 24/7 and 100% free forever, it's your personal guide to transforming your life into the person you were born to be.
AI COACHING THAT UNDERSTANDS YOU
-Always Here for You: Engage in real-time conversations with a coach that best fits your goals & needs, adapts to your unique challenges, and is available 24/7.
-Analyze you between sessions: Coaches not only remember what you said in past sessions but they spend time thinking about you between sessions so that they can provide more insight or help you arrive at better solutions.
-Proprietary Neural Architecture: Developed by Stanford-trained PhD in neuroscience & a PhD/professor of Counseling Psychology at Cal State Fullerton and leading Silicon Valley AI engineers, every empathetic interaction is rooted in clinical research and designed for fast, lasting results. And powered by 42x more compute than ChatGPT.
-Seamless Privacy & Security: Your sessions are fully encrypted, anonymous, and protected by a PIN code, ensuring privacy and your peace of mind.
TOOLS FOR DAILY TRAINING
-Daily Deuce: Kickstart every day with a quick 2-3 minute audio of motivation, wisdom, and storytelling to set a positive tone.
-Daily Do: Turn insights from the Deuce into action with AI-generated journaling prompts that provide small, achievable daily tasks to build lasting habits.
-Cold Shower Protocol: Decrease stress with the world's first guided, science-based cold shower training. Developed by experts and taught by a Navy SEAL Master Chief, this protocol introduces you to over 25 mental tools while easing you into cold exposure — users call it “life-changing” and surprisingly accessible with every shower starting with your normal hot shower routine.
-Push-Up Protocol with Deontay Wilder: Go from 5 to 50 push-ups in 30 days and train your body & mind alongside former heavyweight champion Deontay Wilder. This guided protocol blends physical exercise with mindset training to build confidence & discipline through tools around self-talk, visualization, breath-work & mental focus.
-Focus Mode & Nightly Recharge: Enhance concentration with science-backed beats that help you zone in on your tasks. When it's time to rest, use Nightly Recharge to fall asleep faster and wake up refreshed, ready for a new day of growth.
-Audiobook Summaries: Absorb key insights quickly with audio summaries and key takeaways from thousands of top-rated & best-selling self-improvement books, covering topics from dating and overcoming a break-up, to overcoming obstacles and finding life's purpose.
BUILT ON TRUST & EXPERTISE
Developed by the founding team behind the Calm app, plus a team of renowned PhDs in neuroscience and psychology, mixed with Hollywood content creators, Mental ensures you receive credible and effective guidance, mixed with motivational and entertaining content for the mind.
Mental's EULA is here: http://bit.ly/44jBrW2
JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
Connect with us on social media @thementalapp for news, product updates, inspiration, and funny memes.
And if you're looking for a more hands-on community to share your goals, stay accountable & connect with other Mental'ers, join our Discord: https://discord.gg/pbqSEEeqv3
DOWNLOAD MENTAL TODAY & BEGIN YOUR TRANSFORMATION
Start your journey toward better mental health, increased resilience, and personal transformation with Mental's AI coaching & tools for daily training.

bluejetty:00149699:ios.description:
Snug is a simple daily check-in app for people who live alone. Once a day, at a time you pick, you tap a button to say you're okay. If you miss it, Snug alerts the people you trust.
Made for:
- Older adults living alone who want to keep their independence
- Adult children checking on a parent without calling every day
- Pet owners who want someone to know if something happens
- Anyone aging solo, without family nearby
How it works:
- Pick your daily check-in time
- Tap once to check in
- Miss it, and Snug alerts your emergency contacts by text
- Add as many contacts as you like, free
Want more? The Dispatch Plan adds a live call from Snug's team if you miss a check-in, plus a wellness check.
A modern alternative to a medical alert pendant. No wearable, no equipment, just your phone. Trusted for over 20 million check-ins and featured by AARP.

bluejetty:00072914:ios.summary:

Using SongCapsule is super easy: all you need to do is connect t
bluejetty:00072914:ios.description:
SongCapsule is an app to rediscover your music library and works like your personal DJ. It’s available on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro with a single purchase.
Using SongCapsule is super easy: all you need to do is connect the app to your music library — it supports Apple Music, iTunes Match, or local synced songs in your device. SongCapsule will locally scan your songs and automatically create mixes and playlists for you based on your favorite artists, genres, and even decades.
With Magic DJ, you can create mixes of artists and genres with different algorithms, like playing more of your top songs or rediscovering hidden gems in your music library. It’s like a shuffle mode — but more intelligent and tailored just for you.
SongCapsule will learn and send a #tbt notification every week to remember you of songs you once loved, but haven’t played for a while. There’s also a special playlist and widget with your forgotten songs.
FEATURES
• Magic DJ with three different configurations
• Playlists
• Apple’s Music app integration
• Siri Suggestions and Shortcuts
• Sharing now playing songs on Instagram, Threads and X with a beautiful card image
• CarPlay support
• AirPlay 2
• Light and Dark Modes
• Widgets (including a Lock Screen widget for iOS 16)
• Wind Down support (for iOS 14 and 15)
• Privacy built-in
• Full iPad and Mac support
To learn everything that SongCapsule can do, visit sorcererhat.com/support/songcapsule.
IMPORTANT
SongCapsule requires a music library with at least 100 songs added to it. Subscribed playlists don’t count.

bluejetty:00131710:ios.description:
Universal TV Remote – Smart Control for All Your TVs
Tired of juggling multiple remotes for every device in your home? 
Transform your smartphone into a smart, all-in-one remote control for your TV. Whether you're watching your favorite movie, switching between streaming apps, or searching for a show — everything becomes effortless.
Our app is built to work with all major smart TV brands, from Roku, Samsung to Chromecast TV, Apple TV, and more. Just connect and take full control of your entertainment.
ONE APP - FULL REMOTE CONTROL
No more lost remotes or dead batteries. Our full-featured remote gives you everything:
- Power on/off your TV
- Adjust volume & mute instantly
- Change input sources
- Navigate menus with smart gestures
- Control playback and channel navigation
Whether you’re watching cable, streaming films, or casting a video — control it all from your phone.
UNIVERSAL TV REMOTE CONTROL - ADVANCED FEATURES:
- Quick Access to Streaming Channels:
Jump right into your favorite shows and apps with a single tap. Instantly launch popular platforms.
No more endless navigation. Just tap and go.
- Control with Your Voice:
Use your voice to search, switch channels, adjust volume, or open an app. Say it, and let the app do it for you. Perfect for hands-free control or when you're across the room.
- Smart Touchpad & Swipe Navigation:
Replace clunky buttons with smooth gesture-based control. Swipe to scroll, tap to select — just like using a smart touch controller. Navigating your TV has never been this intuitive.
- Built-in Keyboard:
Typing on a TV is painful. Use your phone’s keyboard to enter search terms, login info, or type messages — fast and easy, just like texting.
- Customizable Smart Themes:
Make your remote interface match your style and TV type. Choose from smart layouts designed for better visibility, quick access, and ease of use.
- Cast to Your TV:
Want to share photos, videos, or web content on your TV? Use the Cast feature to project directly from your phone to the big screen — great for family moments, presentations, or binge nights.
- Private Listening (Roku Only):
Watching late at night? Use your headphones and stream your TV audio directly to your phone for a private and immersive experience — without disturbing anyone.
* Reclaim control of your TV with just one app. Whether you're relaxing on the couch, in bed, or even hosting friends — our Universal TV Remote gives you everything you need at your fingertips.
* Download now and experience TV control the smart way.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase while using Universal TV Remote Control App. 
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase.
- Subscriptions will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal cost will be charged to your account 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
- When the subscription is canceled, it will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded. 
- If offered, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. 
DISCLAIMER: TV Remote Control Universal is not affiliated with any trademark mentioned. 
Thanks for downloading our app. If you have any problems with this app, please contact us at: contact.tvsmart@gmail.com 
Privacy Policy: https://smarttvcast-screenmirroring.web.app/policy.html
Terms of Service: https://smarttvcast-screenmirroring.web.app/term.html

bluejetty:00088238:ios.name: AIFastPPT - Slides Maker
bluejetty:00088238:ios.summary: "AIFastPPT" is an innovative app designed to provide users with a fast and efficient presentation creation experience using AI technology. Whether you are a student, teacher, professional, or entrepreneur needing to deliver a professional p
bluejetty:00088238:ios.description:
"AIFastPPT" is an innovative app designed to provide users with a fast and efficient presentation creation experience using AI technology. Whether you are a student, teacher, professional, or entrepreneur needing to deliver a professional presentation, "AIFastPPT" offers the perfect solution.
Feature Overview:
1. AI One-Click Presentation Generation: "AIFastPPT" uses advanced AI technology to enable one-click presentation generation. Users simply input a topic or keywords, and the AI automatically generates a slide deck with rich content and a logical structure.
2. Multiple Generation Methods:
 - Topic Generation: Enter a topic, and the AI will provide a presentation with relevant content.
 - File Upload Generation: Supports document uploads to automatically extract key content and generate a presentation.
 - Long Text Paste Generation: Directly paste text, and the AI will intelligently analyze and generate a presentation.
 - URL Link Paste Generation: Enter a URL, and the AI will extract webpage content to generate a presentation.
3. Extensive Template Library: "AIFastPPT" includes hundreds of high-quality templates covering business, education, technology, art, and more. Each template is carefully designed to ensure your presentation is visually appealing.
User Experience:
1. Simple and Intuitive Interface: "AIFastPPT" features a clear and straightforward user interface, allowing users to get started easily without a complex learning process. All functions are optimized for a smooth user experience.
2. High Customization: Users can personalize the generated presentations according to their needs, including changing colors, fonts, layouts, etc., to ensure every slide deck matches their style and requirements.
Technical Advantages:
1. Powerful AI Algorithms: "AIFastPPT" relies on advanced AI technology to quickly analyze and generate high-quality presentation content. Our algorithms continuously learn and improve to provide increasingly accurate content generation.
2. Data Security Assurance: We prioritize user privacy and data security. "AIFastPPT" employs multi-layered security measures to ensure that uploaded files and generated presentation content are fully protected.
Application Scenarios:
1. Education: Teachers can quickly generate teaching materials, and students can easily create presentation reports, enhancing learning and teaching efficiency.
2. Business: Professionals can use "AIFastPPT" to quickly create project reports, business plans, etc., improving work efficiency and professionalism.
3. Creative Displays: Designers and artists can use the extensive templates and customization features to easily create outstanding creative presentation slide decks.
【Automatic Subscription Service Description】
1. Subscription services are:
 - Weekly membership
 - Annual membership
2. Payment: After the user confirms the purchase and payment, it will be charged to the iTunes account.
3. Auto-renewal: The Apple iTunes account will be charged within 24 hours prior to expiration, extending the subscription period by one cycle.
4. Cancel Service: You can go to "Settings" on your iPhone --> "iTunes Store & App Store" --> Click "Apple ID" and select "View Apple ID", enter the "Account Settings" page, click "Subscriptions" to manage automatic subscriptions. To cancel, turn off 24 hours before the end of each cycle. No charge will be made within the 24 hours prior.
5. Subscription Terms: (https://kdocs.cn/l/cc2abLUNsjFD)
6. Privacy Policy: (https://kdocs.cn/l/cuaO8sk7qSc0)

Grub Lab Games brings the fun to the kids table.
Play with your favourite Little Grubbies characters, explore big brand worlds and unlock real-world rewards, at home or at your favourite family restaurant.
Whether you have just sat down at a venue with a Grub Lab kids menu, or you have a link from a previous visit, Grub Lab Games makes it easy to keep kids entertained and engaged.
Play with Little Grubbies and big brands
- Jump into themed games featuring the Little Grubbies crew and their adventures
- Discover experiences inspired by leading entertainment, sport and family brands
- Explore stories, collect items and return to keep playing new content
Made for families and kids
- Simple, kid-friendly gameplay designed for ages 5–12
- Play together at the table or let kids explore in short, snackable sessions
- No in-app purchases and no loot boxes
Perfect for family dining
Grub Lab Games is built for family dining venues. Kids get something fun and interactive to do. Parents get a smoother meal. Venues get a simple way to offer games, promotions and track engagement.
Key Features
- Kids games and experiences featuring Little Grubbies and big brand partners
- Play in-venue using the QR code on your kids menu, or at home
- No in-app purchases

bluejetty:00066181:ios.name: Orient Express Dominoes
bluejetty:00066181:ios.summary: All aboard the mystic Orient Express for dominoes! From the makers of Mexican Train Dominoes Gold and Mexican Train Dominoes Classic, comes both a beautiful journey and game. Be dazzled by the touch-screen optimized interface, slick gamepla
bluejetty:00066181:ios.description:
All aboard the mystic Orient Express for dominoes! From the makers of Mexican Train Dominoes Gold and Mexican Train Dominoes Classic, comes both a beautiful journey and game. Be dazzled by the touch-screen optimized interface, slick gameplay, and sharp graphics, and above all, relax and have fun with beautiful vistas! 
Play with friends using our nifty Pass and Play feature, or alone against AI. Adjust your tiles however and wherever you like, and play as tactically as you want. There’s a scoreboard that keeps track of you and your opponents’ score so there’s no need for paper and pen. There are helpful instructions and hints throughout if you need them, but if you’re happy to fly solo, you can easily switch them off in the settings section. Play a speedy, normal, or lengthy round to suit the time you have going spare. Using portrait mode for your iPhone, you now have the space to organize your tiles, keep an eye on your opponents, and room to take in that gorgeous background! If you play on iPad, you’ll have the classic landscape orientation. However you play, play your way! 
Features: 
- Animated tutorial for beginners 
- Lots of options and settings so you can play exactly your way 
- A.I opponents with different capabilities 
- 3 different modes in which to play to suit you
- Expertly researched and drawn historic stops as backgrounds for a well-rounded Orient Express experience
- Room for up to four players with Pass and Play! 
- Portrait orientation for iPhones
Enjoy the ride, enjoy the game! It’s Orient Express Dominoes!

bluejetty:00032144:ios.description:
War of Evolution lets you control the development of a species from the very start of its evolutionary journey as a microscopic organism, to the point it becomes an intelligent and social creature, to its mastery of the planet, and finally to interstellar exploration as a space-faring species. 
Survival of the Fittest
You will start as a unique organism, where you'll be free to decide how best to grow and survive by eating smaller creatures and running from predators.
Evolve Your Organism
Evolution has several stages: Creature, Tribe, Civilization, and Space. Help your creature evolve from a single creature into a vivid and unique organism that can stand for itself and its species.
Customize Your Creature
Modify the shape, abilities, and appearance of your creature. Use your imagination to create the most unique creature - then introduce it to the world! 
Develop Your Clan
The primordial forests aren't the end of the journey. Hunt down your enemies with overwhelming power or clever strategies and gain upgradable gears. Start with a humble creature and build your own galactic empire!
Build, Expand, & Conquer
Craft customizable buildings for your tribe as they expand from a tiny peaceful town to a bustling metropolis, and eventually…reach for the stars!
Find out more on our Facebook Page
Facebook:https://www.facebook.com/WarofEvolution

bluejetty:00068268:ios.description:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button in Settings under Subscriptions.
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”
Games: Users can enjoy a variety of games served in app. Games include: Sudoku, Solitaire, Jumble, Crossword, and Puzzles
Terms of Use:

- Match the same tiles on the board!
- Tap two of the same tiles to remove them!
- Use a booster when you are having a hard time!

- No time limit, so no rush, just relax playing matching tiles
- Beautiful graphics and various layouts
- Hours of gameplay for you to enjoy
- Free to play and no wifi needed

bluejetty:00146303:ios.description:
Fomo – Your AI Social World
Fomo is an always-active AI social platform designed entirely around you.
Share photos, go live, and chat while all interactions are generated by realistic AI characters — not real users.

Discover and Connect

Filter by interests, mood, or communication style to connect with the perfect AI friend.
Why Fomo?
Always-active AI social experience
Real-time interaction with AI followers and influencers
Create and chat with evolving AI characters
AI-powered photo sharing and live streaming
No real users, no toxicity, no pressure
Fomo is built for creativity, experimentation, and pure interaction without the stress of traditional social media.

Fomo does not aim to connect users with real people.

bluejetty:00096429:ios.description:
Artwork combines step by step drawing tutorials, sketch practice, painting exercises, and digital drawing training designed for beginners and experienced artists.
Practice artwork creation through guided exercises that help develop drawing skills, sketch accuracy, and creative confidence. From simple sketches to advanced illustrations, Artwork helps artists explore drawing, painting, and sketching through engaging lessons and creative challenges.
Whether practicing artwork, learning sketch techniques, or exploring digital drawing similar to Procreate and Sketchbook, structured lessons help artists develop stronger fundamentals and artistic confidence.
==> Key Features of ArtWorkout: Learn How to Draw
1. Step-by-Step Drawing Lessons
Artwork provides structured drawing tutorials that guide every line and shape. Learn how to draw characters, objects, anime drawing, and creative artwork through clear step by step drawing lessons designed to improve artistic fundamentals.
2. Interactive Drawing Practice
Practice drawing with interactive feedback designed to improve sketch accuracy and hand control. Guided exercises help artists understand shapes, proportions, and creative drawing techniques while building confidence through consistent practice.
3. 500+ Drawing Exercises
Explore hundreds of drawing lessons and creative exercises designed to strengthen artistic skills. Practice sketching, painting, and digital drawing through engaging drawing tutorials and training sessions.
4. Sketchbook & Digital Drawing Practice
Practice sketchbook drawing, sketchpad exercises, and digital artwork techniques. Explore creative sketch projects, drawing animation basics, graphic design drawing, and artistic illustration practice.
5. Daily Drawing Challenges
Daily creative challenges help artists stay consistent with drawing practice. Explore drawing games, sketch exercises, and artwork challenges that help improve drawing skills step by step.
==> Drawing for Beginners to Advanced
Lessons support beginners learning how to draw while also helping experienced artists refine sketching, painting, and digital drawing techniques.
==> Why Choose Artwork?
Artwork combines drawing tutorials, sketch practice, artwork training, and digital drawing lessons into a creative learning experience. Structured exercises help artists explore drawing, painting, sketching, and illustration through engaging practice sessions designed to improve artistic skills.

bluejetty:00115808:ios.description:
Welcome to Rockaway Beach Pickleball & Golf Club: your new home for easy booking, local play, and community connection.
Whether you're a first-time player, a social regular, or a competitive grinder, our app makes it simple to get on court and into the flow.
Download the app to:
• Book pickleball and golf courts instantly
• Sign up for Open Play, Clinics, Leagues & Tournaments
• Track your progress with DUPR integration
• Connect with your crew through events and group play
• Manage memberships, passes, and payment all in one place
• Get recommendations based on your skill level and interests
Why Rockaway Pickleball?
We’re a club built on community, coastal rhythm, and the joy of shared play. With five indoor pickleball courts, two golf simulators, and a full-service café + bar, Rockaway Beach Pickleball & Golf is a space to connect, compete, and unwind, no matter your level or schedule.
Our programming blends skill, social connection, and surf-club spirit. From beginner clinics and cardio sessions to competitive DUPR-based play and fun social mixers, we’ve got something for every type of player.
App Features
• Real-time court availability
• Secure, fast booking and cancellation
• Filter events by level, date, or program type
• Track your past and upcoming sessions
• Exclusive offers and perks for members
• Notifications for new events, promotions, and club updates
• Sync with your DUPR account and get matched with the right sessions
Types of Sessions You’ll Find
• One Wave Open Play – Social, fun pickleball
• The Riptide – Competitive play with DUPR score reporting
• The Pulse – Liveball cardio-based sessions
• The First Wave – Beginner clinics + intro series
• The Second Set – Intermediate skill-building sessions

bluejetty:00087278:ios.summary:

Each team has separate color chips. There can be maximum of four players in single team and maximum of four teams in this g
bluejetty:00087278:ios.description:
Jacks Card Game can be played with 2 to 8 players. These players gets equally divided into two, three or four teams.
Each team has separate color chips. There can be maximum of four players in single team and maximum of four teams in this game.
Each card is pictured twice on the game board, and Jacks (while necessary for game strategy) do not appear on the board.
The player chooses a card from their hand, and places a chip on one of the corresponding spaces of the game board (Example: they choose Ace of Diamonds from their hand and place a chip on the Ace of Diamonds on the board). Jacks have special powers. Two-Eyed Jacks can represent any card and may be used to place a chip on any open space on the board. One-Eyed Jacks can remove an opponent's token from a space. Players may use the Two-Eyed Jacks to complete a row or block an opponent, and One-Eyed Jacks can remove an opponent's advantage. One-Eyed Jacks cannot be used to remove a marker chip that is already part of a completed sequence; once a sequence is achieved by a player or team, it stands.
Once player has played his/her turn, player gets a new card from the deck.
A player may place chips on either of the appropriate card spaces as long as it is not already covered by an opponent's marker chip.
If a player possesses a card which does not have an open space on the game board, the card is considered "dead" and may be exchanged for a new card. When it is their turn, they place the dead on card on the discard pile, announce they are turning in a dead card, and take a replacement (one card per turn). Then they proceed to play their normal turn.
In this game, there are multiple boosters which makes the game more interesting.

bluejetty:00155485:ios.name: Backcountry Ski - Beta App
bluejetty:00155485:ios.summary:
Backcountry weather, avalanche data and trip planning resources all concisely displayed on one map. Easily review all the essentials before heading out on a tour:
• Avalanche forecasts and field observations from avalanche centers across t
bluejetty:00155485:ios.description:
Backcountry weather, avalanche data and trip planning resources all concisely displayed on one map. Easily review all the essentials before heading out on a tour:
• Avalanche forecasts and field observations from avalanche centers across the country including Colorado Avalanche Information Center, Utah Avalanche Center, Teton Avalanche Center, Mount Washington Avalanche Center and more.
• Real-time temperature, wind and snowfall data from 2,000+ mountain weather stations. Weather networks include SNOTEL, MADIS, CoCoRaHS, CWOP and many others.
• Preview conditions in remote terrain with live overlays of today's snowfall, depth and coverage along with recent satellite views.
• Weather forecast and observation summaries built specifically for backcountry ski zones. 
• Hourly NOAA weather forecasts for mountain summits and passes.
• Filter observations and weather stations by zone (Berthoud, Loveland, etc) or create your own custom zones to monitor your go-to areas. 
Introducing Backcountry Condition Checks for the 2026/27 season: AI assisted weather queries for specific mountain locations and elevations. Ask "What will the high temperature be at 12,000 feet in Summit County tomorrow?", "Will it get below freezing tonight at Berthoud Pass?", "How windy will it be at the summit of Mount Washington tomorrow?". Get answers sourced directly from the National Weather Service and local weather stations.
Comprehensive trip planning tools for backcountry skiers and snowboarders:
• Munter calculator estimates ski tour travel times based on distance and vertical climb.
• Create instant trip plans from your GPX tracks. Share route information, weather, avalanche forecasts and safety checklists with your partners.
• Topographic slope maps highlight high-risk avalanche terrain.
• GPS tracking to record and share your tours.
• Submit and share observations from your tours (tap the plus button in the upper right corner). Create trip reports with photos and route beta.
Built for the backcountry:
• Offline topo maps work without cell service.
• Home screen widgets for quick weather and avalanche updates.
• All your backcountry resources displayed on one user-friendly map.
What Backcountry Skiers Are Saying:
"It's amazing to have all these tools packed neatly into one app... Finally!!!"
"All the weather/snow-nerd data - it's all here."
"A wealth of resources for backcountry skiers...this is my go to app."
"Having NOAA point forecasts, avalanche outlook, and SNOTEL data all in one app is just the best. This is THE essential winter recreation app IMHO."
===============
Offline topo maps, hourly weather forecasts, weather station data, zone filtering and munter calculator require pro subscription or $19.99 one time lifetime purchase.

bluejetty:00147531:ios.name: Climate Action Now
bluejetty:00147531:ios.summary:
Public opinion is the only effective counterweight to the immense power of the fossil fuel industry. The industry knows this, which is why it spends so much time and money trying to shape it.
Your opinion really does matter. It is your sup
bluejetty:00147531:ios.description:
Public opinion is the only effective counterweight to the immense power of the fossil fuel industry. The industry knows this, which is why it spends so much time and money trying to shape it.
Your opinion really does matter. It is your superpower. But it doesn’t count for much if you don’t express it. The Climate Action Now app can help you with that. It is your opinion amplifier. It is your megaphone.
This app does the work so that you don’t have to. It provides an endless stream of well-researched, well-written, personalized messages that you can send to political and business leaders advocating for climate action in just seconds with just a few touches! And you’ll learn a lot about the issues and earn real trees as you go.
FAST. Most actions in the app – like contacting your elected officials, emailing CEOs, or asking media influencers to step up – can be taken with just a few touches in just a few seconds. We’ve done all the work for you so that you don’t need to. Don’t know who your elected officials are? Give the app your location, and it will tell you. Don’t know how to contact them? The app has their email addresses and phone numbers. Don’t know what to tell them? The app gives you personalized, well-written, powerful messages that you can send in seconds.
IMPACTFUL. Climate Action Now gives you, whether you are a concerned citizen or a hard-core climate activist, the means to take thousands of individual, collective, and systemic actions NOW. To date, app users have sent over one MILLION messages and planted over 47,000 trees. You can send an impactful message in seconds.
Did you know that just 100 companies, and the politicians, investors, and regulators who enable them, are responsible for over 70% of the world’s emissions? Climate Action Now makes it easy for you to influence them with emails, petitions, and phone calls.
Did you know that the fossil fuel industry is poisoning communities of color in their own backyards? Climate Action Now helps you fight these injustices and demand an equitable future for all.
Did you know that leading climate activists say the most important thing you can do about climate change is to talk about it? Every action you take with Climate Action Now is automatically posted to the app's Community Feed where people can see it, take that action also, comment on it, like it, and share it with others. 
REWARDING. Every action you take earns points, and when you’ve earned enough points, a real tree will be planted. Every action you take sets an example for others to follow. Join a team and every action you take contributes to the team’s total and helps it win rivalries with other teams. Through all these things, you earn the most important reward of all: knowing that you’re doing your part to save our planet.
Time is short, and the future is in our hands. Literally. Together, with a phone or tablet and a few minutes a day, we can all take Climate Action Now.

Say goodbye to clutter and wasted storage! Cleaner is the ultimate app to clean, organize, and optimize your phone effortlessly. Merge Duplicate Contacts: Eliminate duplicate entries in your address book and keep your contacts neat.

Powerful Tools: Includes advanced features like video compression, contact merging, and inbox cleaning.

Secure and Reliable: Protects your sensitive files with password-protected folders and a privacy-first approach.

Boosts Performance: Removes unnecessary files and frees up storage to keep your phone running smoothly.
Protects Your Privacy: Locks private files and ensures your sensitive data is safe.
Simplifies File Management: Manage contacts, emails, and videos effortlessly with intuitive tools.

bluejetty:00025831:ios.name: First Words for Baby + Toddler
bluejetty:00025831:ios.summary: Spark your child's curiosity and boost their vocabulary with First Words for Baby & Toddler! Explore animals, vehicles, food and everyday objects, brought to life with hand-drawn graphics, interactive animations and adorable sounds. Our uni
bluejetty:00025831:ios.description:
Spark your child's curiosity and boost their vocabulary with First Words for Baby & Toddler! Explore animals, vehicles, food and everyday objects, brought to life with hand-drawn graphics, interactive animations and adorable sounds. Our unique mix of flashcards and touch-based games makes language learning a fun and educational experience for 1, 2, and 3-year-olds. Touch, tap, and discover a world of words!
'First Words for Baby & Toddler' makes learning fun from the very beginning:
- Designed for Early Learners: Whether you have a newborn baby or a one year old, our app is tailored to suit your infant's unique developmental stage.
- Interactive and Playful: Our colorful high contrast babies games / flashcards with my first 100 words & animal sounds are thoughtfully designed to captivate your child's attention, encouraging them to tap, touch, swipe and explore their way through the content of first words. Very much like a digital baby rattle.
- First words for babies & toddlers: Explore a carefully curated selection of baby and toddler flashcards, introducing vehicles, farm animals for toddlers, fruits and food, forest, music, jungle creatures, pets, clothes, sea life, and everyday objects. We continuously expand our word collection and baby touch games for 1yr 2yr 3yr old.
- Colorful hand-drawn high contrast graphics and animations: We know that children love bright colors and cute animals, so we've designed our montessori preschool app with this in mind. More than 100 illustrations were hand-drawn especially for our baby sensory games for preschoolers.
- Bonding Time with Mommy and Daddy: First Words for Baby & Toddler offers quality family time. Share moments of discovery and joy as you and your child explore the animal sounds for babies, flash cards and baby touch games together.
- Interactive and Fun: Learning is all about fun! This playfully sensory baby toddler learning games app includes interactive mini baby sensory high contrast games for babies from one year old that keep your kid entertained while they absorb new words effortlessly.
- Voiceovers and sound effects: The app features voiceovers and sounds that help to bring the content to life. Toddlers will love learning their first words with audio, hearing animal sounds for babies and the noises of a car engine revving up.
- All first words for baby & toddler flashcards are available in 25 languages (including English, Spanish, German, Portugese, Japanese and Chinese). This way, your baby can develop in their native language through engaging baby sensory games.
- Offline Access: All content is available offline, ensuring uninterrupted baby sensory: high contrast adventures.
- Ad-free: No ads interrupt the magic within the app.
First Words for Baby & Toddler is the gateway to fun learning games for preschool & kindergarten, offering a variety of animal sounds for babies and flash cards for 1yr 2yr 3yr olds. Dive into our colorful high contrast flash cards and interactive toddler games for 1+ year olds where little ones can tap, touch, swipe, and explore their way through the world of first words. Explore animals for toddlers, vehicles, farm animals, fruits, and food, all within a playful, sensory baby toddler learning environment. Enjoy interactive baby sensory games for infants, and witness your baby's vocabulary grow.
For questions and feedback please contact support [@] wienelware.nl

bluejetty:00062393:ios.description:
Looking for ad-free educational games for kids ages 2–7 that work offline — on planes, road trips, or quiet afternoons at home?
Edudi transforms screen time into learning. 150+ playful games like ABC tracing, puzzle solving, virtual pet care, cooking, dress-up, and doctor role-play that teach skills like letter recognition, counting, early math, creativity, and more - all in one app!
Why parents love it
All-in-one kids’ learning app – no need to juggle multiple downloads.
Offline, with no third-party ads – perfect “no-Wi-Fi” entertainment.
Created by certified early-childhood teachers – games designed to meet preschool and kindergarten curricula.
What kids can do inside
Learn the alphabet: Trace letters, spell words, sing along, and shout “I know my ABCs!”
Master numbers & math: Count fruits, learn simple addition, and split pizzas into simple fractions.
Explore colors & shapes: Sort rainbow veggies, match geometric cookies, and paint funny monsters.
Solve puzzles: Enjoy three difficulty levels of jigsaw puzzles to build logic skills and spatial awareness.
Dress up & style: Try dress up games for kids — mix outfits, match patterns, and “dress my doll” to spark creativity and self-expression.
Play hospital & doctor: Step into a hospital game for toddlers to learn empathy and responsibility — check temperatures, bandage knees, and care for your patients until they hear a happy ""all better!""
Cook & bake: Follow recipes, chop, blend, and plate healthy dishes — with no kitchen mess!
Care for cute pets: Feed, bathe, and play fetch with your cute pet to learn empathy and responsibility.
Every mini-game features bright animations and cheerful voice-overs that keep children motivated while they practice hand-eye coordination, fine-motor control, problem-solving, creativity, and self-confidence.
Key facts at a glance:
150+ games / 600+ learning activities
Covers 12 essential preschool skills in one bundle
Designed for ages 3–7 with adaptive difficulty
Works online or offline — great for travel
100 % kid-safe environment – developed taking into account COPPA requirements
Start today!
Download Edudi and watch your child giggle, swipe, and shout “I did it!” while mastering the skills every preschool teacher loves.
Give your little one the best learning app for preschoolers with games and puzzles — because fun and knowledge taste better together!
Please note: only part of the content in the screenshots is available in the free version of the app. To gain access to all app content, you need to make an in-app purchase.
ABOUT ERUDITO
ERUDITO was started in 2012 by four parents with experience in children's education. And today, we are a 250-people team of dedicated designers, artists, animators, and educators. To date, we have more than 30 apps, with our user base having reached 98M.
We are inspired by the idea of bringing fun into early education and enhancing a child's natural love of learning through educational apps for kids.
If you need help, have questions or just want to say “hi!”, get in touch at:
support@eruditoplus.com
http://eruditoplus.com/en
http://eruditoplus.com/en/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00180420:ios.description:
GT eToken Application Description (About this app)
The GT eToken is a mobile application for generating One Time Passwords (OTPs) used in authenticating electronic transactions.
A one-time password (OTP) is a secure and automatically generated string of characters that authenticates the user for login and/or electronic transaction completion.
Electronic transactions include (but may not be limited to) web, internet banking and mobile banking transactions, where you are required to enter a 6-digit token-generated code.
A one-time password (OTP) generated from your GT eToken App can be used as an alternative to or alongside the GTBank hardware token device.
Activating Your GT eToken app
To activate your GT eToken app, select your customer type and choose your preferred activation method, which can be the use of your Bank card, Hardware Token or by calling contact center to get an authorization code.
Your data ID will be verified to complete the activation.
Using Your GT eToken app:
Once your app is activated, you can create a unique 6-digit Passcode that will be used for subsequent log in to the application and enjoy 24/7 banking.
You can find more information about GT eToken on www.gtbank.com or contact GTCONNECT contact center on 080 2900 2900 or 080 3900 3900.
Note: To avoid your OTP being used by anyone, you absolutely DO NOT DISCLOSE OTP code for anyone.

Chart AI Pro: The Ultimate AI Stock Trading Assistant for Smarter Decisions
With Chart AI Pro, you can:
• Take a photo and analyze charts instantly
• Search with AI to uncover high-potential opportunities
• Ask any financial question, anytime. Trade smarter, 24/7
Chart AI Pro Trading Assistant is a powerful AI stock trading assistant and chart analyzer designed for investors and traders who want to stay ahead of the market. Built using sophisticated AI models with billions of parameters and strong financial understanding, it helps you decode charts, identify patterns, and make faster, smarter trading decisions—all in one seamless experience.
Whether you’re new to trading or refining your advanced strategies, Chart AI Pro delivers precise, real-time insights using advanced vision AI, technical breakdowns, and intelligent market interpretation.
Analyze Any Chart with AI
Snap or upload a chart—stocks, ETFs, indices, and more—and get instant AI analysis. The assistant reads patterns, detects key signals, and delivers insights like entry and exit points, support and resistance levels, candlestick formations, and strategy suggestions. It’s like having a chart expert in your pocket.
Ask Anything. Trade Smarter.
Use the built-in chat to ask anything—from technical indicators and strategy ideas to news impacts or risk analysis. No complicated setup. No distractions. Just clear, intelligent responses that help you act with confidence.
Your AI-Powered Trading Edge
Chart AI Pro combines three powerful categories of AI support:
• Chart AI Assistants for deep technical analysis and precision chart reading
• Specialized AI Experts for strategies like day trading, swing trading, options, portfolio planning, and more
• AI Search Assistants that track the markets to find strong buy/short setups and trends worth watching
All assistants are powered by state-of-the-art AI trained on financial data and trading knowledge, making them fast, intuitive, and highly effective across all experience levels.
Built for Traders at Every Level
Whether you’re spotting patterns before others, testing a new setup, or confirming an idea, Chart AI Pro works as your 24/7 trading analyzer and decision-making companion.
No signup required. No personal data collected. Just instant, intelligent insights at your fingertips.
Important Disclaimer:
Chart AI Pro Trading Assistant is an AI-powered informational and educational assistant designed to support trading and investment decisions. It is not a financial advisor and does not provide personalized investment advice or guaranteed results. Get ready for a world of vibrant colors and endless creativity with the Colorland app!
Perfect for children aged 2 to 5, this app offers over 140 delightful coloring pages that will captivate your little one’s imagination. From adorable ani
bluejetty:00081352:ios.description:
Get ready for a world of vibrant colors and endless creativity with the Colorland app!
Perfect for children aged 2 to 5, this app offers over 140 delightful coloring pages that will captivate your little one’s imagination. From adorable animals to fun vehicles, there’s something for every budding artist. 
But that’s not all – Colorland invites children to discover a magical castle where they can set out on an artistic journey like no other.
Let your child explore a dreamy, magical castle and discover all the different painting categories waiting for them. They can proudly display their finished coloring pages on the walls like masterpieces, turning the castle into a magnificent gallery of their artwork.
We designed Colorland to be educational, guiding children through tracing shapes, numbers, and letters—a fun way to build essential early learning skills.
The app features a simple, child-friendly interface, ensuring that even the youngest users can navigate with ease. Watch as your child explores a multitude of tools including brushes, pencils, and wallpapers to bring their creations to life. The vibrant colors, engaging animations, and fun sound effects make every moment spent in the app a joy.
Highlights of Colorland include:
• 7 categories with 144 unique coloring pages
• Tools for painting, drawing, and decorating
• Educational tracing activities for shapes, numbers, and letters
• A bright and intuitive interface
• A gallery to save and showcase artwork
Benefits of using Colorland:
• Encourages creativity and self-expression
• Enhances fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination
• Introduces basic concepts of shapes, numbers, and letters
• Provides a fun and engaging learning experience
With Colorland, your child can explore a magical world of color and creativity while developing important early learning skills. Download now and let the artistic adventure begin!

bluejetty:00083595:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00083595:ios.description:
Simple and effective video editor, which will allow you to edit, combine, trim, and add filters to videos quickly. 
Main features:
- Combine videos: Combine several videos into one to make a montage with several videos. Edit and trim each part of the video to make it your own 
- Trim Videos: If you just need to trim one of your videos, you can also do that quickly and very easily with this app. 
- Filters: Add filters to your videos to add your personalized and original touch. 
- Download and share: Once you finish editing, you can download and share your creation with your friends and family. 
Create your own video projects in just a few taps with an easy and intuitive video merger editor designed for everyday use. Whether you want to merge videos, cut videos, trim clips, or make a quick video compilation, this app gives you simple tools to get the job done fast.
If you need a practical video joiner for multiple videos, this app helps you combine clips in the order you want and create a clean final result without complicated steps. It is ideal for putting together short clips, travel memories, family moments, social media content, or any personal creation you want to save and share.
You can also use it as a video trimmer and video cutter to remove unwanted parts and keep only the moments you really need. If you are looking for apps to edit videos without a difficult learning curve, this app is made to be simple, clear, and effective.
This editing app for videos is a good choice if you want to make a video collage, combine videos from different moments, or create simple collage videos for fun and memories. It can be useful as a video collage maker for casual users who want fast results without advanced editing tools.
Premium features:
- No Watermark Exports: Export your creations without watermark.
- Unlimited Videos When Merging: Add as many clips as you want in a single merge.
- No Ads: Enjoy the app with an ad-free experience.
Privacy Policy: https://www.koruskan.net/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.koruskan.net/terms-of-service/terms-of-service-video-merger.html
