bluejetty:00140244:ios.description:
Sunset Time is the perfect companion for anyone who wants to be in tune with the sun.
• Seeking the ideal lighting for photography? Sunset Time is your answer.
• Planning an early morning or evening hike? Get the perfect timing.
• Want to align your outdoor exercises with the sun? Sunset Time makes it simple.
• Longing for a walk under the sun's comforting rays? It's all planned out.
Whether you're an avid photographer chasing the perfect light, a nature enthusiast seeking harmony with the sun's rhythm, or simply looking for your daily dose of sunlight, Sunset Time is here for you. This app helps you track the sun's movement, ensuring you always have the best light for your activities, making your time outdoors more enjoyable and fulfilling.
**MAJOR FEATURES:
- Sunrise Time
- Sunset Time
- First Light Time
- Last Light Time
- Golden Hour Time
- Blue hour Time
- Calculate Sunrise, Sunset, First and Last light times for any day in the future.
- Handles Daylight Saving times
- Moon phases
Sunset Time Premium
Sunset Time offers a Premium version available as an auto-renewable subscription.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of your selected plan above. 
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings on the device. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Privacy policy: http://sunrise.nicolaeusebi.com/Home/Privacy
Terms of use: http://sunrise.nicolaeusebi.com/Home/Terms

bluejetty:00185878:ios.summary:

Show you have the guts to take high-stakes bets and outbid your competi
bluejetty:00185878:ios.description:
Getting the upper hand in storage auctions is much tougher than TV shows lead us to think. It requires instinct, smarts and lots of courage to beat your rival bidders!
Show you have the guts to take high-stakes bets and outbid your competition in all kinds of auctions, making a name for yourself as the sharpest bidder on the scene!
HIGHLIGHTS
• OUTBID your competition in edge-of-your-seat storage auctions. Enjoy intense gameplay as you choose, analyze and bid faster than your rivals in auctions around the world!
• RUN your own pawn shop and display your rare and valuable acquisitions. Make customers come from all over the world to spend money on your business and make you rich!
• LIVE through a gripping story with engaging characters on your quest to turn your rundown family business into a city-wide business empire!
• PROFIT from your smart deals and unlock new buildings in town to expand your business and make even more money!
• GET KNOWN in the auction world and be noticed by big names on the scene: you never know who might want to do business with you!
• COLLECT a wide range of exotic items, from rare antiques you can restore to cars and boats you can renovate and sell at an epic profit!
Take part in every auction and don’t miss a single opportunity to bid: some of these musty old garages hide treasures beyond your wildest dreams! Try your luck, but never ignore your instincts: they can make or break a bidder’s career!
Become a rising star as you take part in bigger auctions and deal with the good and bad attention you’ll get: some big pawn shop moguls might not like the competition your business represents, and they’ll pull out all the stops to hinder your path! Such problems come with the territory when you get rich and notorious, so be prepared to deal with it!
Start your pawn empire now and get ready to bid!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Chess Score Pad replaces paper scoresheets with a clean, distraction-free way to r
bluejetty:00063116:ios.description:
Chess Score Pad
A modern electronic scoresheet designed for over-the-board tournament play.
Record moves effortlessly and export PGN for post-game analysis.
Chess Score Pad replaces paper scoresheets with a clean, distraction-free way to record your games move by move — so you can focus on playing, not writing.
Designed by a tournament player with hundreds of USCF-rated games, Chess Score Pad is built for over-the-board chess and post-game review.
Record games naturally
• Enter moves by tapping or dragging pieces
• No coordinates to write, no notation to translate
• All moves are saved automatically — no “Save” button required
• Easy move correction if a mistake happens
Review positions and games
• Step through moves one at a time
• Scrub through the game with a live position slider
• On iPad, view the board and notation side by side
• Quickly return to critical positions after the game
Export and share
• Export games as PGN for analysis in your chess database
• Share via AirDrop, Mail, Messages, Files, Notes, Clipboard, and compatible chess apps
• Export a professional PDF scoresheet with a position diagram
Built for tournament play
• Start recording immediately — game details are optional
• “Next Game of Event” copies event info and increments the round
• Automatically place your pieces at the bottom of the board
• Optional legal-move and position checking
• Optional move-time tracking
Flexible notation
• Long or short algebraic notation
• Figurine or standard notation
Important note
Chess Score Pad is an electronic scoresheet and does not provide analysis or engine assistance.
Chess Score Pad is not currently certified for tournament use.
It may be permitted at the discretion of the tournament director.
More screenshots and documentation are available at the Support URL.

1. Inclusive Artwork: Dive into a stunning collection of artwork featuring diverse characters and scenes celebrating the beauty of Black culture and heritage.
2. Endless Creativity: Unleash your imagination with a wide range of coloring tools and a palette bursting with colors. From bold and bright hues to subtle shades, the possibilities are endless!

At Black Color, we believe in the power of representation and inclusivity. Our mission is to celebrate Black culture and promote positive representation through art and creativity. bluejetty:00151970:ios.summary:
Fresh look, elastic skin and chiseled chin - all of these you'll have without spending money on face injections. The youthful glow of health can be yours with just daily gymnastics for your facial muscles!
Face Yoga – Facial exercises is t
bluejetty:00151970:ios.description:
Fresh look, elastic skin and chiseled chin - all of these you'll have without spending money on face injections. The youthful glow of health can be yours with just daily gymnastics for your facial muscles!
Face Yoga – Facial exercises is the most effective anti-aging tool to help improve facial muscle tone. Face exercises prevent wrinkles by increasing the blood circulation. Face yoga is based on the principle that facial muscles are trainable, just like body muscles. If you don't train your body muscles, they become weak and flabby, and the same thing happens to your facial muscles as you age.
WHAT BENEFITS ARE THERE TO DOING FACIAL EXERCISES?
A young, beautiful face is not only good skin without wrinkles. The youthfulness is evidenced by chiseled cheekbones, a beautiful chin line, and the absence of nasolabial "creases". Strengthening the muscles will widen the eyes, lift the cheeks and corners of the lips, and strengthen the chin line, while accelerated blood circulation will make the skin firmer and tighter. In addition, by putting weak and sagging muscles back in place, you can also get rid of wrinkles and prevent them from appearing in the future.
The benefits of doing facial exercises or yoga for the face go beyond just making you look younger. Facial toning can also help with reducing wrinkles, firming muscles in different areas on your body (such as neck area), improving eye strain relief and confidence! Facial workouts are an excellent way not only to get rid of inches from sagging skin but also control what's happening underneath that soften over time - which could lead up towards serious health conditions.
ALL YOU NEED TO START FACE BUILDING, YOU CAN FIND IN OUR APP FACE YOGA – FACIAL EXERCISES:
- different programs of the face yoga;
- video guide explaining the right technique of each face exercise;
- every day a new step of face workout to achieve the goal.
There are many reasons why people would be interested in practicing face exercises. Some say that it's just good common sense, while others claim their classes provide an alternative cost-effective solution for those who can't afford expensive cosmetic surgery or costly injections of botox into the face skin. In recent years there has been a growing trend among yoga practitioners towards doing "facial workout" which includes various types. Face Yoga is one such example where you work out different muscle groups throughout this area using moves like touching fingertips together at nose level then moving them apart slowly until arm movement ceases completely.
The beauty benefits of face yoga are endless. It can help you get a younger appearance and reduce signs of ageing, like wrinkles! Face Yoga – Facial exercises will make you look younger so do them every day!

bluejetty:00139688:ios.name: AI Calorie Tracker by Calorix
bluejetty:00139688:ios.summary: Calorix is the AI calorie tracker that makes logging easy, and even a little fun. Snap your plate, say what you ate or scan a barcode, and Calorix estimates the calories, protein and macros for you. Toasty, a cute living flame, cheers you o
bluejetty:00139688:ios.description:
Calorix is the AI calorie tracker that makes logging easy, and even a little fun. Snap your plate, say what you ate or scan a barcode, and Calorix estimates the calories, protein and macros for you. Toasty, a cute living flame, cheers you on every step of the way.
LOG IT YOUR WAY
• Photo: snap your meal and AI picks out each food and estimates the portion
• Voice or text: "Two eggs, toast and a latte" is all it takes
• Barcode scanner and nutrition label scanning for packaged food
• Food search and manual entry when you know the numbers
FIX WITH AI
• Not quite right? Say or type the change ("half the fries, no dressing, add bacon") or add another photo
• Smart one-tap suggestions for each meal, like "cooked in oil" or "smaller portion"
• Adjust any ingredient or portion yourself, anytime
TRACK WHAT MATTERS
• Calories, protein, carbs and fat, with daily goals built from your profile
• Water tracking with a daily goal
• Weight trend with progress charts and medals
• Apple Health brings in your burned calories and your weight
INTERMITTENT FASTING
• A fasting timer that shows your body's stages, as estimates with sources
• 12:12, 14:10 and 16:8 plans for free; 18:6, 20:4, OMAD and custom fasts with Pro
MEAL PLANS
• A weekly meal plan that fits your goal, your diet and your allergies
• One grocery list for the whole week
• With Pro, AI writes your plan for you
MEET TOASTY
Toasty is a little living flame who reacts to your day. Log your meals, drink your water and keep your streak going, and he cheers you on. Daily and weekly challenges earn coins to spend in the shop on outfits for him. Coins are earned, never sold. And Toasty never comments on your body or calls a food bad.
WHEREVER YOU ARE
• Home Screen widgets
• Live Activities on your Lock Screen for your fast and for a streak at risk
• Apple Watch: calories left, water, your fast and voice logging, right on your wrist
• Available in 46 languages, on iOS 17 or later
BUILT ON SOURCES
• Calorix never sets a daily target below 1,200 kcal for women or 1,500 kcal for men
• Every health number is sourced in the app: Profile › Sources and method
Calorix gives estimates, not medical advice.
FREE AND PRO
The free version includes AI scans every day (photo, voice, text, label, Fix with AI and meal ideas share them). Barcode scans, food search, manual logging, water, weight, the 12:12, 14:10 and 16:8 fasts and Toasty are unlimited.
Calorix Pro unlocks unlimited AI scans (fair use), every fasting plan and weekly meal plans written by AI. Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, weekly, monthly or yearly, with a free trial where offered. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://calorix.ai/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://calorix.ai/privacy/
Support: https://calorix.ai/support/

Arrange 52 cards into 4 foundation piles (Ace to King, per suit) across 7 tableau columns.

Too many customization options: card backs, faces, and table designs.
Smart tools: Auto-complete, Hints, and Unlimited Undos.

bluejetty:00145349:ios.name: VR Matkalla
bluejetty:00145349:ios.summary:
The VR Matkalla app is a travel companion that can help you at every stage of your journey.
START TRAVELLING
The VR Matkalla app is the best way to buy tickets for VR’s commuter and long-distance trains. The app offers single tickets, mul
bluejetty:00145349:ios.description:
The VR Matkalla app is a travel companion that can help you at every stage of your journey.
START TRAVELLING
The VR Matkalla app is the best way to buy tickets for VR’s commuter and long-distance trains. The app offers single tickets, multi-tickets and season tickets for regular travellers, as well as corporate tickets for business travellers. Starting or continuing your journey in the capital region and in many other cities around Finland is easy! You can buy single tickets from HSL and other local transport operators for your journey to and from the train station.
We will send your ticket to both the app and your email. You can pay for your journey using internet banking, a payment card and MobilePay, or with employee benefits like Epassi, Smartum and Edenred. If you have bought your tickets as a logged-in customer, you can always find the tickets you have bought in your own VR account, in the app and at vr.fi. This means that you can buy your ticket on your computer at home or in the app and travel with that same ticket on your phone.
WHERE WOULD YOU LIKE TO SIT? 
When buy a ticket, you can conveniently reserve a seat using the coach map. You can also buy the seat next to you and enjoy the extra space. If you want to add a touch of luxury to your journey, you can travel in Ekstra Calm Class, where you can enjoy the peace and quiet, or in Ekstra Relaxed, which offers the best view. In Ekstra Classes, the ticket price includes hot drinks and spring water. When buying your ticket, you can also buy a ticket for your travel companion, bicycle or pet. 
PLANS CAN CHANGE
Sometimes things don’t go as planned. In the VR Matkalla app, you can also make changes after buying the ticket. You can conveniently change your seat and the departure time of your journey as self-service, or upgrade your seat to Ekstra Class after the purchase. If needed, the change can be made to the tickets of the whole travel party. If you’ve bought cancellation insurance, you can also cancel your journey in the app for free if plans change.
WHERE ARE WE AT?
With the On-Track section of the VR Matkalla app, you will get real-time updates about your journey, so you will always know what is happening. When you allow push notifications related to your journey, you will be informed about things like your train’s departure, the movement of the train, changed timetables, transfers and your train’s arrival. You can also view your train’s services and accessibility information in the app. If we have to cancel your train journey, we will suggest new journeys in the app for you to choose from.
ENJOY YOUR JOURNEY
You can order delicious meals to your seat in the app during the journey. You can also pre-order a coffee and pick it up at the checkout of the restaurant car without queuing.
YOU WILL ALWAYS KNOW YOUR BENEFITS
For those who download the app, we offer tasty benefits that you can use in the train’s restaurant car. In addition, we will also tell you about changing benefits that will make your journey even more better. You can find our tips and benefits in the Messages section of the VR Matkalla app.
You can check the carbon footprint of the journeys you’ve taken in the past 12 months in the app. Did you know that the carbon dioxide emissions of a train are 98% lower than those of a car? On the train, you always travel in an environmentally friendly manner. 
Join us on our journey and download the VR Matkalla app today!

Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”
Games: Users can enjoy a variety of games served in app. Games include: Sudoku, Solitaire, Jumble, Crossword, and Puzzles

bluejetty:00088590:ios.description:
The EOH Workforce App gives casual on-hire staff an easy way to manage shifts, timesheets, and availability, anytime, anywhere. Designed for workers employed through Australia’s leading staffing agencies, our app helps you stay organised and in control of your career, whether you prefer to pick up a shift here and there, or work full-time.
Real-Time Shift Management
Check your upcoming shift details, get GPS directions, add to your calendar, and view your pay rate, all in one place.
Flexible Availability Updates
Update your daily availability or preferences instantly, so you only get offered shifts that suit your lifestyle. Add notes to help your agency match you better.
Tailored Shift Offers
Get notified of shifts that match your availability, location settings and qualifications. No need to filter through hundreds of unsuitable shifts to find your next job.
Fast & Flexible Timesheets
Submit timesheets digitally or upload your paper version. Add travel claims, track disputes, and ensure accurate, on-time payments.
Crucial Employment Details at Your Fingertips
Update certifications, bank or super details, view payslips, and keep everything directly through the app.
The EOH Workforce App is designed to make it easier to manage your shifts and timesheets, without playing phone tag with your agency. For any issues or questions about the app, please contact your agency.

bluejetty:00131840:ios.name: AudioTools, dB, Sound & Audio
bluejetty:00131840:ios.summary: AudioTools from Studio Six Digital is a suite of professional-grade audio and acoustic analysis apps. Included in the price of this app is a great collection of professional tools -- SPL, RTA, FFT, Speaker Polarity Test, Generator, Audio Sc
bluejetty:00131840:ios.description:
AudioTools from Studio Six Digital is a suite of professional-grade audio and acoustic analysis apps. Included in the price of this app is a great collection of professional tools -- SPL, RTA, FFT, Speaker Polarity Test, Generator, Audio Scope, CLF Viewer, and Recorder, and the framework to add more powerful modules as you need them.
Customize AudioTools for your needs by buying any of the additional optional modules, like Smaart Tools I, SPL Graph, or Impulse Response, at any time right from your iOS device.
We test every iOS device and calibrate the microphone level and frequency response for the best results. We have the ability to turn off the Apple low frequency filters, and on many devices we can measure up to 120 dB SPL.
Add iTestMic, iPrecisionMic, or iAudioInterface2 for a complete professional audio and acoustic test and measurement platform.
Actual reviews:
“...AudioTools is a “how did I ever live without it” app”.
“I think this application is the best I EVER purchased.”
“I have used many thousands of dollars of complicated test equipment that doesn’t measure up to this app suite.”
***** Included in the app price *****
* SPL Meter
A faithful reproduction of a classic analog SPL meter. Includes A and C weighting, and Fast and Slow ANSI decay modes. All filters meet or exceed ANSI type 1.
* RTA
A 1/3 and octave band Real Time Analyzer. Includes touch-GUI range control, a cursor, max/min bars, and noise curve overlays. 
* FFT
Detailed acoustic analysis, up to 32876 points. View full detail or smooth to 1/24, 1/6, 1/3 or octave. Includes cursor, scalable graphics, and peak tracking.
* Polarity
Speaker polarity checker. Route the test signal to a speaker, and read the polarity of the speaker on the screen.
* CLF Viewer
Show loudspeaker data, including plots for impedance, axial response, sensitivity, polar response, and 6dB coverage, and a 3D color balloon plot. 
* Delay Finder
Measures the time it takes for a pulse to return from a speaker. 
* Generator
Generates sine waves, square waves, white and pink noise.
* Line Level Tests
A line level measurement function and frequency counter.
* Audio Scope
A dual-channel audio oscilloscope that includes auto-triggering, variable gain and sweep rate, and storage of scope images.
* Recorder
A mono/stereo audio recorder with WAV and compressed formats and 8k-48k sample rate. Transfer files via WIFI.
* File transfer of results via wifi to PC / Mac.
* Audio Calculators
***** Optional modules available for purchase from within AudioTools *****
* SoundScope VR - FFT-based audio analyzer with VR.
The powerful acoustical analysis module. Includes RTA graphs to 1/48th octave and Spectrograph, and can display VR.
* Transfer Function -- Requires 2-channel interface. 
Two-channel FFT-based measurement. Allows you to analyze sound system performance with music or pink noise as the signal source.
* ETC
Energy Time Curve. Plot decay of an impulse over time, and compute RT60 time. Internal or External trigger.
* Impulse Response
Record and analyze an impulse or sine sweep, compute octave and 1/3 octave ETC, T30, C50, C80, CT, Definition.
* LARSA
Fast and accurate sine-sweep measurement of loudspeakers and rooms.
* SPL Pro
Digital SPL meter with ANSI Slow, Fast, Peak, and Impulse mode, along with LEQ. Includes A and C weighting, and all 10 octave band filters.
* SPL Graph
Plot second-by-second SPL level for up to 24 hours, and optionally record the audio. Also, add the optional Octave Band Logging upgrade to elevate this tool to rival any professional logging SPL Meter.
* SPL Traffic Light
Monitor live sound levels SPL and Leq and see status in a simple green-yellow-red display.
* STIPA Speech Intelligibility
Meets the current NFPA code standards for testing evac systems and schools.
* Speaker Distortion
Measure THD+n of any driver.
* THD+n (requires iAudioInterface)
* Impedance Meter and Plot (requires iAudioInterface)
* Phase Meter
* Amplitude Sweep

bluejetty:00175327:ios.description:

“Walter” is the machine learning algorithm that powers the WalterPicks app. Trained on millions of data points, thousands of real fantasy leagues, and lines from dozens sportsbooks. But we don't just rely on a black box "algorithm" we also have several expert analysts that help update our projections daily to give us the most accurate predictions possible. 
PLAYER PROP EVALUATOR --
Start winning your parlays. Walter scans lines from dozens of books in real time to identify positive expected value ( +EV ) player props on FanDuel, DraftKings, PrizePicks, Underdog, and all other major platforms. 
LEAGUE SYNC -- 
Sync your ESPN Fantasy, Yahoo Fantasy, Sleeper Fantasy, CBS Fantasy, and Underdog Fantasy football leagues directly to the WalterPicks app to get Walter’s insights custom to your exact league settings. OR easily input your league settings with Manual Mode. 
TRADE ANALYZER AND TRADE FINDER --
Easily analyze fantasy trades and never get fleeced again. Identify realistic trades that will level-up your team.
START / SIT COMPARISONS -- 
Compare players each week based on the most predictive metrics using a range of outcomes approach custom to your league settings.
WEEKLY ADVICE -- 
New waiver wire and transactions advice each week on which players you should add, drop, trade for, or trade away. 
REST OF SEASON RANKINGS -- 
Always up-to-date, zero-bias rankings based on fantasy performance, machine learning predictions, and our team of expert analysts.
ADVANCED RESEARCH --
Easily compare game matchups and advanced player stats for NFL, NBA, NHL, and MLB.
LIVE DRAFT TOOL -- 
Get real-time, pick-by-pick insights during your LIVE fantasy draft based on what your team needs. Now supporting Dynasty, Auction, Keeper, Superflex, and Best Ball formats!
+ SO MUCH MORE

bluejetty:00064331:ios.name: Chromecast TV Streamer #1
bluejetty:00064331:ios.summary: Watch web-videos, online-movies, livestreams and live-tv shows and your personal photos, videos & music by using Google Cast on your TCL TV, Sony TV, Hisense TV, Vizio SmartCast TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Toshiba TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player
bluejetty:00064331:ios.description:
Watch web-videos, online-movies, livestreams and live-tv shows and your personal photos, videos & music by using Google Cast on your TCL TV, Sony TV, Hisense TV, Vizio SmartCast TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Toshiba TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player or Nvidia Shield gaming console. Enjoy the show on your big screen. 
With Video & TV Cast you can browse through the web and stream any online video on your Google Cast enabled device (movies, tv shows, sports, music and more). Just navigate to your favorite website and send the embedded video with a single tap to your TV or gaming console. The discovered video will be shown below the browser. A tap on the video link will send it to your Google Cast enabled device immediately. Streaming personal media from your device is also supported.
* The app only works with devices with Google Cast or Chromecast built-in, like Vizio TV, Toshiba TV, Sony TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player, Nvidia Shield gaming console
* iTunes movies, Flash video and DRM protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO now are not supported!
* Please test your favorite videos with the free edition before upgrading!
* The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). 
* Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. 
* If a specific video does not cast, please check our FAQ. If that does not help, please give us a chance to help you by dropping a mail to info@video-tv-cast.com instead of leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for your video as soon as possible.
>>> UPGRADE FEATURES (available as in-app purchases)
* Premium Edition: Unlocks all of the features listed here. Also future features are included, so you do not have to pay for them when they are released in an updated app version. 
* Remote Playbar: A remote control that allows you to fast forward or rewind videos while browsing. It syncs across all your iPads & iPhones that are connected to the same Chromecast. So your video can be controlled by different users in the same room.
* Personal Media: Cast unlimited personal photos, videos and music directly from your device or from cloud services like iCloud and Dropbox. 
* Ad-Blocker: Blocks ads & popups on most websites and removes the sponsoring ads from the app. You can update and enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings. 
* Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud.
* Subtitles: Display subtitles & closed captions on TV.
* Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings.
>>> A MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPERS
We want to say thank you for all your great support and kindly invite you to honestly rate our app. This helps us to keep up our app development and support for you. Please do not trust other apps that ask you for 5-star ratings in exchange for premium upgrades. This is against good developer ethics and also against Apple guidelines.
If you have any feedback, feature requests or other request, please notify us at info@video-tv-cast.com
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Google, Sony, Philips, Vizio, Sharp, Asus, Nvidia or one of their products and trademarks.

bluejetty:00163786:ios.summary: TELUS SmartHome is your simple all-in-one security, safety and smart home solution. Protect, automate and monitor your home in real-time from anywhere in the world, from any current mobile device. All you need is internet or mobile service,
bluejetty:00163786:ios.description:
TELUS SmartHome is your simple all-in-one security, safety and smart home solution. Protect, automate and monitor your home in real-time from anywhere in the world, from any current mobile device. All you need is internet or mobile service, a TELUS SmartHome Security service plan and the smart devices you wish to install at home.
The TELUS Security app offers solutions for:
· Security and safety alerts
· Interactive video monitoring
· Energy efficiency management
· Home automation
Optimize your home from wherever you are. Just tap your app, and you’ll have real time access to what’s happening at home. View your video screens or clips, change and control settings and make your home the safest and smartest it can be.
Whether you’re down the block or halfway around the world, still in bed or halfway through a busy day, TELUS SmartHome Security has you covered. The TELUS Security app can send you notifications, you can instantly view your front door or living room, make and change rules to maximize energy efficiency or improve comfort, and have direct access to every security and smart home device you’ve installed.
Simple icons and easy-to-follow screens give you remote access and control. Guide a slider to dim a light, tap to chat with someone at your front door, or pre-program an early morning warm up of the house before you even open your eyes.
Note: This TELUS Security app requires a compatible system, internet access and a TELUS SmartHome Security service plan. The app features and their usage varies based on the solution chosen, equipment and service plan. Visit telus.com/home-security for more information.
With the TELUS Security app, you can:
· Receive real-time emails, text messages and push notifications for unexpected activity and events that matter to you
· View your property from installed video cameras
· Watch live and recorded video clips from your security cameras
· Pre-program or turn lights on or off
· Set the ideal temperature on your smart thermostat
· Search your complete event history
· View and speak remotely to a visitor at your front door
How the TELUS Security app helps you stay connected to home:
· Know instantly when your kids are home from school
· Arm your system and lock up from anywhere or automatically as you leave the house
· Know when service people arrive or leave
· Be alerted when the garage door is left open
· Receive a notification your medicine or liquor cabinet has been opened
· Know if someone changes your thermostat settings
· Be alerted if someone attempts to log on to your account
· And much more!

WHAT YOU CAN BOOK

bluejetty:00021722:ios.description:
Flymya is a Myanmar online travel agency. Book domestic and international flights, hotels, bus tickets, hot air balloon rides in Bagan, private cars with drivers, and tour packages, in one app.
WHAT YOU CAN BOOK
Flights: Compare domestic flights across Myanmar with Myanmar Airways International (MAI), Mingalar (formerly Air KBZ), Myanmar National Airlines (MNA), Mann Yadanarpon and Air Thanlwin. Fly between Yangon, Mandalay, Nyaung U (Bagan), Taunggyi, Heho (Inle Lake) and other cities. Book international flights with Singapore Airlines, Emirates, Thai Airways, AirAsia and Malaysia Airlines.
Hotels: Choose from over 200 hotels across Myanmar, in Yangon, Mandalay, Bagan, Inle Lake and Ngapali. Book international hotels worldwide. Long-stay serviced apartments in Yangon are available for stays of one month or more.
Bus tickets: Compare over 100 Myanmar long-distance operators across more than 100 routes. Choose VIP, sleeper and air-conditioned coaches, and pick your exact seat from the live seat plan.
Hot air balloon rides in Bagan: Reserve a sunrise flight over the temple plain with Balloon over Bagan, STT Ballooning, Oriental Ballooning or Golden Eagle Balloon. The season runs from October to April.
Private cars with drivers: Arrange airport transfers, day trips and multi-day journeys across Yangon, Mandalay, Nay Pyi Taw, Bago, the Delta Region, Southern Shan State and the Tanintharyi Region. Every booking includes a professional driver.
Tour packages: Book private tour packages inside Myanmar and abroad, to Thailand, Vietnam, China and India. Every itinerary can be customised around your dates, pace and budget.
HOW YOU PAY
Choose from 29 payment methods. Pay with Myanmar mobile wallets including KBZPay, Wave Pay and AYAPay. Pay with local MPU cards, or with international Visa and Mastercard. Pay cash at 123, NearMe and TrueMoney agents.
Your e-ticket or confirmation arrives by email or SMS after payment.
WHY TRAVELLERS CHOOSE FLYMYA
Flymya has arranged travel in Myanmar since 2015. Flymya is an IATA-accredited travel agent, code 05300013. Flymya is a PATA member and a PATA Gold Award 2025 winner.
Customer support answers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, on +95 9 880 441 011. Visit us in person at our offices in Yangon and Mandalay, or at Junction City, Myanmar Plaza and Hledan Centre in Yangon, and City Square in Taunggyi.
Travel is easy with us.

bluejetty:00097898:ios.description:
Browse 800,000+ luxury homes for sale worldwide. Villas, penthouses, castles, and estates in 140+ countries. Curated for buyers from $500K to $100M+.
JamesEdition is the world's leading marketplace for luxury real estate. From a Cape Town ocean villa to a Mayfair townhouse, an Aspen ski chalet to a Tuscan estate, a Monaco penthouse to a Mallorca finca — get direct access to listings from 150,000+ verified luxury agents worldwide.
KEY FEATURES
— Browse every type of luxury property: villa, mansion, penthouse, castle, chalet, apartment, bungalow, townhouse, and signature estate listings for sale across the world's most desirable destinations
— Filter by exclusive property categories: beachfront villas, ski chalets, golf estates, vineyard properties, equestrian estates, historic mansions, private compounds, and private islands
— High-resolution photography, immersive virtual tours, and walkthrough videos for every listing
— Real-time alerts on new properties matching your saved search
— Personalized recommendations based on your activity
— Save favorites, schedule private viewings, and contact top brokers directly through the app
WHO USES JAMESEDITION
JamesEdition is the trusted choice for sophisticated buyers across every category of luxury real estate:
— Trophy estates and private compounds for ultra-high-net-worth families
— Signature city penthouses in Manhattan, Mayfair, Monaco, Singapore, and Hong Kong
— Beachfront villas in St. Barts, Mallorca, Phuket, the Maldives, and the Caribbean
— Castles, historic mansions, and country estates in the Cotswolds, the Loire Valley, Tuscany, and Bavaria
— Equestrian estates and vineyard properties in Tuscany, Provence, Napa Valley, and the Hamptons
— Ski chalets in Aspen, Telluride, Verbier, St. Moritz, Courchevel, and Zermatt
— Oceanfront homes and bungalow retreats in Bali, Mauritius, the Bahamas, and Cape Town
HOW JAMESEDITION IS DIFFERENT
JamesEdition is built exclusively for the luxury segment — properties starting from $500K and reaching beyond $100M. Every listing is reviewed before publication. No clutter, no compromise.
We aggregate luxury inventory from 150,000+ verified agencies and brokerages worldwide rather than US-only MLS data. If you're searching for a Cap Ferrat villa, a Lake Como estate, or a Côte d'Azur penthouse, JamesEdition is the single source.
BEYOND REAL ESTATE
JamesEdition is also the trusted destination for superyachts, private jets, exotic and classic cars, fine watches, and other extraordinary luxury goods.
Trusted by buyers across 140+ countries — primary residences, vacation homes, investment properties, and trophy estates.
Download today and discover the world's finest properties for sale.
Questions? Contact us at support@jamesedition.com

bluejetty:00156539:ios.description:
Huddle | Your Hub for Health Records
Healthcare is a team effort.
Many of us help manage care for others – our children, our parents, our grandparents, or those close to us - as well as ourselves.
Unfortunately, keeping up with medical information for you and everyone you’re responsible for can be difficult.
Huddle makes managing care easier by gathering and storing health information for you and those you care for.
Huddle simplifies medical records: for both caregivers and patients.
For Caregivers: When caring for others, keeping up with their latest medications and conditions can be nearly impossible. Huddle gives you the info you need to give them the best care.
For Patients: It’s challenging to remember all your health information. With Huddle, your medical data, contacts, and patient portal are right at your fingertips.
You can store all sorts of medical info in Huddle including:
• Lists of medications
• Doctors’ contact details
• Medical documents
• Links to patient portals
• Test results
• Insurance information
• And more!
Huddle even allows you to share information with other caregivers (such as family members or hired caretakers).
With Huddle, it’s your data, your rules. Your data is only seen by those you authorize to see it, for as long as you want them to see it.
We care about security as much as you do. That’s why we’ve taken every precaution to make sure your important health information stays safe.
Huddle is powered by DrFirst, a pioneer in care collaboration technology, whose innovations have transformed the way healthcare organizations use patient data.
Huddle builds on DrFirst’s 20-year legacy, giving patients a secure way to store and share their own health records.
Health records don’t have to be a hassle. Get Huddle to get control of your medical information.

bluejetty:00074620:ios.summary:

That's where What's Due
bluejetty:00074620:ios.description:
Tired of using spreadsheets for tracking your bills? Or maybe you have all of your bills in a to-do app that's not designed for bill tracking... Do you sometimes forget that a bill is due until it's already overdue?
That's where What's Due comes in! Never forget about your upcoming bills again with this easy-to-use app.
Some of the top features:
- Projected Occurrences: Show the next occurrence only... Or turn on the 'Include Projections' filter to include projections up to a year out.
- Income & Bills: Add all your income and bills to track everything in one place.
- Pay Periods: Group upcoming bills by pay period instead of by month, so you can see what each paycheck needs to cover.
- Calendar: See your month at a glance — a month grid marking the days income and bills are due, with each day's list one tap away.
- Charts (premium): Visualize your bills and income with category, account, and trend charts — including your on-time payment rate and year-over-year comparisons.
- Search: Quickly find any income or bill with the dedicated Search tab.
- Widgets (premium): Add widgets to your Home Screen to see and update your bills without opening the app.
- Unlimited Bills (premium): Track all your bills (premium feature) or up to 5 upcoming bills at a time without upgrading.
- Bill Reminders: Never forget to pay a bill with bill reminder notifications.
- iCloud Sync: Automatically syncs with your iCloud, so you can start on your iPhone and continue on your iPad, Mac, or Apple Vision Pro.
- Quick Actions: Swipe right to mark as paid or scheduled (paid, but hasn't cleared your bank yet) and left to delete an income/bill. Long pressing a bill with a 'Bill Pay URL' added will allow you to quickly pay online.
- Import/Export CSV (premium): Import your bills from a CSV file. Or export them to save outside the app.
- Biometrics: Hide your bills from prying eyes by locking them behind biometrics.
- Alternate App Icons: Personalize your app with alternate icon options.
- Accent Colors (premium): Set your favorite accent color to be used throughout the app.
- Multilingual: Use What's Due in English, Spanish (español), French (français), Italian (italiano), Portuguese (português), or German (Deutsch).
With an upgrade to Premium, you get:
- Widgets
- Charts
- Unlimited Income/Bills
- Import/Export CSV
- Accent Colors
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00061202:ios.name: EWA: Learn Languages
bluejetty:00061202:ios.summary: Learn English, Spanish, or French with EWA! Read books with real time translations, discover unknown words with a tap of your finger, complete speaking courses with your favorite TV characters, and learn new words with flashcards - all for
bluejetty:00061202:ios.description:
Learn English, Spanish, or French with EWA! Read books with real time translations, discover unknown words with a tap of your finger, complete speaking courses with your favorite TV characters, and learn new words with flashcards - all for free in our app! Improve your existing skills today!
EWA is a personalized English, Spanish, or French tutor that fits in your pocket. Every user can decide for themselves how they would like to learn a language - at what level and at what pace:
1. More than 10,000 English, Spanish, or French books with audio are available for you to sharpen your reading, writing, and grammar skills. Choose a book that matches your current language level and start expanding your skills right away! Unknown word? Simply tap it to translate it, add it to your “to-learn” list, and memorize it forever!
2. Spoken video-courses with popular movie scenes and TV show characters is what our users love the most about EWA! It’s fun, interesting, and an innovative way to improve pronunciation and achieve language proficiency. The courses include a variety of topics, levels and time frames - so, regardless of your current skills, your language abilities will only benefit from EWA!
3. Speaking Topics
Don't know what to say at passport control, how to ask for directions, or how to order food at a café? Read and listen to dialogues on everyday topics that will help you on every journey. With these dialogues, you'll easily improve your conversational English by applying what you've learned in real life!
4. All you need is a spare 5 minutes a day to learn English, Spanish, or French. More than 40,000 flashcards are available for you to choose from. Pick the words you want to learn and memorize them using the spaced repetition study method. Feeling excited about your progress? Compete on score charts, compare your results to thousands of other people, and get to the top-ranked spot!
5. The games section is now available in EWA.
A unique teaching methodology compromised of cognitive training exercises and easy-to-learn brain games will help you sharpen your language skills in a very fun and exciting way.
Our games aren’t time-wasters; they’re actually great mental stimulators!
Play, have fun, and most importantly, learn a new language in no time!
No more cramming, stress, and angry teachers! With EWA, you’ll learn the language whenever and wherever - at your own pace. You’ll improve your English, Spanish, or French and experience the beauty of knowing another language - from freedom while traveling to higher paying jobs.
Any feedback would be greatly appreciated! If you have any concerns, recommendations, or complaints just drop us a line at support@appewa.com and we’ll work towards making EWA better!
==================
PLEASE NOTE:
You will need an EWA subscription in order to access all courses and features. Courses available may vary depending your device’s language.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at ‘confirmation of purchase’
• Your account will be charged for a subscription renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period and will identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
==================
Start now and experience a new way of learning English, Spanish, or French.
Expanding your vocabulary has never been easier.

bluejetty:00168270:ios.description:
Don't put up with bad matches and missing tracks - use the tool that gives you control over your playlist transfers.
Important: You'll need a Spotify account - either free or premium - to use "Playlisty for Spotify".
Features:
• Copy your entire Apple Music library to Spotify in just a few taps
• Fast & accurate: uses advanced search strategies to find the RIGHT Spotify tracks
• NO SUBSCRIPTION – just a small one-off fee to unlock “Pro” features¹
• Lets you preview & amend matched playlists before saving results to Spotify
• Unique "direct play" feature² - browse and play playlists without having to save them
• Copy your library playlists, including your liked songs, from services such as YouTube
• Use Siri Shortcuts to automatically sync playlists in the background
• Discover new curators, artists & genres on some of the world's best music sites
• Paste web links from Apple Music into Playlisty to get the Spotify equivalent
• Import or copy/paste playlists from hundreds of different file formats & web-pages
¹ The free version of Playlisty allows you to import an unlimited number of playlists, but playlists from certain sources (e.g. Apple Music & YouTube) are capped at 20 tracks. Our low-cost "Pro" upgrade unlocks playlists of unlimited length regardless of source.
² Note: Not all features are available on Spotify "free" accounts.
Please note that Playlisty for Spotify transfers playlists *into* Spotify, not out. If you are looking to transfer playlists from Spotify to Apple Music please look at our other app: Playlisty for Apple Music (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/playlisty-for-apple-music/id1459275972) which goes the other way.

bluejetty:00069500:ios.name: Wag Buddy: Dog Friendly Places
bluejetty:00069500:ios.summary:
Meet Wag Buddy—the social app built for dogs and the people who love them.
Create a profile for your pup, share memorable moments, connect with fellow dog lovers, discover nearby playmates, and explore dog-friendly places and activities. F
bluejetty:00069500:ios.description:
Meet Wag Buddy—the social app built for dogs and the people who love them.
Create a profile for your pup, share memorable moments, connect with fellow dog lovers, discover nearby playmates, and explore dog-friendly places and activities. From arranging park meetups to planning your next dog-friendly adventure, Wag Buddy helps make life with your pup more social, convenient, and fun.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH WAG BUDDY
CONNECT WITH DOG LOVERS
Share your dog’s adventures through a pup-focused social feed. Post photos and updates, follow friends, discover other dogs in your community, and keep up with your favourite furry personalities.
TAKE PART IN FUN CHALLENGES
Enter dog-themed challenges, show off your pup’s cutest outfits or best moves, vote for your favourites, earn points, unlock badges, and compete for prizes and rewards.
FIND DOG PARKS, TRAILS, AND BEACHES
Use the interactive map to discover dog parks, walking trails, beaches, and other places to explore with your pup. View helpful details such as fencing and water availability before you visit.
SEE WHO’S AT THE PARK
Real-time check-ins let you see which furry friends are currently at the park. You can also receive notifications when your dog’s friends check in, making spontaneous playdates easier.
DISCOVER DOG-FRIENDLY PLACES AND SERVICES
Find dog-friendly hotels, cafés, restaurants, groomers, daycares, and more—whether you’re exploring your neighbourhood or travelling with your pup.
FIND THE PERFECT PLAYMATE
Browse dog profiles and find potential playmates based on factors such as breed, size, and personality. Send friend requests, make new connections, and arrange playdates with other dog parents.
SEARCH WITH HELPFUL FILTERS
Looking for a fenced off-leash park or a restaurant with a dog-friendly patio? Use filters to quickly find places that suit you and your pup.
DISCOVER AND CREATE EVENTS
Find local dog-friendly events, activities, meetups, and get-togethers. You can also create your own event and invite other Wag Buddy members to join.
HELP BRING MISSING DOGS HOME
Create and share a missing-dog alert with nearby Wag Buddy users so the community can help reunite lost dogs with their families.
SHARE DOG-FRIENDLY DISCOVERIES
Found a hidden gem? Add dog-friendly places and services to Wag Buddy and help other dog parents discover somewhere new.
Whether you’re looking for new friends, a nearby park, a dog-friendly hotel, or your pup’s next adventure, Wag Buddy brings everything together in one welcoming community.
Download Wag Buddy and start exploring with your best friend today!

bluejetty:00065063:ios.name: Lyon County State Bank Mobile
bluejetty:00065063:ios.summary: The Lyon County State Bank Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view
bluejetty:00065063:ios.description:
The Lyon County State Bank Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Lyon County State Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use theLyon County State Bank Mobile App, you must be enrolled as an Lyon County State Bank internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00065891:ios.name: Cờ Tướng - Cờ Thế, Cờ Úp
bluejetty:00065891:ios.summary:
Cờ tướng đầy đủ trong một ứng dụng gọn: đấu với máy, chơi cùng bạn bè, và 1058 thế cờ xếp thành một hành trình qua các thành cổ Việt Nam.
CHƠI VỚI BẠN QUA MẠNG
Một người bấm Tạo phòng, hệ thống sinh ra mã 6 số. Gửi mã đó cho bạn mình, ngườ
bluejetty:00065891:ios.description:
Cờ tướng đầy đủ trong một ứng dụng gọn: đấu với máy, chơi cùng bạn bè, và 1058 thế cờ xếp thành một hành trình qua các thành cổ Việt Nam.
CHƠI VỚI BẠN QUA MẠNG
Một người bấm Tạo phòng, hệ thống sinh ra mã 6 số. Gửi mã đó cho bạn mình, người kia nhập vào là hai bên vào chung một bàn. Không cần đăng ký, không cần tài khoản, không cần kết bạn. Chơi được cả cờ tướng lẫn cờ úp.
ĐẤU VỚI MÁY, SÁU CẤP ĐỘ
Từ Tập chơi cho người mới tới Kiện tướng cho người đã quen. Cấp cao nhất đủ mạnh để bạn phải nghĩ. Thắng một cấp thì mở cấp kế tiếp.
CỜ THẾ: ĐƯỜNG ĐẾN THĂNG LONG
1058 thế cờ không còn là một danh sách. Chúng xếp thành một con đường đi qua 44 thành cổ Việt Nam, từ Cà Mau ngược lên tới Thăng Long. Giải xong một thế là mở thế kế tiếp; đi hết một chặng là tới một thành mới.
Hai chặng đầu có hướng dẫn từng nước, mũi tên chỉ sẵn -- người chưa từng chơi cờ tướng cũng đi được ngay.
Từ đòn phối hợp cơ bản tới những thế cờ giang hồ nổi tiếng như Bảy sao tụ hội. Có thế mục tiêu là chiếu bí, có thế mục tiêu là cầm hoà. Bí quá thì xem gợi ý nước đầu.
XEM LẠI VÁN ĐÃ ĐẤU
Ba mươi ván gần nhất được lưu lại. Mở ra là bày lại từ thế cờ đầu, đi từng nước tới cuối. Muốn biết lẽ ra nên đi gì thì bấm phân tích: máy vẽ mũi tên ngay trên bàn cờ kèm điểm đánh giá.
CỜ ÚP
Quân xáo trộn và úp xuống, lật ra khi đi. Cùng bàn cờ quen thuộc nhưng ván nào cũng khác. Chơi với máy, với người ngồi cạnh, hoặc với bạn qua mạng.
HAI NGƯỜI MỘT MÁY
Chữ quân bên Đen xoay ngược để người ngồi đối diện đọc thuận.
LUẬT ĐẦY ĐỦ
Chiếu bí, hết nước đi, lặp lại thế cờ, hai bên hết quân tấn công, và luật 60 nước không ăn quân. Ván có điểm dừng rõ ràng chứ không kéo dài vô tận.
THEO DÕI TIẾN BỘ
Số ván, tỉ lệ thắng, chuỗi thắng, số thành cổ đã thăm, thành tích và nhiệm vụ mỗi ngày.
CHỨC NĂNG KHÁC
Hoàn tác nước đi. Xem lại từng nước đã đánh. Thoát giữa chừng vẫn giữ nguyên ván. Chạy hoàn toàn không cần mạng, trừ chế độ Chơi với bạn.

bluejetty:00040965:ios.name: HOPIN - tap for transport
bluejetty:00040965:ios.summary: • The easiest way of getting around is now even easier! Use HOPIN app and order a taxi without dispatch call, buy a parking ticket, order courier service, track public transport vehicles real time, buy bus tickets or see useful timetables.
bluejetty:00040965:ios.description:
• The easiest way of getting around is now even easier! Use HOPIN app and order a taxi without dispatch call, buy a parking ticket, order courier service, track public transport vehicles real time, buy bus tickets or see useful timetables. 
• The most favourite transport app in your city, downloaded by 700 000+ users. 
• TAXI profile
- order a taxi with a simple tap without calling 
- pay by credit card or cash
- see estimate price for your ride
- choose a taxi by your preferences - car list, quiet ride
- if necessary, it is possible to communicate with the driver via the application or the phone
- ride with professional drivers
- ECONOMY ride - take a ride with us anywhere and anytime - quickly, safely and for better prices
- PREMIUM ride - we chose for you higher class vehicles for more comfy ride and drivers with the best ratings
- EKO ride - choose electric and hybrid cars for your ride
• PARKING service
- buy a parking ticket through HOPIN app in Bratislava
- synchronize your Bratislava Parking Assistant (PAAS) account and parking card
- quick and easy electronic online parking reservation
- create your profile and add car ID (EČV) 
• BUS profile
- easiest way to buy e-ticket for your bus
- find the best routes for public transort
- see realtime public transport directions
- nearby lines and stations
- complete map of all stops with timetables
• COURIER service
- click on the courier icon, enter the pick-up and delivery address of the package and we will take care of the rest
- online service that is available 24/7
- express shipments or at a specific time
- after entering the addresses, you will know the price for delivery in advance
• You can order taxi with HOPIN app in Bratislava, Košice, Martin, Prievidza, Poprad, Michalovce, Humenné and Prague, Ostrava, Kyiv, Chernihiv, and soon in other cities.
• Courier service, Parking Service and Bus profile are available only in Slovakia.
• All important information you can find on na www.hopin.sk

Download now and start calming down, relaxing your sensory system, and transforming distressed moments into peaceful ones with the power of fluid simulation.

bluejetty:00065698:ios.description:
*App Store: Best of 2020*
TOGETHER WE CAN END HUNGER!
ShareTheMeal is the charity app from the 2020 Nobel Peace Prize winner, The United Nations World Food Programme. The app allows you to seamlessly feed people all over the world with just a few taps on your phone. Conflict, climate change, disasters and inequality are causing the rate of world hunger to rise. 
The good news? Hunger IS solvable.
+1+ million supporters are fighting hunger with ShareTheMeal
+300+ million meals and counting have been shared
+Meals are delivered by the United Nations World Food Programme
+Learn more about how together we can build a world without hunger 
With ShareTheMeal you can:
+Share your meal with hungry families wherever and whenever you want
+See exactly where your donation goes and who you are helping
+Create a Challenge and fight hunger together with your community 
Fight hunger with ShareTheMeal because:
+Hunger is the world's greatest solvable problem
+Your payment information is safe and secure
+The World Food Programme provides the food and monitors the impact
+Recommended by The New York Times, CNN, Wired, Buzzfeed and many more
Say hello!
We'd love to hear from you. Send your feedback and suggestions to support@sharethemeal.org
Website: www.sharethemeal.org
Facebook: @ShareTheMeal
Twitter: @ShareTheMealorg
Instagram: @ShareTheMeal
TikTok: @sharethemeal

bluejetty:00161380:ios.description:
Bring anime-inspired adventures to your block-building worlds with a growing collection of addons, skins, maps and custom content.
Browse the catalog, discover new characters and abilities, explore detailed content pages and download the packs you want to use. The app makes it easy to find anime-inspired content and prepare it for your next adventure.
ANIME ADDONS
Discover a collection of anime-inspired addons featuring unique characters, abilities, powers, equipment and gameplay ideas. Browse available content and find something new for your world.
SKINS & CHARACTERS
Explore character skins inspired by anime aesthetics. Choose different heroes, fighters and fantasy characters to give your adventures a completely new look.
MAPS & WORLDS
Discover themed maps and custom worlds designed for battles, exploration, adventures and roleplay. Explore new locations and create your own stories.
POWERS & ABILITIES
Expand your gameplay with addons featuring special abilities, combat mechanics, transformations, weapons, armor and other anime-inspired features.
EASY TO USE
Finding new content is simple:
1. Browse the addon, skin and map catalog
2. Open an item to view its details
3. Download the content you want
4. Follow the available installation steps
5. Open the game and enjoy your new content
CONTENT IN ONE PLACE
Instead of searching across different sources, browse a convenient catalog organized around anime-inspired content. View previews and descriptions before deciding what you want to download.
DISCOVER NEW CONTENT
Explore different types of content, including:
• Anime-inspired addons
• Character skins
• Adventure maps
• Custom worlds
• Special abilities
• Transformations
• Weapons and equipment
• Battle content
• Roleplay content
• Texture content
BUILT FOR ANIME FANS
Create ninja adventures, master supernatural powers, discover fantasy fighters, explore custom worlds and build your own stories. Mix different addons, characters and maps to create the experience you want.
REGULAR CONTENT UPDATES
The catalog continues to grow with additional addons, skins, maps and other content. Check back to discover new downloads and ideas for your worlds.
Whether you enjoy combat, exploration, building or roleplay, the app gives you a convenient way to discover anime-inspired content and expand your block-building adventures.

bluejetty:00044744:ios.description:

bluejetty:00062946:ios.name: Angry Birds Friends
bluejetty:00062946:ios.summary:
Angry Birds Friends brings back the classic physics puzzle game experience you know and love. If you are asking, "Where can I play the original Angry Birds?" you have found your destination.
Dive into the authentic 2009 slingshot gameplay
bluejetty:00062946:ios.description:
Angry Birds Friends brings back the classic physics puzzle game experience you know and love. If you are asking, "Where can I play the original Angry Birds?" you have found your destination.
Dive into the authentic 2009 slingshot gameplay featuring pure physics and tower-crumbling destruction, exactly as you remember it.
Load up your slingshot, pop the bad piggies, and master the perfect trajectory. The core mechanics remain completely intact, delivering the genuine Angry Birds experience!
-----------------------------
Who is Angry Birds Friends for? 
• Nostalgia seekers: For anyone asking, "How do I play the original Angry Birds?" this delivers the exact retro feel.
• Puzzle masters: Perfect for players craving pure puzzle games who want to master the physics and plan the perfect trajectory.
• Perfectionists: Built for fans chasing 3-star glory who won't quit until every green pig is popped and every slingshot launch lands perfectly.
-----------------------------
What does this classic game deliver? 
• The original formula: Experience unreinvented mechanics where wood, glass, and stone break exactly based on your launch angle.
• Endless new puzzles: Test your brain with 35+ brand-new hand-crafted slingshot levels every single week.
• The classic flock: Use Red, Chuck, Bomb, Matilda, and the rest of the birds to cause maximum destruction.
-----------------------------
How do you play and win? 
• Master the physics: Pull back your slingshot, aim, and release to damage structural weak points, letting the authentic engine do the rest in this classic physics puzzle game.
• Unleash your flock: Success requires knowing each bird's strengths. Use the Blues to shatter glass, Chuck to pierce through wood, and Bomb to destroy heavy stone. Just like in the original Angry Birds!
• Smash weekly tournaments: Test your strategy in the most popular game mode. Solve fresh tournament puzzles by analyzing the structures and finding the most efficient, high-scoring path to victory across your favorite Angry Birds game.
-----------------------------
Need some help? Visit our support pages or send us a message! https://support.rovio.com/
Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/angrybirdsfriends/

If you have not installed the latest update, Rovio will not be responsible for the game failing to function as expected. Angry Birds Friends is completely free to play, but there are optional in-app purchases available.

Star Stacker allows you to import a sequence of star photos taken throughout the night and turn them into star trail images or a time lapse video.
After importing you can create the images and/or a time-lapse video with a few different eff
bluejetty:00126109:ios.description:
Star Stacker allows you to import a sequence of star photos taken throughout the night and turn them into star trail images or a time lapse video.
After importing you can create the images and/or a time-lapse video with a few different effects.
- Full trails - every star at full brightness
- Faded trails - Stars get brighter as the process runs
- Shooting star - Like faded trails but the last image is brighter than any previous giving a shooting star effect
- Javelin - Both ends of the trail are faded
- Warp mode - zooms into the image stack slowly creating a warped effect. This will also affect the foreground so post processing may be required if the images have the foreground included.
You can also choose to save a video of the time-lapse based on the options used for the image stacking.
Can import images from your photos app. RAW files that have been recently imported from an SD card reader, may take a few minutes before the full resolution files are available.
There are resolution limits depending on the device being used and the memory it has:
- 6gb - 62mp
- 5gb - 62mp
- 4gb - 62mp
- 3gb - 42mp
- 2gb - 30mp

Routs finder and GPS navigation is a smart app which let the user find all the routs, exact direction, current location, and nearby places. 
The app will get user location and show the user all nearby places, 
This navigator app will help your find the accurate rout from your existing location, and will guide you turn to turn and will reach you your accurate destination. This app will now only show your route, but it will guide your turn by turn via voice. 
Next you can find all your nearby places in around 1000 meter, including filling station, coffee shops, parks, food places, casinos, and more. 
This app is giving user the real world experience by letting the use using Maps with voice and location search. 
This app will help you if need to find route while driving, or if you want to find all nearby places, or if you want to know the world by using the real voice map.

Rout Finder – You can find route once you enter your current location and destination, it will also show you live traffic condition
Near By Places – The app will let know all nearby locations, if you need to visit nearby park, schools etc..
 GPS Navigator – You can navigate all routes through GPS and by inputting your voice 
Voice input functionality- You ask the app by talking to the app to show you the route

bluejetty:00066128:ios.summary: Get ready for the ultimate driving challenge in Mega Ramp: Impossible Tracks, a high-speed racing and stunt game that pushes your skills to the limit. Experience the thrill of extreme car stunts, breathtaking jumps, and dangerous ramps desi
bluejetty:00066128:ios.description:
Get ready for the ultimate driving challenge in Mega Ramp: Impossible Tracks, a high-speed racing and stunt game that pushes your skills to the limit. Experience the thrill of extreme car stunts, breathtaking jumps, and dangerous ramps designed to test even the best drivers. If you love adrenaline-filled racing games and impossible tracks, this is the perfect game for you.
Choose from powerful sports cars and perform flips, drifts, and insane jumps while racing down massive ramps. Every track is packed with tricky paths, sharp turns, and obstacles that demand precision and control. Each level is carefully designed with impossible tracks that keep you on edge. From giant ramps to gravity-defying jumps, every race delivers a new challenge. Thanks to a physics-based engine, every crash, drift, and flip feels real, making the gameplay more intense and immersive.
Game Features:
- Multiple exciting stunt levels
- Realistic physics-based driving
- High-speed cars with smooth controls
- Stunning 3D graphics and visuals
- Challenging missions and rewards
- Playable offline anytime, anywhere
Whether you are a racing enthusiast or a casual gamer, Mega Ramp: Impossible Tracks offers a thrilling mix of racing, stunts, and impossible challenges. Master the ramps, conquer the tracks, and prove yourself as the ultimate stunt driver.

bluejetty:00087048:ios.summary:

Many delectable dishes ↠↠↠ New York Pizza, classic Apple Pie, Alaskan king crab, hamburger; French cuisin
bluejetty:00087048:ios.description:
Located on beautiful beaches, our Cooking Seaside restaurant chain is a must-visit culinary experience destination for all travelers.
Many delectable dishes ↠↠↠ New York Pizza, classic Apple Pie, Alaskan king crab, hamburger; French cuisine like Escargot grilled snails, steak, croissant,...; Singapore food, Japanese dishes, sashimi, ramen, bento... all fresh seafood and high-class meats definitely impress whole upcoming customers. 
You are cooking in the coastal restaurant divided into various zones with unique styles, facing the stunning ocean. 
Cooking by the sea will delight you alots, as you know, coastal restaurants, various zones with unique styles, facing the stunning ocean,... All the time, you love cooking and chilling out in your areas.
The journey awaits ahead!
⇪ COOKING SEASIDE 2025
In this culinary wonderland, you are gonna:
• Experience various dishes from throughout the world, including Asia, Europe, and America on this exciting voyage, you will also learn more and travel to the world's most famous seaside cities.
• Feel like you're cooking in your own kitchen. You'll learn every culinary method, as well as dozens of additional cooking recipes you've probably never heard of.
• Improve cooking ingredients and introduce more innovative recipes to fantastic guests. Along with preparing increasingly sophisticated dishes, you will boost your revenue and advance through all stages. 
• Learn how to manage, balance time wisely, and update kitchen gadgets to tackle foodies rapidly.
⇪ HOW TO PLAY
• Play the game to unlock new restaurants by collecting enough keys
• Prepare and serve a range of delectable delicacies for guests
• Upgrade your kitchen ingredients and appliances
• Boost your profits by servicing more consumers
• Create numerous combos to increase your income and bonus from consumers
• Increase your cooking power and speed by using item packs
• Avoid wasting or burning food
⇪ TIPS FOR CHEFS
While playing the game, you may be helped in 
• Instant cook ‣ bringing food instantly 
• Anti-over cook ‣ keeping food without burning. 
• Double coin ‣ X2 money you earn, richer helps you to quickly upgrade goods and enhance the restaurant.
• Auto - Serve ‣ Automatically serve customers
• Items: Add time, Add customer, Second chance,... gonna save you when out of time
All customers will visit your beach restaurant to immerse themselves in nature, listen to the waves of the sea, and thoroughly appreciate the taste of high-class cuisine offered by you. They are waiting for you every minute, so don't waste time.
Cooking Seaside - let’s download game right now! 
Roll up your sleeves and put on your chef's hat.

bluejetty:00159352:ios.description:
MONITORING YOUR HEALTH DAILY IS THE KEY TO WELLNESS AND BALANCE
Stay on top of your health with HeartFit! Check your heart rate, track your blood pressure, monitor your oxygen saturation, and log your blood sugar levels—all directly from your iPhone.
Simply place your finger on the camera to measure your heart rate instantly. Keep an eye on your BMI, analyze HRV data, and monitor your stress and energy levels with ease. Receive daily reminders to check your vitals and stay connected to your health journey. Achieve peace of mind and a healthier you—all in one app.
Key Features:
· Heart Rate Measurement: Use your fingertip and camera to measure your heart rate anytime.
· HRV Analysis: Monitor key metrics like stress, energy, and more to understand your well-being.
· Blood Sugar Log: Track your blood sugar levels for a comprehensive health overview.
· Blood Pressure & Oxygen Tracking: Record your blood pressure and oxygen saturation levels.
· Weight & BMI Calculation: Easily calculate your weight and BMI to track your fitness progress.
· Daily Health Assessments: Receive personalized insights and lifestyle advice to stay healthier.
· Comprehensive Health Overview: View all your daily health measurements in one place for better tracking.
· History Reports: Access detailed records of your heart health for progress tracking.
· Apple Health Integration: Sync your pulse measurements with the Health app for seamless health monitoring.
How to Check Pulse：
First, put your finger on the phone's camera lens.
Secondly, ensure the fingertip fully covers the camera lens and do not press too much.
Finally, keep still until the measuring process ends.
IMPORTANT NOTICE
HeartFit is not meant to be used as a substitute for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. The app is not a medical device, and users should always seek the advice of a healthcare professional before making any healthcare decisions.
Subscription Conditions:
- Subscribe to get unlimited access to all premium features.
- Subscription length: weekly, monthly, yearly.
- The iTunes account will be charged after the trial period ends.
- You should be aware that the subscription will automatically renew unless you close the automatic renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- After purchase, you can turn off automatic renewal at the account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://res.heartfitsolution.com/privacy-policy.html 
Terms of Service: https://res.heartfitsolution.com/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00026131:ios.description:
Join millions who rely on Muslim App, formerly Muslim Assistant, for accurate prayer times, Qibla direction, the Quran, and daily azkar.
Why Muslim App?
70M+ Users: Trusted by millions of brothers and sisters for daily ibadah.
Loved for Clarity & Precision: Built to be simple, beautiful, and easy to use.
Privacy as an Amanah: Your data is a trust. We treat it with care and prioritize your privacy and security.
Key Features
- Prayer Times (Verified + Precise): Truly location-based Adhan times from verified authorities, with madhhab and latitude adjustments when needed. Times update automatically when you travel across time zones.
- Adhan Notifications: A maqam-based default Adhan, plus options like the one commonly heard in your country. Customize sounds by time of day, choose an alarm sound if you prefer, or vibration-only for work and meetings.
- Prayer Tracker: Mark your daily salah, follow your progress, and stay consistent in your ibadah.
- Apple Watch Support: Track prayer times, find the Qibla direction, and count your dhikr with the digital tasbih — all from your watch.
- Namaz Times Widgets: Beautifully designed widgets that show your upcoming prayers at a glance on your home and lock screens.
- Qibla Finder: Map + compass mode to find the Kaaba direction, even when offline — ideal for travel.
- AI Imam: An Islamic companion for learning, everyday guidance, and support — always with respect, care, and verified sources.
- Al Quran Kareem: Read in English and 40+ other languages with tafsir and transliteration. Listen to famous reciters with a background player (screen locked / app in background). Download recitations to read and listen offline.
- Quran Widgets: A new verse each day on your home and lock screens, keeping the words of the Quran close to your heart.
- Khatam Tracker: Plan your Quran completion and stay on track.
- Azkar: Morning and evening azkar, and more — Arabic, translation, pronunciation, explanation, virtue, and audio.
- Digital Tasbih: Track your dhikr counts and cycles easily.
- Asma'ul Husna: Learn the 99 Names with a refreshed, educational design.
- Jumu'ah (Friday): Starting Thursday evening — reminders for dhikr and salawat to welcome Friday with more remembrance.

70M+ Users: Trusted by millions of brothers and sisters for daily ibadah.

Privacy as an Amanah: Your data is a trust. We treat it with care and prioritize your privacy and security.

- Prayer Times (Verified + Precise): Truly location-based Adhan times from verified authorities, with madhhab and latitude adjustments when needed. Times update automatically when you travel across time zones.
