bluejetty:00033686:ios.description:
Descarga agora Estudos bíblicos Teología mais completos para aprender mas sobre a bíblia.
Maravilhosos e educativos estudos bíblicos sobre Teologia para seguir a Palavra de Deus.
Você pode expandir seus conhecimentos devido à magnífica informação sobre teologia, estudos bíblicos teologia , estudos bíblicos em profundidade , estudos bíblicose Diários , perguntas e respostas sobre teologia , Teologia Bíblice e Sistemática..
Aplicativo na que encontrará todo tipo de recursos bíblicos que ajudarão você a estudar mais em profundidade a Biblia ou a pregar com o exemplo em qualquer momento ou lugar.
Descubra novos dados e expandir seus conhecimentos com Estudos Bíblicos Teologia
Aprenda tudo o que você quer saber sobre vários tópicos sobre o livro mais famoso do mundo, a Bíblia.
Estudos Bíblicos Teologia tem informações sobre a Bíblia. Interpretação da Bíblia para obter respostas sobre tudo, oração, fé, conhecimento e muito mais.
Se deseja aprender mais sobre a natureza da doutrina, descarga Estudos Bíblicos Teología , disporá em sua smartphone de uma grande heramienta para consultar.
Algum conhecimento sobre teologia incluido
- Principal Mensagem de Jesus 
- A graça de Deus na Bíblia 
- Cristão pode perder a salvação? 
- O Melhor de Deus Está Por Vir? 
- O Deus de sempre 
- Breve comentário acerca da teologia cristã atual
- A Constituição da Liberdade Cristã
- O Propósito e o Modo de se Buscar a Deus
- O Critério da Salvação 
- A Unidade Entre os Cristãos é Obtida por Esforço
- O Valor da Alma 
- A Culpa do Homem Reside em Não Buscar a Deus
- O Reino Prometido de Paz 
- Jesus Lava os Pés de Seus Discípulos
- Humilde Como Uma Criança 
Alguns estudos bíblicos diários incluídos:
- Os direitos de Deus 
- É hora de planejar 
- A arte da comunhão 
- No universo da criança 
- Dependência ou morte 
- A lição da borboleta 
- Violência: retrato de uma sociedade sem Deus
- Buscar a Deus 
- Evitando controvérsia 
- A genealogia de Jesus 
- Como Passar o Dia Com Deus 
- Natal uma oportunidade da salvação 
Ademais em nosso aplicativo encontrará temas Bíblicos em profundidade tais como:
- A Força que toca a Coração de Deus
- Sansão e a síndrome das decisões ruins
- Louvor Bíblico
- O valor de um perdão
- Falta de Sabedoria
- Alegria e Regozijo
- Ai de Vós!
- O Que Define o Seu Valor
- A Chuva da Graça
- A Preparação da Esposa do Cordeiro
- Remindo o Tempo
- Aqueles que Julgam os Outros São Julgados
- Canção da Alma
A Teologia bíblica estuda a Bíblia e organiza as conclusões obtidas pela Teologia exegética (que usa técnicas como a exegese para interpretar a Bíblia) em várias divisões e áreas de estudo, com a finalidade de estudar e conhecer a evolução ou a história progressiva da Revelação de Deus à humanidade, desde da sua queda e passando pelo Antigo Testamento e Novo Testamento.
Além disso, o aplicativo inclui um melhor estudo e compreensão da Bíblia:
- Teología Bíblica Sistemática nutre-se da convicção de que a praxis vivida pela comunidade de fé em Jesús Cristo é o acesso à manifestação singular de Deus que constitui o objeto de reflexão teológica cristã.
- Perguntas sobre Teologia: Perguntas e respostas importantes e para saber mas a respeito da teologia.
- Dicionário teológico: Uma ferramenta para você aprender e compreender qualquer definição da doutrina da teologia. É muito conveniente e fácil de usar. Você vai encontrar muita informação sobre teologia que vai fazer você ver o mundo cristão a partir de uma perspectiva global.
- Bíblia Escrita: Consulta toda sua obra quando deseje. 
- Audio Bíblia: Relaxe-se e escuta a Biblia tranquilamente
- Versículos Bíblicos en audio
Estudos Bíblicos Teologia contém publicidade para cobrir os custos de programação.
Encontre encorajamento para superar as provações da vida com a ajuda da Palavra de Deus e estudos bíblicos sobre Teologia da educação.
Descarga agora Estudos bíblicos Teología e partilhar connosco a sua experiência.

bluejetty:00188076:ios.summary:
Addiko Mobile Srbija aplikacija za mobilno bankarstvo vam omogućava jednostavan i siguran pristup informacijama o proizvodima (računi, krediti, kartice, štednja, itd.) kao i lako upravljanje vašim finansijama na svim iOS uređajima. 
Osnovn
bluejetty:00188076:ios.description:
Addiko Mobile Srbija aplikacija za mobilno bankarstvo vam omogućava jednostavan i siguran pristup informacijama o proizvodima (računi, krediti, kartice, štednja, itd.) kao i lako upravljanje vašim finansijama na svim iOS uređajima. 
Osnovne prednosti nove verzije m-banking aplikacije su: 
• Jednostavan pristup banci putem mobilnog telefona 24h dnevno, 7 dana u nedelji 
• Aktivacija aplikacije ne zahteva odlazak u banku; korisnik može aktivirati aplikaciju na više uređaja 
• Korisničko ime i lozinka zamenjeni su 4-cifrenim PIN-om koji sami kreirate 
• Jednostavan pregled stanja i prometa po računima 
• Informacije o platnim karticama uz pregled potrošnje i rezervacija 
• Informacije o štednji i kreditnim proizvodima 
• Jednostavna i brza plaćanja korišćenjem mobilnog tokena, uz mogućnost kreiranja šablona i plaćanja na račune predefinisane od strane banke 
• Mogućnost slikanja računa radi lakšeg unosa podataka za plaćanje (Photo&Pay) 
• Prikaz lokacija ekspozitura i bankomata banke uz jednostavno lociranje najbližeg objekta 
• Unapređeno grafičko okruženje i performanse aplikacije 
Sve funkcionalnosti, koje su dostupne na e-banking rešenju Addiko Bank ad Beograd, sada su dostupne i na vašem iOS telefonu. Više detalja o usluzi i aplikaciji možete pronaći na website-u banke: http://www.addiko.rs ili pozivom našeg Info centra na broj telefona 0800 303 303. 
VAŽNA NAPOMENA: Za korišćenje naše m-banking aplikacije morate imati aktiviranu uslugu elektronskog bankarstva.

Your Benefits at a Glance

Read messages, access helpful resources, or reach out for additional support—all within the app.
Strong, Secure Access
Use biometric login to keep your information protected
EBCentral brings everything together so you can focus less on managing benefits and more on using them.

bluejetty:00119690:ios.summary: Discover the ultimate platform to find and sell new and used farm equipment, ag machinery, and tools, including tractors, combines, sprayers, tenders, implements, and parts and attachments. Whether you’re a farmer looking for new machinery,
bluejetty:00119690:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate platform to find and sell new and used farm equipment, ag machinery, and tools, including tractors, combines, sprayers, tenders, implements, and parts and attachments. Whether you’re a farmer looking for new machinery, a private seller, or an ag equipment dealer, the TractorHouse app makes connecting with buyers and sellers in the agricultural industry fast, easy, and secure.
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF FARM EQUIPMENT LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
Browse thousands of listings for tractors, combines, sprayers, planters, balers, mowers, hay and forage machinery, tillage equipment, grain handling systems, and so much more. Plus, find attachments and parts to keep your operations running smoothly.
Once you’ve narrowed your search, dive into detailed photos and videos of your desired equipment and its specifications. Contact sellers directly to secure the best price and explore financing and shipping options offered by CurrencyFinance and FR8Star, trusted partners of TractorHouse.
The TractorHouse app features convenient search tools that allow you to filter listings by category, make, model, location, condition, and specs such as horsepower and year. Save time and find exactly what you need fast.
EASILY TRACK EQUIPMENT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING
Create a private Watch List to save your favorite equipment, or post a “Want-to-Buy” ad to let sellers know what you’re searching for. Receive new listings and weekly updates tailored to your interests via email, and monitor category pages updated daily with fresh inventory.
CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST
If you’re a dealership representative or an independent seller, TractorHouse provides access to thousands of qualified buyers actively shopping for farm equipment, tools, and attachments.
Consign your machinery with TractorHouse to reach a global audience. Click the "My Inventory" button in your TractorHouse app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app, your trusted, easy, and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your inventory on the go—right from your iOS device.
CHOOSE THE TRACTORHOUSE APP FOR ALL YOUR FARMING NEEDS
Whether you’re upgrading your fleet or selling agricultural equipment, TractorHouse connects you with a vast inventory of farm machinery and tools and a large buyer audience.
As part of Sandhills Global, TractorHouse links you to a network that includes MachineryTrader, Truck Paper, SpecialtyCropEQ, NeedTurfEquipment, AuctionTime, and other leading brands. Access listings from trusted manufacturers like John Deere, Case IH, New Holland, Kubota, Massey Ferguson, and more.
GET THE TRACTORHOUSE APP NOW
Thousands of farmers, dealerships, and equipment sellers trust TractorHouse to manage their operations. Download the app today to find the tools you need or sell with ease.

bluejetty:00062838:ios.name: Voice Dream - Natural Reader
bluejetty:00062838:ios.summary:
Apple Design Award Winner! Voice Dream - Read Aloud lets you listen to PDFs, textbooks, Web pages, emails, and books using advanced AI Text To Speech!
Featured by Apple as Best New App and App of the Day in 81 countries. Voice Dream - Read
bluejetty:00062838:ios.description:
Apple Design Award Winner! Voice Dream - Read Aloud lets you listen to PDFs, textbooks, Web pages, emails, and books using advanced AI Text To Speech!
Featured by Apple as Best New App and App of the Day in 81 countries. Voice Dream - Read Aloud is also part of App Store Permanent Collections in Education.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
“Both experts recommend Voice Dream Reader as the best app in the text-to-speech space.” - Wired
“This app is one of the best educational finds of my entire career.” - Forbes
“As a user myself and as a mother of a child with dyslexia, I am blown away by the features of Voice Dream.” - Quartz
“Voice Dream Reader is hailed by many as the best mobile text-to-speech (TTS) app.” - Examiner
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Text-to-Speech 
- 36 built-in iOS voices in 27 languages are also available for free.
- 200+ additional premium voices in 30 languages from Acapela, NeoSpeech and Ivona available.
- Correct pronunciation with your own pronunciation dictionary.
- All voices work offline and play in the background even with the screen locked.
Supported Document Formats
- PDF, Plain text, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, RTF, and Google Docs.
- Textbooks
- Web articles.
- Bookshare Books.
- EPUB eBooks. (DRM-free books only. Kindle, iBooks and most commercial eBook platforms are not supported.)
- DAISY text-based books and audiobook.
- Audiobooks in MP3, MP4 or zipped MP3 format.
- Rich text and image support for all documents.
Built-in Scanner
- Scan paper documents with the camera for text-to-speech.
- State-of-the-art A.I. is fast and accurate, even in poor lighting conditions.
- Works entirely on device: No need for internet and your data stays private.
- Only languages using Latin alphabets are currently supported.
Reading Styles
- Tee-up a list of articles and play while you drive, walk or run.
- Spoken word is highlighted to improve comprehension and retention.
- Auto-scrolling and full screen, distraction-free mode to help reader focus.
- Finger reading. For beginners to read by at running a finger under each word.
- Pac-Man. Harvard and MIT developed speed-reading method for everyone to read at 2x speed with no loss of comprehension.
- High contrast and large font size for low vision readers.
- Optimized for VoiceOver, Braille and switch control.
Tools
- Recognize text for scanned PDF documents.
- Bookmarking, text highlighting and annotation. Highlights and notes can be exported.
- Full-text search.
- Built-in dictionary.
- Automatically skip text in PDF header and footer. 
Content Sources
- Native support for Dropbox, Google Drive, iCloud Drive, Pocket, Instapaper and Evernote.
- Native access to Bookshare.
- Safari extension to save Web pages and Web addresses.
- Support for Box and OneDrive via iOS Document Picker.
Library Synchronization
- Your entire library, including folders, reading locations, bookmarks and annotations are synchronized across all your devices using iCloud Drive
A subscription is required to access the app. A free trial is offered to new users.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

The go-to feet-inch-fraction calculator for framers, contractors, and builders. Includes Construction Master Pro and Construction Master Pro Trig in one app, with the CMPro Training Guide built in.
Built with the same core engine that powers the industry-standard advanced construction-math calculators from Calculated Industries. Award-winning tools trusted by the industry for 40 years.
BUILT FOR THE JOBSITE
• Framers and carpenters: rafter cuts, stair layouts, lumber quantities, and framing calculations on the job 
• Builders and general contractors: estimates, material takeoffs, and building layouts 
• Concrete and masonry: footing volume, block counts, and unit conversions
• Roofing contractors: bundles, squares, pitch, and slope in seconds 
WHY PROFESSIONALS CHOOSE CONSTRUCTION MASTER® PRO
• Powerful built-in calculations make CMPro ideal for completing layouts, plans, bids, and estimates 
• Work in and convert between all common building dimensional formats US & Metric 
• Built-in right angle functions simplify square-ups, rafters, slopes, and more 
• Handles framing, roofing, concrete, lumber, and stair calculations in one app
• Full trigonometric functions for advanced construction math
BUILT-IN SOLUTIONS 
• Dimensional Math and Conversions 
• Feet-Inch-Fraction, Inch Fraction, Yards 
• Decimal Feet and Inches (10ths, 100ths) 
• Preset Fractions (1/2" through 1/64") 
• D:M:S, Decimal Degree Entry and Conversions 
• Full Metric Function (m, cm, mm) 
RIGHT ANGLE SOLUTIONS 
• Complete Right Angle/Rafter Calculations 
• Pitch Key (Slope and Grade) 
• Rise, Run, Diagonal/Common Rafter Keys 
• Regular and Irregular Hip/Valley & Jack Rafter Keys 
• Rafter Cutting Angles (Plumb, Cheek, and Level Cuts) 
• Stair Layouts (including – Riser Limit, Stairwell Opening, Headroom, Floor Thickness) 
• Rake-Wall (including Arched) 
AREA AND VOLUME SOLUTIONS 
• Square and Cubic 
• Roof – Bundles, Squares, 4x8 Sheets, Pitch, Plan Area 
• Drywall, Siding and Paneling 4x8, 4x9 and 4x12 
• Column/Cone Area and Volume -- 
• Basic & Advanced Circular Calculations 
• Weight per Volume Conversions 
• Length, Width, and Height Keys 
• Blocks, Footings 
SPECIAL FUNCTIONS 
• Trigonometric Function Keys: Sine, Cosine, Tangent, Arcsine, Arccosine, Arctangent 
• Board Feet 
• Studs: Find number On-center 
• User-Definable Preferences 
• Cost per Unit (total costs based on unit price) 
• Equal-Sided Polygon 
• Compound Miters 
• Crown Angle 
• Advanced Paperless Tape
APP-ENHANCED FEATURES 
• Ask CMPro – exact steps for any calculation. AI built on CMPro’s 40 years of proven math
• CMPro Toolbelt -- quick access to every tool, customizable for your workflow 
• Fast Fractions Mode -- dedicated fraction keys for faster, more precise entry 
• Materials Mode -- streamlined estimating for drywall, roofing, lumber, and more 
• Project Notes -- create text or voice-to-text notes, set up folders by project or client, add attachments, and share with your crew 
• EZ Calcs – 100+ forms-based calculators with illustrations for framing, concrete, roofing quantities, and much more.
• Searchable Help and how-to videos 
• Context-sensitive Help -- press and hold any function key for Help text, diagrams, and videos 
• Save and share calculations and outputs (e.g., cut lists) with others on your crew 
• Bosch GLM integration -- send measured values into live calculations or Notes
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION 
Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Apple account Settings > Account (Apple ID) > Subscriptions.
TRADEMARKS 
Construction Master® and Calculated Industries® are registered trademarks of Calculated Industries, Inc. 
Copyright 2026

bluejetty:00092819:ios.summary:
Nunca foi tão fácil investir com a Grão, a gestora de fundos do Grupo Primo!

bluejetty:00092819:ios.description:
Nunca foi tão fácil investir com a Grão, a gestora de fundos do Grupo Primo!
O app da Grão te dá acesso aos fundos de previdência criados pela gestora do Grupo Primo, que é um ecossistema de empresas do setor financeiro que tem como dois dos principais sócios os influenciadores Thiago Nigro (o Primo Rico) e Bruno Perini.
Atualmente, você encontra duas opções de previdências para investir por meio do app: a ARCA Previdência Multimercado e a ARCA Previdência Renda Fixa.
- ARCA Previdência Multimercado: é o produto baseado na estratégia de investimentos criada e difundida pelo Thiago Nigro: a metodologia ARCA. É uma previdência multimercado, que aloca o patrimônio dos investidores por meio de fundos de investimento que seguem as 4 classes de ativos presentes no método do Primo Rico: ações (fundos de ações), real estate (fundos imobiliários), caixa (fundos de renda fixa) e ativos internacionais (fundos de índice). 
- ARCA Previdência Renda Fixa: é a previdência mais conservadora da Grão, que investe o patrimônio dos investidores apenas na parte “caixa” da metodologia ARCA, ou seja, aplica somente em produtos de renda fixa. O investimento é feito por meio de fundos de renda fixa. 
Você pode investir nesses produtos contando com as diversas funcionalidades e ferramentas que o app da Grão oferece:
- O app da Grão é pensado para você investir sozinho e de forma rápida. Depois do cadastro dos seus dados, é possível escolher o seu modelo de previdência com poucos cliques, enviando a ordem de investimento instantaneamente.
- Durante o processo de contratação da previdência, você pode acompanhar o andamento em tempo real no app da Grão. Acompanhe a solicitação, os aportes e a efetivação dos seus investimentos, tudo de forma totalmente digital e intuitiva.
- O seu patrimônio aparece na tela inicial do aplicativo. Com isso, você pode acompanhar diariamente como está a evolução da sua carteira.
- Veja, em tempo real, em quais fundos a sua previdência investe e a porcentagem de aplicação em cada um deles. 
- O app possui a função de aporte esporádico, que permite que você faça a sua aplicação quando quiser e no valor que quiser (respeitando apenas os R$100,00 de movimentação mínima), o que facilita a gestão do seu patrimônio de acordo com a sua organização financeira.
- No app você tem um FAQ com todas as respostas sobre previdência privada de modo geral e especificamente sobre cada produto contratado. 
- No app você tem acesso facilitado à equipe de atendimento.
Ainda não teve a sua questão respondida ou precisa de informações mais detalhadas? Consulte o nosso atendimento para dúvidas mais específicas.

bluejetty:00160674:ios.name: Block Puzzle Fun Game
bluejetty:00160674:ios.summary:

Masteri
bluejetty:00160674:ios.description:
"Block Puzzle" is a free and engaging block puzzle game that’s perfect for 
passing the time while challenging your mind. The objective is simple yet 
entertaining: match and clear as many colorful blocks as you can from the board. 
Mastering the art of filling rows and columns will enhance your gameplay and 
make the experience even more enjoyable. "Color Match Puzzle" not only offers 
a relaxing gaming experience but also sharpens your logical thinking and 
brainpower.
This block puzzle game features two exciting modes: Classic Mode and Adventure 
Mode, providing a delightful and satisfying gaming experience. The cube block 
puzzle is easy to play, stimulates your brain, and enhances your cognitive 
skills. Plus, "Color Match Puzzle" is completely free and can be played offline, 
allowing you to tackle logic puzzles anytime, anywhere. Get ready to embark on 
a fun puzzle journey with "Color Match Puzzle" as your go-to companion!
• Classic Mode: Drag and drop colorful blocks onto the board and match as 
 many as possible in this addictive brain-training game. The game continuously 
 presents various shapes of blocks until there’s no space left on the board.
• Adventure Mode: Dive into a world of challenging puzzles! Explore vibrant 
 landscapes, encounter unique characters, collect rewards, and boost your 
 brainpower by solving intricate logic puzzles.
In this free and popular cube block puzzle game, you don’t need WiFi or an 
internet connection. Even offline, you can use logic and strategy to solve 
puzzles and enhance your mind. Join this enjoyable puzzle journey!
How to play the free block puzzle game:
• Drag and drop colored tile blocks onto the 8x8 board for sorting and 
 matching.
• Classic mode requires strategic matching of rows or columns to clear 
 colorful blocks.
• The game ends when there’s no more space to place blocks on the board.
• Blocks cannot be rotated, adding an extra layer of challenge. Use logic 
 and strategy to ensure optimal placements, testing your IQ and brainpower.
Block puzzle game features:
• Completely free, no WiFi needed. Play online or offline and enjoy the fun 
 of block puzzles anytime, anywhere.
• Fun for everyone—suitable for kids, adults, and seniors alike.
• Enjoy rhythmic music while playing, along with colorful graphics and 
 hundreds of addictive levels!
In this free cube block puzzle game, you’ll also experience unique COMBO 
gameplay. Whether you’re a puzzle expert or a beginner, our thoughtfully 
designed logic puzzles and captivating gameplay will keep you engaged.
Tips to master the fun and satisfying block puzzle game:
• Use board space wisely to maximize your scoring potential.
• Choose the best placements based on the shapes of the colored blocks.
• Plan ahead for multiple blocks, not just the current one.
• Analyze the board to predict potential block shapes and placements.
If you’re searching for a free classic puzzle game, "Color Match Puzzle" is 
the perfect choice. This game combines elements of traditional block puzzles, 
Sudoku, match-3 games, and more, making it ideal for passing the time. 
Download this beloved puzzle game and share the fun with friends and family!

The Tommee Tippee app is your all-in-one parenting companion – combining smart product control with a powerful new Baby Tracker.
Whether you're using our connected products or just want to stay on top of your baby’s daily routine, the app helps you manage everything in one place.
Baby Tracker & Diary
• Log daily activities like feeds, sleep, nappy changes, expressing, and more
• Discover the right products for your baby with personalised insights

• Find the perfect name using our built-in baby name generator
• Spot trends and patterns to better understand your baby’s routine
• Share updates effortlessly with your partner or other caregivers
Connected Products
• Pair with Tommee Tippee smart devices like Perfect Prep machines, breast pumps and cameras.
• Carry out maintenance, receive alerts, and control settings remotely
Designed to support you through every stage of your parenting journey – from newborn to toddler.

bluejetty:00124405:ios.name: NecroMerger - Idle Merge Game
bluejetty:00124405:ios.summary: The Devourer is always hungry and it’s your job to feed it in this idle merge game mashup. Play as the NecroMerger and use dark magic to summon an array of creatures (skeletons, zombies, demons, banshees… the list goes on). Merge them from
bluejetty:00124405:ios.description:
The Devourer is always hungry and it’s your job to feed it in this idle merge game mashup. Play as the NecroMerger and use dark magic to summon an array of creatures (skeletons, zombies, demons, banshees… the list goes on). Merge them from piddly little grunts into massive (and tasty) brutes, before feeding them to your ever hungry pet.
As you grow your Devourer you’ll attract the attention of merchants, champions and even rivals. Some can be useful, others must be fought… or fed to your insatiable pet. The bigger the Devourer grows the more your lair will expand and you’ll unlock powerful abilities and spells.
Complete tasks to unlock new stations and equipment… graves, altars, fridges and even a bathtub to hold excess slime. New stations will let you summon new, stronger (and even more tasty) creatures. Manage your lair and your underlings to maximize your resource generation.
NecroMerger is a whole new type of game, which combines merge and idle mechanics with resource management to create something truly unique.
Grow Monsters
+ 70+ creatures to spawn and merge.
+ Creatures have unique abilities to manage (resource generation, damage, deliciousness)
+ Legendary Creatures with massive benefits.
Expand your Lair
+ Expand your lair. Unlock new equipment including; graves, supply cupboards, lecterns.
+ Attract Champions, merchants and thieves to your lair.
+ Complete tasks, master spells, brew potions.
Idle Merge Mashup
+ A unique system of resource management.
+ Resources generate even when you’re offline.
+ Months of fun!
From the makers of Idle Apocalypse and Idle Mastermind, NecroMerger has all the humour and inane chatter you’d expect of a Grumpy Rhino Game.

bluejetty:00027665:ios.summary:
スマホの中にある素敵な思い出の写真を
世界にたったひとつのカタチに変えて、
大切な人へお届けするフォトギフトサービスです。
一年ぶんの、
ありがとうをぜんぶ
とじこめて。
スマホの中の写真を選ぶだけで、オリジナルフォトギフトを作れます。
大切なご家族への贈りものに、お子さまの写真、思い出の家族写真、あの日、あの時の時間をカタチに変えたフォトギフトはいかがですか？
ギフトにもお使いいただけるパッケージでお届けするので、大切な方へのプレゼントにおすすめです。
◆思い出の写
bluejetty:00027665:ios.description:
スマホの中にある素敵な思い出の写真を
世界にたったひとつのカタチに変えて、
大切な人へお届けするフォトギフトサービスです。
一年ぶんの、
ありがとうをぜんぶ
とじこめて。
スマホの中の写真を選ぶだけで、オリジナルフォトギフトを作れます。
大切なご家族への贈りものに、お子さまの写真、思い出の家族写真、あの日、あの時の時間をカタチに変えたフォトギフトはいかがですか？
ギフトにもお使いいただけるパッケージでお届けするので、大切な方へのプレゼントにおすすめです。
◆思い出の写真でつくる「OKURU家族カレンダー」
写真を12枚選ぶだけでかんたんにつくれる、家族の思い出がつまったカレンダーはいかがですか？
リビングや玄関、寝室などお好みの飾りたい場所を選べるよう、壁かけや卓上カレンダーをご用意しています。
年末年始の贈り物や新年のご準備にもおすすめです。
◆グッドデザイン賞 受賞「こどもの手書きカレンダー」
「こどもの手書きカレンダー」は、お子さまの書いたかわいい数字とお気に入りの写真でつくる、オリジナルカレンダーです。
お子さまが紙に書いた数字の0〜9をアプリで読み取るだけで、カレンダーに使われる全ての数字を自動で作成。
あとは、お気に入りの写真を選ぶだけ。お子さまの数字フォントでオリジナルカレンダーが完成します。
数字を撮って、写真を選ぶだけのかんたん操作なので、忙しいママ・パパでも簡単に作ることができます。
手書きの数字はお子さまの情報に紐づけて保存されるので、兄弟・姉妹や書いた年齢ごとに分けて保存することができます。
2022年のグッドデザイン賞を受賞し、審査委員が選ぶ「私の選んだ一品」にも選出されました。
◆心に残る大切な写真やモノを形に変える「フォトグッズ」◆
特別な日の写真から、日々の成長を感じる瞬間の記録まで。ご家族のたいせつな思い出をカタチにする商品をお届けします。
【アクリルスタンド】
ハレの日の思い出をより鮮やかに彩るアクリルスタンド。
主役のお子さま、背景、装飾パーツを重ねることで、自然な奥行きと立体感が生まれ、まるでその場にいるかのように感じられます。
デザインは七五三、バースデー、ニューボーン・ベビー、卒園・入学、スタンダードの５種類をご用意。
コンパクトなサイズなので、おうちの好きな場所に手軽に飾って楽しめます。
【アクリルキーホルダー】
お気に入りの写真を1枚選ぶだけでつくれる、持ち歩けるキーホルダーです。
写真は人物のシルエットに沿って自動で切り抜かれるので、難しい操作はいりません。
写真だけの「フォトキーホルダー」と、お名前パーツを組み合わせる「フォト＋おなまえキーホルダー」の2種類からお選びいただけます。
お名前パーツは、お花やリボン、雲など6種類の形と、11色のカラーから選べます。
バッグや鍵などにつけて、お子さまの笑顔をいつも一緒に。離れて暮らすおじいちゃん・おばあちゃんへの贈りものにもおすすめです。
◆お子さまの成長をずっと残せる「アニバーサリーブック」◆
アニバーサリーブックは、生まれてはじめてのお誕生日や、一年ごとの成長の記録をまとめるのにぴったりのフォトブックです。
富士フイルム製の銀塩写真を使っているので、お子さまの成長を美しく、末永く残せます。
「みてね」と連携すると、おすすめの写真を選んでくれたり、選んだ写真に最適なレイアウトを提案してくれます。忙しいパパ・ママでも、愛と思い出がつまった一冊を簡単に作れます。
◆フォトギフトサービス「OKURU」とは？◆
スマホで撮った写真を、大切な人にフォトギフトとして贈るサービスです。 
写真を選ぶだけでつくれるオリジナルフォトギフトをお届けいたします。
◆「OKURU」の４つのポイント◆
①写真を選ぶだけでフォトギフトが作れる
写真を選ぶだけで自動配置されるので、手間のかかる写真レイアウトが必要ありません（手動編集もできます）。
通勤中や、育児や家事の合間など、ちょっとの時間でも作ることができます。
②目的や飾り方に合わせて選べる商品
おうちに飾られた写真が、日々の新しい彩りになるよう、シーンに合わせて選べるフォトギフトを揃えました。
一年中飾れる「フォトカレンダー」、思い出の写真をカタチに変える「フォトグッズ」、成長の記録をキレイに残す「アニバーサリーブック」、お気に入りの一枚を絵画のように飾る「フォトキャンバス」をご用意しています。
③写真が魅力的に見えるデザイン
各商品ごとに、写真が魅力的に見えるデザインをご用意しております。一月に一枚の写真を選ぶだけでかんたんに、思い出のつまったカレンダーを作ることができます。
素材感にもこだわったフォトキャンバスは、とっておきの一枚が素敵な作品に仕上がります。
④ギフトにも使える特製パッケージでお届け
フォトギフトはギフトにもお使いいただけるパッケージに入れてお届けします。大切なご家族の方へのプレゼントにもおすすめです。

写真だけの「フォトキーホルダー」と、お名前パーツを組み合わせる「フォト＋おなまえキーホルダー」の2種類からお選びいただけます。
お名前パーツは、お花やリボン、雲など6種類の形と、11色のカラーから選べます。

バッグや鍵などにつけて、お子さまの笑顔をいつも一緒に。離れて暮らすおじいちゃん・おばあちゃんへの贈りものにもおすすめです。


◆お子さまの成長をずっと残せる「アニバーサリーブック」◆
アニバーサリーブックは、生まれてはじめてのお誕生日や、一年ごとの成長の記録をまとめるのにぴったりのフォトブックです。
富士フイルム製の銀塩写真を使っているので、お子さまの成長を美しく、末永く残せます。
「みてね」と連携すると、おすすめの写真を選んでくれたり、選んだ写真に最適なレイアウトを提案してくれます。忙しいパパ・ママでも、愛と思い出がつまった一冊を簡単に作れます。


◆フォトギフトサービス「OKURU」とは？◆
スマホで撮った写真を、大切な人にフォトギフトとして贈るサービスです。 
写真を選ぶだけでつくれるオリジナルフォトギフトをお届けいたします。


◆「OKURU」の４つのポイント◆

①写真を選ぶだけでフォトギフトが作れる
写真を選ぶだけで自動配置されるので、手間のかかる写真レイアウトが必要ありません（手動編集もできます）。
通勤中や、育児や家事の合間など、ちょっとの時間でも作ることができます。

②目的や飾り方に合わせて選べる商品
おうちに飾られた写真が、日々の新しい彩りになるよう、シーンに合わせて選べるフォトギフトを揃えました。
一年中飾れる「フォトカレンダー」、思い出の写真をカタチに変える「フォトグッズ」、成長の記録をキレイに残す「アニバーサリーブック」、お気に入りの一枚を絵画のように飾る「フォトキャンバス」をご用意しています。

③写真が魅力的に見えるデザイン
各商品ごとに、写真が魅力的に見えるデザインをご用意しております。一月に一枚の写真を選ぶだけでかんたんに、思い出のつまったカレンダーを作ることができます。
素材感にもこだわったフォトキャンバスは、とっておきの一枚が素敵な作品に仕上がります。

④ギフトにも使える特製パッケージでお届け
フォトギフトはギフトにもお使いいただけるパッケージに入れてお届けします。大切なご家族の方へのプレゼントにもおすすめです。

Now you can save the world from monsters together with your friends in co-op mode: invite friends to a squad or find new allies using auto-selection.

- Ability to play without internet connection (offline mode)

bluejetty:00090788:ios.description:
Discover how easy it is to learn Tagalog with Turong Wika, your all-in-one Tagalog learning app! Whether you're a language enthusiast, a Filipino yearning to reconnect with your roots, or a traveler exploring the stunning Philippines, Turong Wika is for you.
Whether you want to learn the basics of the Filipino language or dive into Tagalog vocabulary, our app is designed to provide a comprehensive, immersive, and engaging learning experience. Embark on a language learning journey with the unique features that make Turong Wika your go-to learning app for Tagalog or Filipino. 
Key Features: 
- Comprehensive Lessons: Delve into meticulously crafted lessons designed by language experts, ensuring a solid foundation for your learning journey. Covering Tagalog's distinct grammar structure, verb conjugations, vocabulary, pronunciations, and cultural insights, ensuring a well-rounded understanding of the Tagalog language.
- Dictionary: Easily look up words and expand your vocabulary with our extensive dictionary, designed to support your language learning journey.
- Flashcards: Expand your vocabulary by utilizing the Spaced Repetition System (SRS) flashcards to efficiently memorize vocabulary and phrases, promoting long-term retention.
- Practice Drills: Reinforce your learning with interactive practice drills, enabling rapid progress in reading and writing Tagalog.
- Cheat Sheets: Access quick-reference guides of essential Tagalog grammar rules.
Why Choose Turong Wika?
- All-in-One Learning: Learn to speak Filipino or Tagalog in one place. From practice drills to help you become comfortable with the different aspects of the Tagalog language, Flashcards to aid in vocabulary memorization, and Cheat Sheets that serve as quick reference materials.
- Progress Tracking: Stay motivated with visual progress tracking, highlighting your achievements, pinpointing areas for improvement, and keeping you on track toward mastery.
- Offline Access: Learn anytime, anywhere with offline access to lessons and resources, ensuring uninterrupted learning even without an internet connection.
- User-Friendly Interface: Our app is designed with the learner in mind, offering an intuitive and easy-to-navigate experience.
- Regular Updates: We're committed to continually improving Turong Wika, adding new features and content to enhance your learning journey.

bluejetty:00184647:ios.description:
About the TimelessToday App
Discover the power of life’s simplicity through Prem Rawat’s timeless message
Experience clarity and understanding that speaks to your heart, not just your mind
Connect with practical wisdom that celebrates the gift of each breath
Access transformative discourses, stories, and insights anywhere, anytime through your mobile device
Enjoy Prem Rawat’s latest livestreams, replays, Video-by-Request, topic based content, interviews and much more.
This app is designed to bring you the latest content and many treasures filled with inspiration and practical wisdom. Through the TimelessToday platform Prem guides us to understand life’s purpose and to actually know personal peace, not just believe in its possibilities.
The app is free to download with access to hundreds of free audio and video content. Subscription based purchase options provide access to livestreams, full length replays and much more.
For full access to content, TimelessToday brings you reasonably priced subscriptions, giving you access to premium content. We never tire of bringing you new material, livestreams, replays, and more. You can choose a ‘Premier’ (video) or 'Classic' (audio only) subscription to best suit your needs. 
About Prem Rawat
Prem Rawat is a global peace ambassador, humanitarian and New York Times bestselling author. Through his work, he has dedicated his life to promoting peace and well-being across the globe, speaking to audiences in over 100 countries and inspiring millions of people to discover inner peace through books, trainings, web content, media appearances and press coverage, and, above all, his live events and speaking engagements. In 2023 alone Prem Rawat spoke to over 916 million people across all media, including TV, print and radio. His podcast channel, “Life’s Essentials,” has reached audiences in over 110 countries. His previous books, including “Hear Yourself” and “Peace Is Possible,” have been widely praised for their wisdom and insight into the human condition. Prem is an inventor, musician, artist, photographer and an accomplished jet and helicopter pilot with 15,000 hours of flying time. He is married with four adult children and four grandchildren.
Prem’s message is easy to understand and is highly relatable to everyday life. Through The Prem Rawat Foundation, his Peace Education Program has reached hundreds of millions of people from all walks of life – from those wealthy and famous to those facing desperate times. 
About TimelessToday®
TimelessToday is a multi-media company founded in 2016 to produce Prem Rawat’s premium content about the human potential for peace and well-being. Through livestreams, replays, interviews, timeless topics of interest and music, it makes his unique perspective on life available to a global audience anytime, anywhere.
Terms & Conditions
By downloading and using the TimelessToday app, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Please review our policy here: https://timelesstoday.tv/help/legal/terms-and-conditions
Your Feedback
We hope you thoroughly enjoy your TimelessToday experience and we would love to hear from you. Leave feedback within the app under ‘Account / Help & Support’ or via these contact methods:
- Facebook: @timelesstoday
- Website: https://www.timelesstoday.tv
- Help & feedback: customercare@timelesstoday.com
- https://www.instagram.com/TimelessToday
- https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029Va66SaLCRs1qHWJgSV1R
TimelessToday Team

The four friends scrounged up $900 to put a tiny stand in an East Hollywood parking lot. The menu was simple, and the chicken was the star. bluejetty:00076999:ios.description:
Free Text is your all-in-one solution for efficient communication. With Free Text, you can get a second phone number that empowers you to make local and international calls at incredibly affordable rates and send unlimited text messages worldwide. Whether you're connecting with friends and family or conducting business on a global scale, Free Text ensures you stay connected without breaking the bank.
Key Features:
Virtual Phone Numbers: Free Text provides you with virtual phone numbers that are accessible right from your iOS device. These numbers are perfect for maintaining your privacy, managing different aspects of your life, or keeping personal and business communication separate.
Sync Contacts Easily: Seamlessly sync your existing contacts with Free Text, making it effortless to manage your connections within the app. No need to manually enter numbers; everything is at your fingertips.
Multiple Numbers, One Device: With Free Text, you can have multiple virtual phone numbers on a single device. Keep your work, personal, and other texts and calls separate without the hassle of juggling multiple phones.
Spam Blocker: Tired of nuisance calls and messages? Free Text offers a robust Spam Blocker feature to filter out unwanted communications, ensuring you only receive messages and calls from the people and businesses that matter to you.
Call Recording: Never miss an important detail again. Free Text allows you to record calls, helping you keep a comprehensive record of your conversations for future reference or legal purposes.
Group Messaging: Connect with multiple contacts at once by sending group messages. Whether it's coordinating with a team, planning an event, or catching up with friends, Free Text makes group messaging effortless.
Media Sharing: Share pictures and location effortlessly with your contacts with this app. Whether you're sharing vacation photos or guiding a friend to a meeting spot, Free Text makes sharing moments and information simple and secure.
Stay connected, communicate efficiently, and take control of your virtual communication with Free Text's second phone numbers capabilities. Download the app today and start enjoying the convenience of affordable calls, unlimited messaging, and a range of powerful features.

1. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
2. Initial payments are charged to a user's iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
3. Charges for renewal occur within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
4. Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
5. Fair Use Policy - Free Text reserves the right to limit any or all of the above services based on what it deems to be abusive practices, unusually high usage or what Free Text deems as 'Fair Use'.
6. Privacy Policy - https://callweb.io/freetext/privacy_policy.html
7. Terms of use: https://callweb.io/freetext/terms_of_use.html

'Animal Jigsaw Puzzles: Jungle Animals' is a lovely animal jigsaw which enables even very small children to develop observational skills, visual memory, personal achievement, perseverance, fine motor skills and organisation of shapes in space. 
This is a gorgeous jungle, specially designed for children, where the most astonishing animals happily live together: a lion, elephant, monkey, hippo, giraffe, parrot, tiger, rhino, orangutan, snake, zebra and a crocodile.

bluejetty:00186679:ios.description:
Euki is the privacy first period tracker - plus so much more. 
Euki empowers you to take control of your health data and decisions with customizable health tools and learning resources- all with best in class privacy features.
You can give feedback on the App via our anonymous, encrypted survey https://bit.ly/Euki-UX-Survey. And- if you love Euki - please help us by leaving a review in the App Store.
Euki is a non-profit, open source project: co-designed by leading reproductive health researchers, privacy experts, and users like you! 
Learn more or donate to support our work via our website www.eukiapp.org. 
*Privacy. Period.
No Data Collection 
Your data is stored locally (on your device) and nowhere else. 
Data Deletion
You can delete data on the spot or schedule sweeps to remove sensitive information from your phone. 
No Third-Party Tracking
When you use Euki, the only person collecting your data or tracking your activity is YOU.
Anonymity
You don’t need an account, email, or phone number to use Euki. 
PIN Protection
You can set a customizable PIN passcode to protect your Euki data. 
*Track: Take control of your health
Customizable Tracking
Track everything from monthly bleeding to acne, headaches, and cramps. You can also set appointment and medication reminders.
Period Predictions
Know what to expect, when! The more you track, the more accurate the predictions will be.
Cycle Summary
Get a full picture of your cycle, from the average length of your cycle to the duration of each period, with Euki’s cycle summary.
*Learn: Make Empowered Choices About Your Health 
Content Library
Find non-judgmental information about abortion, contraception, sexually transmitted infections, and more—all vetted by health experts
Personal Stories
Discover real, relatable stories about other people’s sexual health experiences
*Search: Find Care Options That Meet Your Needs and Preferences
New Feature (Public Beta): Care Navigator
Search, filter, and save up-to-date information on reproductive health care providers, from telehealth clinics to abortion support hotlines. Note: Although we have tested for privacy and security, this specific feature is in a ‘Public Beta’. This means we will be incorporating your feedback to improve its design and function. Give input via our encrypted, anonymous survey https://bit.ly/Euki-Care-Nav. 
Interactive Quizzes
Take a quick quiz to decide which forms of contraception or other care might be best for you
*Feature Details
Abortion and Miscarriage Support
Learn about different types of abortion and how to find a clinic you can trust
Prepare for a clinic appointment, including what questions to ask a clinician and how to get financial support
Set reminders to help you remember an appointment or when to take your pills
Browse FAQs for answers and explore trusted resources for more information
Read stories from real people who’ve had abortions or miscarriages
Connect with organizations that provide free, confidential legal support
Contraception Information
Decide what matters most to you about contraception—like how often to take it or how to start or stop using it
Access more detailed information about the contraception methods that might work for you
Learn where and how to access your method of choice
Comprehensive Sex Ed
Explore easy-to-understand information on sex, gender, and sexuality
Learn about consent and where you can turn for support
Discover affirming resources that help answer other questions about LGBTQ issues, sex, gender, and health
Euki Takes User Input Seriously 
Share feedback or requests through our anonymous, encrypted User Survey https://bit.ly/Euki-UX-Survey.
Learn about or join our User Advisory Team. 
Reach out on social: IG @eukiapp, TikTok @euki.app
Looking for other support? Email us: eukiapp@protonmail.com.
Love Euki? Please help us by leaving a review in the App Store.

bluejetty:00173159:ios.description:
OBD-2 (On-Board Diagnostics) is a standardized system used in vehicles to monitor and manage various components' performance.
The ultimate OBD-2 scanner app brings the power of car diagnostics with just a tap on your screen. Designed for both car enthusiasts and everyday drivers, the app allows you to diagnose issues, monitor real-time sensor data, and retrieve diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) to pinpoint potential problems.
OBD-2 scanner app supports a wide range of OBD-2 compliant vehicles, ensuring compatibility with most cars manufactured after 1996.
KEY FEATURES:
*Sensor Data - gain access to real-time sensor data and keep a close eye on your car's vital signs.
*Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs) - read and interpret DTCs that are generated by your car's onboard systems when an issue is detected.
*Parameter Identification Codes (PIDs) - PIDs provide detailed information about various systems, allowing you to perform advanced diagnostics and troubleshoot efficiently.
***************
Premium access
To access all the premium features and content, you need to subscribe or pay once for lifetime access. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account.
Subscriptions automatically renew and are billed at the rate and period you choose based on your subscription plan. User accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://thinkaboutapps.com/policy

iPassSafe – Advanced Privacy and Security in Password Management
> WHY IPASSSAFE IS THE SECURE CHOICE?
○ ADVANCED ENCRYPTION: 
iPassSafe uses AES-256 encryption combined with PBKDF2 key strengthening to secure your data. This industry-standard encryption ensures your information is protected from unauthorized access, even if a backup is compromised, offering robust defense against any threats.
○ EXCLUSIVE USE OF APPLE’S OFFICIAL FRAMEWORKS: 
Unlike many competitors that integrate third-party libraries for analytics, push notifications, and other services, iPassSafe relies solely on Apple’s official frameworks. By avoiding external code, iPassSafe minimizes potential security risks and ensures that your data is handled within a highly secure and trusted environment.
○ PRIVACY POLICY: 
Our privacy policy is straightforward—iPassSafe does NOT collect or track ANY user data. iPassSafe stands out by NOT collecting or tracking ANY user data. Unlike most other apps, your information stays completely private and secure, with NO third-party involvement.
○ LOCAL DATA STORAGE WITH SECURE CLOUD SYNC OPTION:
Unlike some popular password managers that have been compromised due to reliance on centralized private clouds, which have faced security breaches, iPassSafe avoids these risks. Your data is stored directly on your device and in your iCloud (optional), benefiting from Apple’s secure infrastructure. This approach makes such breaches impossible and ensures robust privacy and control while offering seamless sync and password autofill across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Safari.
◆ Available on both iOS and macOS!
> TOP SECURITY
○ Utilizes iOS AES-256 encryption to automatically encrypt all your data with a Master Password known only to you
○ All data is stored locally on your device; cloud storage is optional and encrypted
○ Self destruct option after 10 tries
○ Logout timer when inactive
○ Lock timer when using other App
○ Delete clipboard (optional)
○ Strong Built-In Password Generator to create unique passwords
○ Stay anonymous, account creation is not needed
○ Face/Touch ID support
> ALL YOUR DATA
• 24 x Custom categories you can design as you want
• 19 x Built-in categories including:
○ Logins (Web, Email, FTP...)
○ Credit Cards 
○ Photos (from Gallery/Camera)
○ Bank accounts details 
○ Safe/PIN numbers 
○ Text notes 
○ Documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PPT ...)
○ Contacts with Build-it call/send email option
○ ID cards
○ Passports
○ Driving License
○ Software License
> SYNC/BACKUP
○ 4 Sync options: iCloud, FTP, AirDrop (Files,Dropbox, iOS devices ...)
○ All data get encrypted before sync
> ADVANCED FEATURES
○ Safari extension support 
○ AutoFill extension support
○ Icons pulled in from any of your websites automatically !
○ Seamlessly autofill usernames and passwords directly from the QuickType bar to apps and Safari
○ Contact import from Address Book
○ Built-in search tool

bluejetty:00179761:ios.name: Poker AI - Game & Strategy
bluejetty:00179761:ios.summary: Texas Hold'em poker is a popular and widely studied problem in the fields of Game Theory and Artificial Intelligence. Algorithms such as Tree Search, Regret Minimization, Reinforcement Learning and Neural Networks have been developed to sol
bluejetty:00179761:ios.description:
Texas Hold'em poker is a popular and widely studied problem in the fields of Game Theory and Artificial Intelligence. Algorithms such as Tree Search, Regret Minimization, Reinforcement Learning and Neural Networks have been developed to solve poker. Nevertheless, solving multiplayer no-limit Texas Hold'em in real time remains a major challenge considering its vast combination of possible states and the existence of hidden information.
Based on Regret Minimization algorithms, we developed an innovative solving architecture that combines multi-stage Pre-training, Parallel Sampling, Equilibrium Finding, Dynamic Programming, State Abstraction, Encoding-Decoding and Edge Computing. Powered by our built-in AI engine, we present you Poker AI, a fast and accurate Texas Hold'em strategy solver that runs in real time on edge devices with limited computing resources.
We are also working on a neural network version of Poker AI using Self-playing, Reinforcement Learning and Deep Neural Networks, which may help avoid errors introduced by abstraction and encoding-decoding, and be more robust in long-tail scenarios that rarely occur. We will release the neural network version when its performance surpasses that of the regret minimization version in our evaluation tests.
Key Features of Poker AI:
·Offline and online poker with robots and human players.
Talk is cheap, the best way to improve your poker skills is simple and straight: play as much as you can! With Poker AI, you can start a game anytime, anywhere, with or without an internet connection, against bots or humans, and without risking any real money!
·Real-time strategy solver and win rate tools.
With our built-in AI engine, you can customize your poker scenarios and calculate strategies based on Nash equlibrium efficiently and intuitively. By combining pre-trained backbone strategies with edge computing optimizations, strategies and win rates for up to 10 players can be solved within seconds.

bluejetty:00184614:ios.description:
The best way to enjoy all of your favorite Internet radio stations wherever you go.
⁕ In Your Pocket ⁕
Triode goes where you go with your iPhone and iPad. The elegant interface keeps your favorite stations right at your fingertips.
⁕ From Your Couch ⁕
Listen with our Apple TV app and use AirPlay 2 to listen anywhere in your home including HomePod.
⁕ In Your Car ⁕
Road trip, anyone? Enjoy your favorite stations while driving. CarPlay and Siri Shortcuts means no fumbling with controls.
⁕ At The Office ⁕
Triode brings one intuitive experience to all your devices, including your desktop computer.
⁕ Limitless Choices ⁕
Start with Our Picks – a curated roster of the best news and music from around the world. Just a tap to discover new sounds from New Orleans to London and beyond.
You can also search thousands of broadcast stations by genre, name, city, or call letters. Find your favorite iTunes Radio station or set up things manually using a URL if that’s your thing.
⁕ Sync Up ⁕
iCloud syncs your favorite stations seamlessly across every device. Handoff lets you move seamlessly between your iPhone & Mac so you won’t miss a beat or the latest news.
⁕ And More! ⁕
Supports Apple Music and iTunes Store:
 • Learn more about an artist
 • Purchase a streaming song
 • Update your playlists
Listen Privately - No signup. We don’t want your email, phone number, or even an account. Nothing.
Presentation Mode - Tap to hide Triode’s controls for a distraction-free view. Tap again and they come back.
Looks Great Everywhere - From the iPhone SE to a Pro Max, Triode looks great. A universal app that’s designed with you in mind.
⁕ Free with No Ads ⁕
Triode is completely free to use. We don't put any ads in the interface or add them to the audio. An inexpensive subscription improves your experience with these options:
 • Add Favorites - Your favorite stations are synced across all devices.
 • High Quality Artwork - When available, album cover art is clean and crisp.
Triode is optimized for each platform you run it on: no web players masquerading as an app. Designed with full support for all the things that make Apple products great.
A single purchase gets you access to everything you see above.
--
Triode uses auto-renewing subscriptions. The subscription provides additional features like high-quality artwork and favorites. The subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of your subscription period and will be charged through your iTunes account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time from your iTunes account settings. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.
Terms of Use: https://triode.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://triode.app/privacy

bluejetty:00166235:ios.description:
Have you considered quitting smoking? Whether you’ve already quit smoking or you’re still thinking about it, QuitNow PRO will help you quit tobacco for good.
Quitting smoking is one of the best decisions you can make for your health: it reduces your risk of disease, you regain energy, you save money, and you also protect the people around you. But the truth is, quitting isn’t easy.
That’s where QuitNow PRO comes in.
QuitNow PRO was born in 2011, created by a smoker who wanted to quit. Since then, we’ve grown, brought in addiction specialists, and refined our tools so you can quit tobacco for good:
YOUR EX-SMOKER STATUS
When you quit smoking, it’s important to clearly see what you’re achieving. That’s why on QuitNow PRO’s home screen you’ll see how long it’s been since you last smoked, how many cigarettes you haven’t smoked, how much money you’ve saved, and how much life you’ve regained.
COMMUNITY: THE EX-SMOKERS’ CHAT
Having a smoke-free environment is crucial when you quit. QuitNow PRO offers a chat full of people who, like you, have said goodbye to tobacco. Sharing your journey with other ex-smokers will make your path easier.
LIVE SESSIONS WITH AN EXPERT
Every month we host a live session with a smoking-cessation expert. In these sessions, the psychologist explains the best way to quit smoking and answers attendees’ questions live. These sessions are a unique opportunity to get personalized advice and resolve doubts in real time.
A COMPLETE COURSE TO QUIT SMOKING
Some people prefer a more structured method when they quit. That’s why QuitNow PRO includes a step-by-step course designed to guide you throughout the entire quitting process. It works like a digital book, but integrated inside the app.
MILESTONES: SMALL MOTIVATIONS TO QUIT SMOKING
As with any task in life, quitting is easier when you break the challenge into smaller goals. That’s why QuitNow PRO offers 80 milestones based on the cigarettes you’ve avoided, the days you’ve gone without smoking, and the money you’ve saved. This way, you can start celebrating your wins from day one.
YOUR HEALTH AS AN EX-SMOKER
In QuitNow PRO you’ll find a list of health indicators that show how your body improves day by day. These indicators are the same ones published by the World Health Organization, and we update them as soon as the WHO does.
Plus, QuitNow PRO includes other sections designed to help you on your journey to quit smoking.
QUITNOW AI
Whenever questions come up during your quitting process, you can turn to QuitNow PRO AI. It’s designed to provide clear, reliable information, based on our course and on data from the World Health Organization.
BOOKS TO HELP YOU QUIT SMOKING
Learning techniques and approaches to quit can make the process much easier. That’s why we’ve selected well-known books that can effectively help you on your path to a tobacco-free life.
ALSO ON YOUR WATCH
QuitNow PRO’s Apple Watch app and its widgets and tiles let you track your progress, see how much you’ve saved, and check your smoke-free stats right from your wrist.
Because we dedicate so much time and effort to it, we firmly believe QuitNow PRO is the best app to quit smoking. As always, there’s room for improvement—so if you have any idea to make QuitNow PRO even better, please write to us at ios@quitnow.app.
We truly hope QuitNow PRO supports you on your journey to a tobacco-free life.
Terms of Service: https://tos.quitnow.app/eula
Privacy Policy: https://tos.quitnow.app/privacypolicy

Helpling is an innovative online marketplace, helping you to connect with insured domestic cleaners. With our app, you can find and book insured domestic cleaners in your area and conveniently manage your bookings. Simply create a profile or use your existing Helpling customer details to access the app. The Helpling app is only available for customers in Germany, France, United Kingdom, Ireland, Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland, Australia and Singapore.
** How Helpling works **
1. Enter your postcode to see if there are any cleaners in your area
2. Choose frequency, duration and date
3. Enter your contact information
4. The cleaner will attend on the agreed date once confirmed
- Features -
+ Convenient booking process: To make a new booking, just tell us when and how often you need your cleaner and we’ll match you with insured cleaners available for your appointment/s.
+ Profiles of cleaners: When making a new booking, you'lll see profiles of the available cleaners, including ratings and reviews from current and previous customers. 
+ Overview of all your appointments: See all your upcoming appointments to help you plan your schedule.
+ Reschedule your appointments: You can now amend your appointments individually or in bulk.
+ Chat with your cleaner: You can chat with your cleaner at anytime using our integrated chat feature.
+ Secure online payments: Pay securely with any major credit/debit card. You’ll receive your electronic invoice via email after the payment has been processed.
---------------------------------------------------------
For more information please visit https://www.helpling.co.uk or contact us via email: apps@helpling.com.

bluejetty:00091362:ios.description:
The ZYRTEC® AllergyCast® app is your go-to allergy tracker and pollen forecast tool, eliminating the guesswork in managing allergies. Using local data like pollen count, air quality and weather, it provides a personalized allergy impact score, predicting how your seasonal allergies will make you feel each day. Think of it as a "real-feel" forecast for your allergies!
Wondering about today's pollen count? Get that and more at your fingertips with AllergyCast®. Beyond just pollen counts, the app offers personalized daily symptom severity predictions. Sign in, track your symptoms, and unlock personalized predictions that get more accurate over time.
When you start using the app, you'll receive a local pollen forecast and a generalized symptom severity prediction. Consistently log your symptoms for more personalized predictions. Each day you’ll receive daily allergy symptom severity predictions and multi-day forecasts, factoring in your tracked symptoms and local weather.
Did AllergyCast® predict a "Mild" day? Enjoy less sniffling. "Severe" symptoms predicted? You may want to be prepared. 
AllergyCast® App features include:
- Multi-day forecasts for symptom severity predictions, pollen, weather, and air quality based on your current location.
- Interactive pollen & air quality maps to see the pollen and air quality levels along with the top allergens in your area.
- An enhanced allergy symptom tracker & personalized Allergy Profile.
- Personalized allergy insights to learn which specific pollens may be triggers for your outdoor allergies.
- Trends based on your tracked symptoms, including a personalized Allergy Profile.
- Exclusive savings, coupons & offers for ZYRTEC® products.

bluejetty:00158473:ios.summary: Ti Koze Ak TT se yon aplikasyon mobil ki pèmèt ou rete konekte ak Thériel Thélus (TT) ansanm ak kominote Ti Koze Ak TT a. Li pèmèt ou rete enfòme, patisipe nan diskisyon, oswa amize ou, aplikasyon sa a pote tout sa ou renmen sou TT dirèktem
bluejetty:00158473:ios.description:
Ti Koze Ak TT se yon aplikasyon mobil ki pèmèt ou rete konekte ak Thériel Thélus (TT) ansanm ak kominote Ti Koze Ak TT a. Li pèmèt ou rete enfòme, patisipe nan diskisyon, oswa amize ou, aplikasyon sa a pote tout sa ou renmen sou TT dirèkteman gras ak telefòn ou.
TI KOZE AK TT la pou ede moun wè pi klè sou aktyalite politik, sosyal ak ekonomik Peyi dAyiti. Li pèmèt ou aprann epi pratike lang Kreyòl Ayisyen an atravè konvèsasyon enteresan pandan w ap fòme ak enfòme. Aplikasyon an kapab ofri w tou anpil bèl bagay tankou: egzèsis ak diskisyon sou diferan sijè pou ede itilizatè yo amelyore konpreyansyon yo sou tout sa k ap pase nan Peyi dAyiti ak rès mond lan.
Ou ka koute radyo an dirèk, kote ou jwenn dènye nouvèl yo, analiz enpòtan, ak diskisyon sou sijè cho yo. Ou kapab tou gade emisyon an dirèk, san w pa janm rate yon konvèsasyon enteresan, yon entèvyou, oswa yon evènman espesyal oubyen tande bèl mizik.
Pou moun ki renmen defi, aplikasyon an gen kesyonè, kote ou ka teste konesans ou, touche pwen, epi konpetisyon ak lòt itilizatè yo. Plis ou patisipe, se plis ou monte sou klasman lidè yo, ki ba w chans pou w vin youn nan pi bon lidè kominote Ti Koze Ak TT a, san konte ou ka genyen prim tou nan chak fen mwa. 
Anplis sa, aplikasyon sa a se yon espas kote ou ka pale ak TT, pataje opinyon ou, epi angaje w nan diskisyon ki enpòtan yo.
Telechaje Ti Koze Ak TT jodi a epi dekouvri pi bon fason pou w rete enfòme, amize ou, epi rete konekte ak nou.

bluejetty:00167591:ios.name: MyTummy: Intuitive Eating
bluejetty:00167591:ios.summary:
*** Discover Intuitive Eating and Build a Healthy Relationship with Food! ***
Take control of your nutrition with an easy-to-use meal plan that helps you organize daily eating habits—your personalized meal plan keeps you on track every day
bluejetty:00167591:ios.description:
*** Discover Intuitive Eating and Build a Healthy Relationship with Food! ***
Take control of your nutrition with an easy-to-use meal plan that helps you organize daily eating habits—your personalized meal plan keeps you on track every day. Record your dietary choices in a dedicated food journal, making it simple to reflect on progress and keep your food journal updated with each meal. Monitor everything you eat with a detailed food log, ensuring your food log stays accurate while syncing with your meal plan and food journal for a complete overview.
Welcome to My Tummy, your go-to app for intuitive eating! This is your personal, judgment-free space to explore your unique relationship with food. Forget rigid diets, calorie counting, or what you "should" be eating—this app is designed to help you make food choices that feel good for your body and mind. It's time to tune into your inner hunger cues and nourish yourself in a way that feels right for YOU.
In My Tummy, you can label your meals however you want and even use customizable tags to track how different foods make you feel. It’s all about empowerment, not restriction!
*** Why Choose Intuitive Eating? ***
Do any of these sound familiar?
You might benefit from intuitive eating if you:
- Find yourself being overly critical about your food choices.
- Mindlessly snack without genuinely enjoying your meals.
- Feel overwhelmed by calorie counting or strict diets.
- Eat out of stress or emotions rather than hunger.
- If you nod along, you're not alone—and My Tummy can help!
*** Intuitive Tools to Support Your Journey! ***
My Tummy offers a variety of tools to guide you on your intuitive eating journey:
- Daily Food Tracker – Log your meals and feelings to understand your eating habits better.
- Digestion Timer – Monitor how long it takes for your food to digest and improve body awareness.
- Daily Journal – Reflect on your emotions, cravings, and overall well-being.
- Food Tags – Customize how you label foods to match your personal experiences.
These tools will help you better understand your body’s signals, without any judgment or pressure. Simply observe, reflect, and enjoy the process!
*** Join Our Community – See What People Are Saying! ***
Still trying to decide if My Tummy is right for you? Check out the glowing reviews from our users! They love the app because it helps them develop a positive relationship with food and can do the same for you. Whether you're just starting your intuitive eating journey or looking for extra support, this app provides all the necessary tools and guidance.
My Tummy is completely FREE with all premium features available for the first 7 days at NO COMMITMENT. Take this time to see if it's the right fit for you. After that, you can get a LIFETIME premium membership for just $5!

bluejetty:00088716:ios.description:
Mixx by Yas est une plateforme financière qui vous facilite la gestion de votre argent. Que vous ayez besoin d'envoyer de l'argent, de payer des factures, d'acheter des forfaits ou d'économiser, Mixx by Yas vous permet de tout gérer en toute sécurité et efficacité depuis une seule application.
Principales fonctionnalités :
• Transferts d'argent instantanés : Envoyez et recevez de l'argent en toute sécurité à tout moment. Transférez de l'argent vers d'autres comptes Mixx by Yas, des comptes bancaires ou des portefeuilles électroniques au Togo.
• Paiement de factures simplifié : Payez vos factures directement depuis l'application, sans avoir à vous rendre dans un centre de paiement.
• Paiement avec QR Codes : Effectuez vos achats dans les magasins au Togo en scannant les QR codes Mixx by Yas. Ce moyen vous permet de payer en toute sécurité sans utiliser de l’argent liquide.
• Crédit et forfaits : Achetez du crédit et des forfaits de données instantanément. Choisissez parmi les forfaits disponibles pour avoir toujours suffisamment de données pour naviguer sur internet ou de minutes pour appeler.
• Sécurisé et facile à utiliser :
• Limites mensuelles de compte : Définissez des limites de dépenses pour mieux gérer votre budget.
• Vérification biométrique : Utilisez votre empreinte digitale ou la reconnaissance faciale pour un accès sécurisé.
• Authentification par code PIN : Assurez la sécurité de vos transactions avec un code PIN.
• Historique des transactions : Consultez un historique détaillé des paiements, transferts et autres transactions à tout moment.
• Self Onboarding : Ouvrez un compte Mixx by Yas directement via la Super App, disponible pour tous les réseaux au Togo.
Autorisations nécessaires :
• Accès à la localisation : Nécessaire pour localiser les agents, agences ou commerçants proches qui acceptent les paiements Mixx by Yas.
• Accès à la caméra : Requis pour scanner les QR codes lors des paiements ou des transactions avec les commerçants.
• Accès aux contacts : Cette fonctionnalité vous permet de sélectionner facilement des contacts enregistrés pour les transactions, évitant ainsi la saisie manuelle des numéros de compte.
Confidentialité et sécurité des données :
Mixx by Yas garantit la confidentialité de vos données, en collectant uniquement ce qui est nécessaire pour fournir ses services et en respectant les règles de protection des données. Toutes les données financières, informations personnelles et détails de l'application sont cryptés et stockés en toute sécurité, conformément aux normes les plus strictes.
Support :
Pour toute question ou assistance, contactez le support Mixx by Yas via l'application, ou appelez le 888 (Coût : 20 FTTC) ou par mail : MixxByYas@yas.tg ou rejoins-nous sur nos réseaux sociaux :
- Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/YasinTogo 
- Instagram : https://instagram.com/yas_togo 
- X : https://x.com/YasTogo/ 
Siège social :
Place de la Réconciliation, quartier Atchanté,
BP 333 Lomé-TOGO

bluejetty:00062750:ios.name: TeachMe Anatomy: 3D Human Body
bluejetty:00062750:ios.summary:
Learn human anatomy with Teach Me Anatomy, a comprehensive learning resource for medical students, healthcare professionals and anyone studying the human body.
Explore detailed anatomy articles, interactive 3D models, clinical illustration
bluejetty:00062750:ios.description:
Learn human anatomy with Teach Me Anatomy, a comprehensive learning resource for medical students, healthcare professionals and anyone studying the human body.
Explore detailed anatomy articles, interactive 3D models, clinical illustrations, dissection images, quizzes and flashcards – all designed to make complex anatomy easier to understand and remember.
ABOUT TEACH ME ANATOMY
Based on the Teach Me Anatomy website, our app combines clear anatomical explanations with clinical knowledge to help you understand the human body and apply what you learn.
Whether you're preparing for anatomy exams, revising for medical school or refreshing your clinical knowledge, Teach Me Anatomy brings everything together in one place.
FEATURES
600+ ANATOMY ARTICLES
Explore detailed, easy-to-read guides written and peer-reviewed by doctors. Learn regional, systemic and clinically relevant anatomy.
750+ INTERACTIVE 3D ANATOMY MODELS
Visualise anatomical structures in three dimensions. Rotate and explore models to understand the relationships between bones, muscles, nerves, blood vessels and organs.
2,000+ HD ANATOMY ILLUSTRATIONS
Study detailed, full-colour anatomical diagrams that simplify complex structures and relationships.
120+ REAL DISSECTION IMAGES
Connect textbook anatomy with real human anatomy through labelled dissection images.
1,900+ ANATOMY QUIZ QUESTIONS
Test your knowledge with multiple-choice anatomy questions and detailed explanations. Consolidate your learning and identify areas for improvement.
2,500+ ANATOMY FLASHCARDS
Revise important anatomical concepts using flashcards and spaced repetition to support long-term retention.
PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS
Track your quiz performance, identify weaker topics and focus your revision where it matters most.
OFFLINE ACCESS
Study anatomy anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection. Access anatomy articles, illustrations and quiz questions offline, making it easy to learn wherever you are.
CLINICAL ANATOMY
Understand the clinical relevance of anatomical structures with integrated medical explanations and examples.
EXPLORE THE HUMAN BODY
Study regional anatomy, including the head and neck, brain and nervous system, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, back, upper limb and lower limb. Explore anatomy by body system, including the skeletal, muscular, cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, nervous and lymphatic systems.
AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH AND SPANISH
Study anatomy in English or Spanish, with content automatically displayed in your device's language.
TEACH ME ANATOMY PRO
Teach Me Anatomy offers Pro membership through an in-app subscription. Teach Me Anatomy Pro provides cross-platform, ad-free access to premium learning resources, including 3D anatomy models, anatomy quizzes and flashcards.
Subscriptions are available on monthly, quarterly or annual plans. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, at the applicable subscription price.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal at any time through your Apple Account subscription settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.
If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Terms of Service: https://teachmeanatomy.info/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00174464:ios.name: Lines Universal Orlando
bluejetty:00174464:ios.summary: LINES will help you save time and money during your Universal Orlando trip. Because we’re independent travel writers, we can tell you what Universal can’t, from actual waits in line, to which park will be less crowded every day of your trip
bluejetty:00174464:ios.description:
LINES will help you save time and money during your Universal Orlando trip. Because we’re independent travel writers, we can tell you what Universal can’t, from actual waits in line, to which park will be less crowded every day of your trip.
LINES features include:
-Both Universal’s currently posted wait time at every attraction and how long you’ll REALLY wait in line, based on our experience and that of thousands of families on the same ride. 
-New “Ride Now” and “Wait to Ride” recommendations to show whether waits are going up or down at your favorite rides.
-Customized step-by-step touring plans for both Universal Studios Florida and Islands of Adventure parks, including The Wizarding World of Harry Potter areas. You tell LINES which rides you want to see, and LINES will create a step-by-step itinerary showing when to go to each ride to avoid long lines. You can even change your plans while you’re in the park!
-A Crowd Calendar showing you how busy each park will be over the next ten days.
-Universal’s official app doesn’t show you the waits for many attractions or character greetings. LINES has wait times for more rides, shows, and character greetings than even Universal’s own app.
-Ask questions and get fast answers from our online community of 120,000 theme park experts.
-Menus and prices for every restaurant, kiosk, food stand, and cart in all of Universal Orlando Resort – more than 4,500 things to eat! Every menu is searchable – you can find every steak in Islands of Adventure or throughout the parks, CityWalk, and the official Universal Orlando Resort Hotels!
Our theme park trip planning tools have been featured in USA Today, the New York Times, FOX News and dozens of other newspapers, magazines, television and radio shows. Since 1986, we’ve helped more than 3 million families plan their vacations.
Note: Some LINES features, such as the crowd calendar and wait times, require an in-app subscription purchase to access. Other LINES features, such as customized touring plans, menus, and viewing chat forums, are completely free. Your in-app subscription includes 365 days of access to TouringPlans.com, the Web’s most popular subscription-based site for theme park trip planning.

bluejetty:00173952:android.description:
The Teeniepings who caused a ruckus at Harmony Village are now here!
They are causing a commotion with pranks here, too!
Hurry! Transform into a princess with 'Catch! Ping AR' and find the Teeniepings and send them to the Emotion Kingdom!
■ Teenieping Catch ■
- Find and catch the Teeniepings hidden everywhere!
- Look around and find hidden Teeniepings and touch Teenie Heartwings!
- Transform yourself to all the Princess forms you met in the animation from Princess Heart to Princess Veronica!
※ Each princess is more powerful against specific Teeniepings! Choose a princess that's right for the job! 
- It's time to go back to home~ Piri Piri Catchring~! Send the Teenieping you caught into the cube!
■ Play a Special Volleyball, Teenieping Volleyball ■
- Play a volleyball with Teeniepings you caught!
- Play it by yourself or with your friends as 1 by 1!
■ Curious about the Teeniepings you've caught? Cube Collection ■
- The Teeniepings caught in fierce battle are kept in the cube.
- Check out more information on the Teeniepings you've caught in the cube collection, and carefully take them out again!
- Call your Teeniepings with AR and create a fond memory by making a video together~!
■ Teenieping House, a place for Royal Teeniepings! ■
- A royal Teenieping who helps Romi transform into a princess! This is their secret place!
- The Teenieping House that was only available in toy stores is now on your smartphone!
- You can use AR to bring up the Teenieping House right in front of your eyes!
■ Emotion Kingdom, hometown of Romi and Teeniepings ■
- Want to see the Teeniepings who returned to the Emotion Kingdom? Now, it's our turn to go play!
- Emotion Kingdom, where you can enjoy a variety of interactive objects!
With 360-degree imaging, let's take a look around the Emotion Kingdom.
■ Create an Unique Video with Romi, Romi AR ■
- Why don't you summon Romi through Augmented Reality(AR)?
- Romi will take various poses for you! Record the video with her and make an unique video by yourself!
Please read the following before you play 'Catch! Ping AR'!
 1. AR is used in Teenieping Catch, Cube Collection, Teenieping House AR and Romi AR.
 - AR may cause you to collide with nearby objects and the surrounding environment. If this app is used by a child, consent and supervision by a guardian, such as a parent, are required.
 2. If you want a refund for products purchased through in-app purchase (IAP), please be sure to read the precautions below:
 - Because in-app products are digital content, refund claims (withdrawal of subscription) may be restricted.
 - A full refund can be made if you request it within 7 days of purchasing the product and it has not been used. However, refunds will be declined if the product has already been used.
 - If an in-app purchase was made by a minor without the consent of his/her legal guardian, such as a parent, the purchase can be refunded only once.
 - To prevent indiscriminate in-app purchases by minors such as children, please be sure to activate security settings such as verification and password for payments.
3. The following permissions are required to smoothly play 'Catch! Teenieping AR'.
 [Essential]
 ▶ Camera: Space recognition and video recording
 ▶ Microphone: Record audio while shooting video on Romi AR
 [Optional]
 ▶ Photo and Video: Save recorded video
4. We strongly suggest you play with your Google account via Google Play Games. You can play as a guest but your play data could be removed if you uninstall the application or play on the other device.
 If you have any issues related to your account, especially linking your guest and Google account, capture the screenshot from setting menu and send it to our customer service on below.
Please send your inquiries about refunds or other matters to the email address below!
- support@anipen.com
AUGMENTED LIFE BEYOND TECHNOLOGY, ANIPEN
