bluejetty:00114692:ios.description:
Postal Vote BD is the official mobile application developed by the Bangladesh Election Commission to enroll voters and track ballot papers only at home and abroad. However, voters will exercise their voting by manually casting vote in a postal ballot paper sent by postal services. Voters will send this ballot paper by postal service to concerned electoral official(s) in Bangladesh. This secure and verified platform enables eligible voters to exercise their democratic rights conveniently from anywhere.
CURRENT FEATURES:
- Enrollment & Registration
Start enrollment directly from the app. Simply provide registered mobile number to create a secure profile.
- Voter Enrollment:
Complete verification through a secure eKYC process, followed by a facial verification with liveness detection to confirm voter identity. User can also provide passport details (optional) and postal address for receive postal ballot.
- Ballot Tracking:
Once voters are registered and verified, a ballot is prepared and sent to your registered postal address(obtained during enrolment process). Voter can track the delivery status of ballot within the app to ensure safe and timely arrival.
- Ballot Return and Verification:
After receiving a ballot, simply scan the QR code printed on the enve using the app. Complete a quick liveness check, cast a vote on the paper ballot, and return the envelope to voter designated constituency for official processing.
- Notifications & Reminders
Receive timely alerts about deadlines, application status, and important updates.
- Multi-language Support
Available in both Bangla and English for convenience of voters.
- Notifications & Reminders
Receive timely alerts about deadlines, application status, and important updates.
- Multi-language Support
Available in both Bangla and English for convenience of voters.
PREREQUISITE:
- A registered mobile number
- A valid National ID (NID) card
- A valid passport (Optional)
- A valid postal address
WHO CAN USE THIS APP:
- Bangladeshi elligible voters living abroad
- Government officials on duty
- Members of law enforcing agencies
- Electoral officials
- Other eligible voters as per Bangaldesh Election Commission guidelines
SECURITY & PRIVACY:
Data security is the top most priority. Postal Vote BD mobile application follows strict government data protection protocols. All personal information is securely stored and processed in accordance with Bangladesh's data protection regulations.
OFFICIAL & VERIFIED:
This is the only official postal voting app authorized by the Bangladesh Election Commission. Beware of fraudulent applications.
SUPPORT:
For assistance, please contact:
Email: info@ocv.gov.bd
Contact:

bluejetty:00152784:ios.description:
Step into the world of Mahjong Slide: Zen, where relaxation and entertainment come together in a fun mahjong matching experience. This exciting game offers endless play in a calm and friendly setting, ideal for relaxing after a busy day or giving your brain a workout. It turns leisure time into moments of discovery and enjoyment.
Why choose Mahjong Slide: Zen
- Peaceful Enjoyment: Immerse yourself in a calm and relaxing environment that makes playing Mahjong Slide: Zen, a joy. This game is designed to bring you happiness and relaxation every step of the way.
- Adaptable Challenges: Whether you're beginner or experienced, it has diferent levels for players: Normal, Hard, and Expert. Each level is crafted to match your skill and keep your mind active.
- Helpful Guidance: Need help finding your next move? Helpful hints are provided to guide you through tough spots, ensuring you can solve puzzles without frustration.
- Inventive Gameplay: Enjoy thousands of levels that offer endless fun and unique challenges. Each level is designed to keep you interested and wanting to play more.
- Diverse Styles: Make your gaming experience more exciting with different themes and backgrounds. It lets you customize your play, making each session visually refreshing.
- Train Your Brain: Challenge your mind and improve your thinking skills with various difficult levels. It offers not just entertainment but also a chance to train your brain.
- Play Anywhere, Anytime: Enjoy gaming without timers or pressure. Play offline on any device, like a phone or tablet, without needing Wi-Fi. Your ideal escape is always ready for you.
How to Play
- Tile Matching: match unblocked tiles vertically and horizontally to clear them and enjoy strategic gameplay.
- Tile Movement: Drag tiles to their suitable spots, controlling every move with precision.
- Score Breaking: Push yourself to beat your previous scores, adding excitement to each game.
- Smart Assistance: Use hints to find hidden spots and make better choices.
- Victory Awaits: Clear the board to win and feel the satisfaction of your success.
Experience the exquisite journey Mahjong Slide: Zen, offers, inviting you to explore a world filled with wonder and delight. Embark on this remarkable mahjong adventure and discover the joy of endless possibilities!

bluejetty:00087918:ios.description:
Your digital companion for better recovery
The myrecovery app helps your care team create a digital treatment companion designed to guide and support you through every stage of your treatment journey. Whether you’re preparing for surgery, recovering from injury, or working through rehabilitation, myrecovery keeps you informed, motivated, and confident — every step of the way.
With myrecovery, you can:
* Watch short videos that explain what to expect before, during, and after treatment
* Follow interactive exercise guides and self-care tools tailored to your care plan
* Set and track your recovery goals easily within the app
* Stay connected with your care team for guidance and updates
Getting started is simple. You may receive an email or text message from your care team with a link or unique 6-digit PIN to register quickly. In some cases, your surgeon or healthcare provider may direct you to an online form where you can register for the right care pathway. Once you’ve registered, simply sign in with your email and password to begin your recovery journey.
The myrecovery app is here to support you every step of the way - empowering you to take an active role in your health, stay on track, and recover with confidence.
Your data and safety are our top priorities. 
The myrecovery app and your care team’s secure dashboard are built and maintained under our Hopper Healthcare™ Quality and Information Security Management Systems — meeting internationally recognised standards: ISO 13485 (Quality Management), ISO 27001, and HITRUST r2 (Information Security). This ensures that your personal information and health data are protected with the highest level of care and security throughout your journey.
Join thousands of patients who are using myrecovery to take control of their recovery experience and feel more supported along the way.
Download myrecovery today — and empower your healing journey.

bluejetty:00177090:ios.description:
Take the security of your data into your own hands. Cryptomator encrypts your files before they reach the cloud — so only you hold the key. Not your cloud provider, not us, no one.
Most cloud providers encrypt your data only during transmission, or they keep the decryption keys themselves — keys that can be stolen, copied, or misused. With Cryptomator, the key to your data stays in your hands.
EASY TO USE
Cryptomator is a simple tool for digital self-defense. Protect your cloud data yourself, independently.
• Assign a password to a folder — we call it a vault. That's all: no key creation, no registration, no configuration
• Unlock vaults with Face ID / Touch ID
• Fully integrated into the Files app — browse and open your encrypted files right where you already manage them
• Everything you save into a vault is encrypted automatically
COMPATIBLE
Cryptomator works with the most commonly used cloud storages and is available for all major operating systems.
• Compatible with iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint (incl. Microsoft Teams), pCloud, Box, WebDAV- and S3-based cloud storage services
• Create vaults in any location via other File Providers (third-party apps must support this)
• Access the same vaults across all your mobile devices and computers
SECURE & TRUSTWORTHY
You don't have to trust Cryptomator blindly, because it is open source software — everyone can see the code: https://github.com/cryptomator/ios
• No backdoors and no expiration date, thanks to open source
• File content and filename encryption with AES and 256 bit key length
• Vault password secured with scrypt for enhanced brute-force resistance
• Independently audited by security researchers; crypto implementation publicly documented
If someone looks into the folder in your cloud, they cannot draw any conclusions about your data.
AWARD-WINNING
Cryptomator received the CeBIT Innovation Award 2016 for Usable Security and Privacy.
CRYPTOMATOR COMMUNITY
Join the Cryptomator Community and participate in the conversations with other Cryptomator users:
• Community: https://community.cryptomator.org
• Mastodon: @cryptomator@mastodon.online
---

bluejetty:00186638:ios.description:
Master French verb conjugations with the most complete reference on the App Store.
Search 1000 verbs across 17 tenses — from présent to subjonctif passé — with results available offline. Exact matches always surface first. Audio pronunciation, example sentences, and translations in 14+ languages make it a complete learning tool.
KEY FEATURES
● 1000 verbs across 17 tenses — indicative, subjunctive, conditional, imperative, and more
● Practice with flashcards — build a deck from your favourites, all verbs or irregular verbs, and review a few each day
● Audio pronunciation for every conjugation — hear exactly how each verb is pronounced
● Example sentences — see how verbs are used in real-world context
● Powerful search — find any verb instantly, with exact matches shown first
● iCloud sync — save favourites and access them across all your devices
● Favourites & history — bookmark verbs you use often and quickly revisit recent lookups
● Translations in 14+ languages — see translations in your native language
● Export, copy & print — share conjugation tables via email, clipboard, or print
● Works offline — conjugation data is stored on your device
● iPad optimised — full support for iPad including landscape split-screen view
● Regular & irregular verb indicators — quickly see whether a verb follows standard patterns
WHAT USERS SAY
"This app is excellent! It has almost every verb I have needed to find and makes it so easy to find them"
"Essential for studying French — comprehensive verbs collection in various tenses. Love the audio."
---
This is the free, ad-supported version. Upgrade to French Verbs Pro for an ad-free experience.

bluejetty:00138490:ios.description:
Introducing the reading app designed specifically for grade 2 kids to expand their reading skills and knowledge, spark their curiosity, and foster a love for reading while covering a wide range of subjects! Dive into captivating stories, fascinating science topics, enchanting folktales, essential social-emotional learning, English language arts, vocabulary building, health topics, community, holidays and festivals, and ecosystem exploration, all in one interactive platform.
With this reading app for grade 2 kids, young readers embark on a thrilling journey through colorful and engaging stories that not only entertain but also educate. From whimsical adventures to insightful science explorations, each book is carefully curated to align with grade 2 curriculum standards and ignite young minds.
Features:
Vast Library: Access a diverse collection of books covering stories, science, folktales, social-emotional learning, English language arts, vocabulary building, health topics, professions, science, space, and ecosystems.
Human Narration: Each book is read aloud in a human expressive voice to maximize engagement and retention.
Educational Content: Explore topics like ecosystems, social interactions, health habits, and more, presented in a child-friendly and age-appropriate manner.
Offline Reading: Download books to read offline, enabling uninterrupted learning anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection.
Immersive Audio-Visual Experience: Enjoy vibrant illustrations, enchanting narrations, and captivating animations that bring stories to life and make learning a joyous experience.
Whether your child is exploring the wonders of science, delving into imaginative stories, or learning about important life skills, this app provides a fun, and educational platform that nurtures a lifelong love for reading and learning in grade 2 children. Download the app today and embark on an exciting literary adventure!

bluejetty:00131433:ios.description:
The Hopper app has helped over 100 million travelers find and secure the best price on flights, hotels, homes and car rentals - each and every time they book their trips.
Book Flights, Hotels, Homes & Rental Cars 
Find millions of flights, hotels, homes, rental cars (and cute bunnies) – all in one app. Book your trip safely and securely, in just a couple taps and a swipe. 
Always Get the Best Price 
You can watch a trip right in the app and we’ll send you a notification when it’s the best time to buy — recommending you to book now, or maybe wait just a little longer.
Easily Find The Cheapest Travel Dates 
Simply search your preferred destination and use Hopper’s color-coded deals calendar to easily find the cheapest travel dates for your trip.
Travel with Confidence
Avoid fees and frustration! Make any trip flexible with Hopper’s Cancel and Change for Any Reason plans. Get instantly rebooked without extra costs if your flight is delayed or you miss a connection with Hopper’s Flight Disruption Guarantee. Travel stress free with 24/7 access to Hopper’s Customer Support. 
Help the Planet, One Booking at a Time. 
With every booking that occurs on Hopper, we pledge to plant 2 trees to offset the carbon footprint. To date, we’ve planted over 31 million trees. 
Hopper has no ads, no spam, and no stress — just accurate predictions and travel deals.
So what are you waiting for? Start saving money with the bunny today. Download Hopper for free now, and let’s start planning your next trip!

bluejetty:00132095:ios.description:
Designed to manage both Freshwater and Saltwater aquariums!
Available in 13 languages: Català, Dansk, Deutsch, English, Español, Français, Italiano, Polski, Português, Română, Русский, 中文(简体), 中文(香港).
Includes a very comprehensive livestock library of both Freshwater and Saltwater fish, coral, invertebrate and plant species with smart compatibility advice with your fish!
Features: 
• Manage unlimited number of aquariums,
• Record your parameter test results,
• Customize parameters for each tank by adding or removing parameters to your need,
• Easily convert measurements in different units and calculate the required dosing with the advanced unit converters and dosing calculators,
• Use the count-down timer to perform timed tests easier,
• Analyze your tank parameters along with your activities with beautiful, full-screen and touch responsive graphs,
• Plot results of multiple parameters along with your husbandry activities all in one chart,
• Create your husbandry tasks and set reminders for them with an advanced scheduling system,
• Track your activities integrated with tasks and reminders,
• Keep all your notes organized in the searchable Notes section,
• Find information about your Freshwater & Saltwater livestock in Aquaribase,
• Import and save your livestock information from Aquaribase for each tank,
• Add your favorite livestock to the built-in wish list directly from Aquaribase,
• Visually keep track of tank inhabitants with Timelines,
• Analyze the progress of your livestock, along with your logged activities and test results, with Timelines,
• Store your tank equipment,
• Keep track of your expenses,
• Create photo galleries and organize all your photos in different albums,
• Backup & restore your app data wirelessly on Aquarimate Cloud,
• Manage your aquariums across all devices with Aquarimate Live,
• And enjoy!
When it comes to maintaining our aquariums, we all want to stay organized and perform the routine husbandry tasks properly. After all, this is the key to success in maintaining any aquariums.
We always keep track of tank parameters and changes in health, growth, color changes, diseases, etc., to make sure our ecosystem is healthy and thriving. In our busy life, sometimes we find it difficult to remember the progress of all the livestock in our tanks and may forget about things we have to do for our aquariums.
Aquarimate is a comprehensive mobile app that is built to help all aquarists, whether hobbyist or professional, to maintain their tanks properly.
Aquarimate can help you record your test results, analyze changes, visually track your livestock, setup tasks and reminders, log your activities, store your livestock and equipment, take notes, track expenses, build photo galleries and so much more.. 
Aquarimate includes the most comprehensive Saltwater & Freshwater livestock library called Aquaribase. You can browse or search Aquaribase to find information about your livestock, equipment, food and supplements. This database includes thousands species of fish, corals, inverts and plants as well as dry goods with pictures and information organized in categories for saltwater and freshwater aquariums. 
Last but not least, never worry about your app data anymore. You can backup your app data wirelessly and restore whenever you need. Aquarimate Cloud comes with 100MB Free storage in the cloud which can be upgraded to 1G of space via in-app purchase of an annual subscription for $9.99 per year. The subscription will automatically be renewed to maintain your backup in the cloud to keep your data safe and secure. This, however, is not necessary if your data size is below 100MB.
Join Aquarimate Live! and manage your aquariums across all of your devices. Subscription is needed for $9.99 per year which will be automatically renewed every year.
Please visit our website at http://www.aquarimate.com to get more details about the app features and read our Terms & Conditions at http://www.aquarimate.com/terms

bluejetty:00183114:ios.description:
Beach Buggy Racing is back with more Powerups, more drivers, more thrill-ride race tracks, and more fun! 
Join the Beach Buggy Racing League and compete against drivers and cars from around the world. Race through Egyptian pyramids, dragon-infested castles, pirate ship wrecks, and experimental alien bio-labs. Collect and upgrade an arsenal of fun and wacky Powerups. Recruit new drivers, assemble a garage full of cars and race your way to the top of the League.
The first Beach Buggy Racing introduced over 90 million international mobile players to console-style kart-racing with a playful offroad twist. With BBR2, we've upped the ante with a ton of new content, upgradeable Powerups, new game modes...and for the first time you can compete against other players in online competitions and tournaments!
• • • SPECTACULAR KART RACING ACTION 
Beach Buggy Racing is a fully 3D off-road kart racing game with amazing physics, detailed cars and characters, and spectacular weapons, powered by Vector Engine and NVIDIA's PhysX. It's like a console game in the palm of your hand!
• • • UPGRADE YOUR POWERUPS 
With over 45 Powerups to discover and upgrade, BBR2 adds a layer of strategic depth to the classic kart racing formula. Create your own custom Powerup deck with out-of-this-world abilities like "Chain Lightning", "Donut Tires", "Boost Juice" and "Killer Bees". 
• • • BUILD YOUR TEAM 
Four new drivers -- Mikka, Beat Bot, Clutch and Commander Nova -- join Rez, McSkelly, Roxie and the rest of the BBR crew in the battle for kart racing supremacy. Build your reputation to recruit new racers, each with their own unique special ability.
• • • COLLECT OVER 55 CARS
Collect a garage full of beach buggies, monster trucks, muscle cars, classic pickups and formula supercars. All the Beach Buggy classic cars return -- plus dozens of new cars to discover!
• • • PLAY AGAINST THE WORLD
Test your skills against other players from around the world. Race against player avatars in daily races. Compete in live tournaments and special events to win exclusive in-game prizes.
• • • CUSTOMIZE YOUR RIDE
Win exotic metallic, rainbow and matte paints. Collect decal sets with tiger stripes, polka dots, and skulls. Customize your car exactly the way you like with different wheels and accessories.
• • • AWESOME NEW GAME MODES
Edge-of-your-seat racing with 6 drivers. Daily drift and obstacle course challenges. One on one driver races. Weekly tournaments. Car challenges. So many ways to play!
• IMPORTANT NOTICE
Beach Buggy Racing 2 is designed for players 13 and older. It is free to play, but it contains items that can be purchased for real money.

bluejetty:00135823:ios.description:
Good Drills is the basketball training app designed to help you build real-game athleticism, skills, and confidence—on and off the court. Whether you're trying to dunk, improve your handles, or level up your game IQ, our system helps players at all levels get better results with just 4 sessions per week.
Inside, you’ll find drills that carry over to games, a full 6-phase development plan, and coaching features that help you stay accountable. Join thousands of hoopers transforming their game with the same structure used by D1 athletes, high school prospects, and everyday players chasing real progress.
FEATURES INCLUDE:
• Game-speed workouts and vertical jump programs
• Skill work for shooting, finishing, ball handling, and footwork
• Strength training designed for basketball performance
• Personalized weekly training plans
• Progress tracking and self-assessment tools
• Access to private Discord for community and coaching support
• Real drills, real coaching, real results
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Good Drills is free to download. Continued access requires an active subscription.

Once purchased, no refunds will be issued for unused portions of the term.
ONE-TIME IN-APP PURCHASES

• Swish Everything – $19.99
A focused shooting module designed to fix common form issues and help you become a consistent shooter under pressure.
• Good Recruit System – $39.99
A step-by-step recruiting blueprint built in partnership with a D1 coach to help you stand out, get noticed, and navigate the recruiting process with clarity.

bluejetty:00121326:ios.description:
Le meilleur de la vie locale dans une seule application mobile.
Avec l’application ici, retrouvez toute l’actualité autour de chez vous : société, politique, insolite, faits divers, santé, environnement…
Vous pouvez également écouter les directs de votre radio locale ici (ex- France Bleu) et de votre antenne régionale France 3. Écoutez et visionnez les émissions radio et TV sur l’actualité régionale, les dernières idées de sorties, le patrimoine culturel, l’histoire de votre région…
Grâce à ici, profitez également de services personnalisables pour mieux vivre au quotidien : météo, agenda des sorties, jeux, horoscope.

bluejetty:00070096:ios.description:
A dark veil sweeps across the wasteland, and the undead bride awakens from her slumber.
The limited-time Undead Bride-themed event is now live!
At midnight, the church bells toll, and a bride draped in shadow returns from oblivion. Her vows, long buried beneath the dust of time, have become a mysterious power sweeping across the wasteland. Walk beside her to uncover the past and stand against the silent curse spreading through the apocalypse. Join the Undead Bride-themed challenges to unlock exclusive cosmetics and generous rewards. 
Make your choice before the midnight bells ring. Will you be her ally or become part of her collection?
Doomsday: Last Survivors is a zombie survival game with multiplayer online competition and real-time strategy elements. Set in a near future where zombies have taken over the world, survivors must fight for their lives and humanity's future. As the Commander, you must lead fellow survivors to build their Shelter, explore fog-filled areas, and fight the zombies and rival factions! Are you tired of the usual strategy games and love zombie games? Check out Doomsday: Last Survivors to experience one of the most exciting survival games!
[Game Highlights]
Z-Virus Adventure Upgrade
Embark on thrilling Z-Virus Adventure expeditions! Assemble your team from scratch and venture deep into the wasteland. Evade the zombie onslaught while scavenging for resources and arming yourself against the clock. Survive the relentless horde through tactical decisions and quick reflexes!
Survival of the Fittest
Lead troops and civilians in your Shelter! Exterminate zombies to survive the apocalypse, or raid other Shelters to sustain your own. You can also form an alliance and fight enemies with your allies in one of the best survival games!
A Realistic Doomsday Experience
The crisis continues to loom over us in a cruel world where it's kill or be killed. Want to experience one of the best immersive survival experiences in zombie games? Look no further! Check out the realistic spherical terrain system with convenient zoom controls that enable close-up Shelter views to satellite views. Download Doomsday: Last Survivors today!
Strategic Battles
Become the best at survival games by utilizing everything you can find. Train multiple troop types and execute diverse battle strategies with Hero skills and attacks to outlast the zombie hordes.
Unique Heroes
Realistic and exciting Hero designs portray survivors from different walks of life. Recruit talented Heroes to help lead your troops, defend your Shelter, and beat one of the best strategy games!
Commander, are you ready to survive the apocalypse?
Become the best at zombie games with your strength and wits!
===Information===
Official Tik Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@doomsdaylastsurvivor
Customer Service: help.doomsday.apple@igg.com

- Subscribe to get: Research Speed +2%, Training Speed +2%, Stamina Recovery +2%, EXP from Zombies +10%, and daily rewards.
Note:
1, Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase.
2, Subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription.
3, Your account will receive confirmation of the next renewal and price within 24 hours before the end of your current subscription.
4, You may manage/turn off your subscriptions and auto-renewal by going to the Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00023609:ios.name: FamilyTime Jr.
bluejetty:00023609:ios.summary: FamilyTime Jr. is a thoughtful app designed to connect children with their parents digitally for quick help in emergencies. This connection allows parents to keep their kids safe while children can happily enjoy their latest iPhones and iPa
bluejetty:00023609:ios.description:
FamilyTime Jr. is a thoughtful app designed to connect children with their parents digitally for quick help in emergencies. This connection allows parents to keep their kids safe while children can happily enjoy their latest iPhones and iPads with peace of mind. With FamilyTime Parental Control, kids can easily communicate and immediately inform their parents if they're in trouble.
Key Features:
TeenSafe Drive - Speed Alerts
Are you afraid your teens will drive too fast? That can be dangerous. Get speed alerts for your teens and know when they exceed the speed limit.
Location History
You can quickly check the location history of all the places your children have visited, complete with addresses and timestamps for each visit. It's a great way to stay informed about their adventures!
Send SOS/Panic Alerts
It's essential to be there for your children during emergencies, and knowing how to reach them is critical. Children can easily send SOS alerts with their complete location details from their iPhone or iPad, making it even easier to stay connected.
Send PickMeUp Alerts
Remember to pick up your children from school, the gym, or football practice. When it's time to pick them up, they can send PickMeUp alerts with complete location information from their iPhone or iPad.
Important:
Parents need to download FamilyTime - Dashboard on their phones to manage their family devices on the go.
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/familytime-dashboard/id981066103
Feedback:
If you have any problems, please look at our help pages or contact us via the contact page of our website. We cannot always help you if you post questions in the reviews.
https://familytime.io/support.html
Note: 
• The FamilyTime app collects certain information from the child’s iOS device to run properly. To know what information this app collects from the device, check our App Permissions at: 
https://familytime.io/legal/app-privacy-policy.html 
• Data charges may apply for using the FamilyTime app over cellular data. Contact your provider for details. 
• Continuing to use the mobile device's GPS running in the background can drain battery life. Check the device's battery settings for details.
We take your privacy seriously and use the best security practices and ultra-secure servers to protect your data. For more details, please read:
Privacy Policy:
https://familytime.io/legal/privacy-policy.html
Terms and Conditions:
https://familytime.io/legal/terms-conditions.html

bluejetty:00031733:ios.name: Learn Korean Language Phrases
bluejetty:00031733:ios.summary: Learn Korean for beginners with Hangul, everyday phrases, vocabulary and audio you can replay at your own pace. Start with the alphabet and greetings, follow guided levels, or choose a mini course for travel, food, family and more. No accou
bluejetty:00031733:ios.description:
Learn Korean for beginners with Hangul, everyday phrases, vocabulary and audio you can replay at your own pace. Start with the alphabet and greetings, follow guided levels, or choose a mini course for travel, food, family and more. No account registration is required.
BUILD YOUR KOREAN FOUNDATION
Read Korean words alongside English meanings and pronunciation guides. Explore numbers, colors, questions, common verbs, days, months, measurements and useful expressions. Learn a few words, listen to their recordings, then practice what you remember.
LISTEN AND PRACTICE
Choose between two Korean learning voices, Ji-woo and Woo-jin. Replay individual words and phrases, adjust playback speed and volume, and practice saying them aloud. Use the English voice settings to customize spoken translations.
MAKE NEW WORDS STICK
Review lessons with flashcards and mark words you know or need to revisit. Test yourself with multiple-choice quizzes, true-or-false questions, word matching and writing exercises. Save favorite words and phrases for easy review, or search for the vocabulary you need.
CHOOSE YOUR LEARNING PATH
Follow guided levels or explore five practical mini courses: Starter Pack, Travel Basics, Food & Restaurant, Family & Home, and Health & Emergency.
Browse 26 topic chapters: Foundation, Humanity, Adornments, Cuisine, Kinship, Emotions, Pharmaceuticals, Living Spaces, Dwelling, Human Endeavors, Human Tasks II, Occupations, Athletics, Learning, Creative Expressions, Journey, Machinery, Vehicles, Automobiles, Milestones, Natural World, Planet Earth, Animal Kingdom, Plant Life, Terrains, and Varied Topics.
BUILD A DAILY HABIT
Track lesson progress, exercise results, daily check-ins and learning streaks. Set a daily reminder and see your activity on the calendar. Study in light or dark mode on iPhone and iPad.
LEARN ON THE GO
Lesson content and included Korean recordings are stored in the app for offline study. Purchases, ads and sending feedback require an internet connection.
KEEP YOUR PROGRESS AND GET HELP
Create a manual backup of favorites, progress, exercise results, check-ins and preferences, then restore it from a saved file. Report a word, translation or audio issue from a learning screen, or contact Feedback & Support about an app or purchase problem. Replay onboarding whenever you need a refresher without clearing your learning data.
FREE AND PREMIUM ACCESS
Start with selected free lessons. Full access to lessons and premium features requires a subscription or one-time lifetime purchase. Available plans and prices are shown in the app. The free version includes ads.
Privacy Policy: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-korean/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-korean/terms/

bluejetty:00124205:ios.description:
Welcome to Farm Bay! Enjoy exciting adventures in a free farming game!
Can you turn a pretty farm into a paradise bay land? Enjoy the fun farming game to succeed in the building a magnificent seaside village! Harvest crops, raise animals, trade with friends, earn precious resources and xp to expand the town! Maintain stocks of crops and products to make your farm plentiful! 
Your good neighbors will help you get comfortable and grow the farm even faster! Сhat and trade with friends in the neighborhood to become the best farmers! Explore the mine to get precious resources to have a good progress! Complete exciting orders to expand! Take part in regular events to enjoy the pleasant family atmosphere on your farm!
Unforgettable trips to the treasure islands await you! Use a wonderful yacht to sail to the islands and get precious resources to expand and find fantastic treasures as well! Interesting and exciting missions will make expanding your farm fast and cheerful! 
Farm Bay features:
* Numerous crops and fruits to harvest! 
* Cute animals to get healthy farm products!
* Various production buildings to make beneficial recipes!
* Market stand, ship and order board to trade and earn coins to expand!
* Magnificent airship to improve the production buildings!
* Exciting trips to the treasure islands!
* Many interesting quests and challenging orders!
* Regular in-game events on the farm!
* Fishing to get fish and make delicious fish recipes!
* Nice decorations to make the farm more beautiful!
Notes:
* Farm Bay is free to download and free to play, however some 
 in-game items can be purchased for real money!
* The game requires an active internet connection to play!
* Farm Bay is a standalone game and will not synchronize or 
 connect to the Facebook version of the game!

listings.name: Farm Bay
listings.description:
Welcome to Farm Bay! Enjoy exciting adventures in a free farming game!

Can you turn a pretty farm into a paradise bay land? Enjoy the fun farming game to succeed in the building a magnificent seaside village! Harvest crops, raise animals, trade with friends, earn precious resources and xp to expand the town! Maintain stocks of crops and products to make your farm plentiful! 

Your good neighbors will help you get comfortable and grow the farm even faster! Сhat and trade with friends in the neighborhood to become the best farmers! Explore the mine to get precious resources to have a good progress! Complete exciting orders to expand! Take part in regular events to enjoy the pleasant family atmosphere on your farm!

Unforgettable trips to the treasure islands await you! Use a wonderful yacht to sail to the islands and get precious resources to expand and find fantastic treasures as well! Interesting and exciting missions will make expanding your farm fast and cheerful! 

Farm Bay features:
* Numerous crops and fruits to harvest! 
* Cute animals to get healthy farm products!
* Various production buildings to make beneficial recipes!
* Market stand, ship and order board to trade and earn coins to expand!
* Magnificent airship to improve the production buildings!
* Exciting trips to the treasure islands!
* Many interesting quests and challenging orders!
* Regular in-game events on the farm!
* Fishing to get fish and make delicious fish recipes!
* Nice decorations to make the farm more beautiful!
 
Notes:
* Farm Bay is free to download and free to play, however some 
   in-game items can be purchased for real money!
* The game requires an active internet connection to play!
* Farm Bay is a standalone game and will not synchronize or   
   connect to the Facebook version of the game!

bluejetty:00082190:ios.developer: RAGE QUIT GAMES GROUP SP Z O O SPOŁKA KOMANDYTOWA
bluejetty:00082190:ios.summary: Tomorrow has come! Get ready to fight in a post apocalyptic wasteland where survival is an ongoing adventure. In Tomorrow: MMO Nuclear Quest, players are thrown into a post nuclear wasteland full of zombie, monsters, and hostile factions. S
bluejetty:00082190:ios.description:
Tomorrow has come! Get ready to fight in a post apocalyptic wasteland where survival is an ongoing adventure. In Tomorrow: MMO Nuclear Quest, players are thrown into a post nuclear wasteland full of zombie, monsters, and hostile factions. Set in the 2060s, the open-world RPG allows you to complete different types of quests. You can craft essential items, defend against zombie who have managed to survive the apocalypse, and much more. Each quest tests your skills and forces you to adapt in this harsh post nuclear MMO wasteland. 
Build your own shelter in a post nuclear environment!
With deep survival RPG elements, Tomorrow: MMO Nuclear Quest offers an adventure unlike any other. Explore the vast open world at your own pace, taking on quests that challenge your ability to craft items, build a base, and engage in intense PvP battle. In this sandbox RPG, crafting is essential for survival. You'll craft everything from weapons to survival gear, allowing you to dominate the wasteland. Base building is a key element of survival. Your base will help you not only protect yourself from hordes of hostile zombie but also manage your own resources! 
Craft, fight, and dominate the wasteland!
The sandbox nature of this MMO means that every quest is a new opportunity to explore, scavenge resources, and discover new realistic areas. Whether you want to craft new weapons or build a PvP strategy, the world of Tomorrow is a playground for true survivors. Gamepad support allows you precise control, giving you an advantage in the fight against zombie. Did you enjoy Rust? Tomorrow: MMO Nuclear Quest will please you even more! 
PvP challenges and COOP adventures in this MMORPG!
This is not a shooter like others! Form alliances to complete each quest and share resources to survive. Compete in PvP battle that add rivalry to your adventure by testing your strategy and skills against other players. Events provide rare items, allowing you to craft powerful equipment, from guns covered with rust to nuclear weapons that will give you dominance over the wasteland! 
Explore the world of this unlimited wasteland!
This MMORPG offers a full-fledged campaign filled with quests and adventures that will draw you deeper into the apocalyptic wasteland. The nuclear fallout still has its effects—monsters and zombie are lurking for weak survivors. The open world encourages exploration, and each quest reveals new aspects of the post nuclear wasteland environment! You won't experience any ads in Tomorrow: MMO Nuclear Quest! You don't have to worry about something interrupting your boss fight in the most intense moment! 
Collect materials and craft items necessary for survival. RPG elements abound, with customization options for your character. You can craft equipment to fit your play style. If you want to speed up the development of your character, you can make a purchase in the game store! There are a bunch of unique items there - even weapons you can’t craft! Defeat hundreds of zombie, build a shelter, and experience the harshness of this real post nuclear world’s lore! 
The ultimate survival MMORPG adventure awaits!
Tomorrow: MMO Nuclear Quest combines the excitement of PvP combat and the creativity of crafting in the vast wasteland of the sandbox. The open world allows you to discover hidden quests and engage in epic adventures that will test your RPG skills. Are you ready to conquer the wasteland and become a legend in this nuclear MMO game?
Download now, and hop on board the raft of Tomorrow: MMO Nuclear Quest, where every quest is a new adventure and every battle shapes your legacy in the wasteland!
This game requires a minimum of 3GB of RAM to run. Ensure your device meets or exceeds this requirement.
Terms of Service: https://ragequitgames.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://ragequitgames.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00043574:ios.summary:
GoSUP is the ideal companion for your stand-up paddle tours.
Use your Apple Watch or iPhone to record your tours, keep a logbook and analyze your tours with a variety of reports.
GoSUP has been optimized for the Apple Watch and uses its s
bluejetty:00043574:ios.description:
GoSUP is the ideal companion for your stand-up paddle tours.
Use your Apple Watch or iPhone to record your tours, keep a logbook and analyze your tours with a variety of reports.
GoSUP has been optimized for the Apple Watch and uses its sensors to offer you an optimal analysis.
For example, GoSUP can detect your paddle strokes or recognize when you jump into the water and what temperature the water has.
The compass shows you the direction home and with GPS your speed and route is recorded.
Here is an overview of all the features:
- Personalized workout view: decide yourself which values you see during the workout.
- Paddle Strokes: Detect your paddle strokes (beta), the cadence and efficiency of your paddle strokes.
- Water contact and water temperature: Detect where you jump into the water and measure the water temperature.
- Compass: shows you the direction and distance to your starting point
- Route: View the distance traveled & see where you took photos
- HealthKit: All workouts and routes are synced with HealthKit. 
- Live Activity: Pause your tour directly from the Lockscreen or from the Dynamic Island 
- Live Statistics: Analyze the current progress of your workout
- Complications & Widgets: Use a widget to view your last workout or choose between different complications to start GoSUP directly from your personalized watchface.
- Photos: Browse through all your photos taken during a trip.
- Use the action button on the Apple Watch Ultra to start a workout or switch between the map and workout view during a workout.
FAQ: 
- Installation: If you installed GoSUP from your iPhone, the app may not appear on the Apple Watch. It may also happen that the installation can no longer be started from the iPhone, as the installation icon is grayed out.
If you experience similar behavior, do the following: 1.) Open the AppStore on the Apple Watch. 2.) Scroll to "Account" 3.) Select "Purchases" 4.) Find GoSUP in the list and tap on the "Cloud" icon.
- Why don't I see distance in the fitness app:
The fitness app only shows walking distance, cycling distance or swimming distance. Other types are not supported.
If you like GoSUP I would be very thankful for a review and it would help me to improve GoSUP continuously.
Enjoy your ride & GoSUP!

bluejetty:00142780:ios.name: Protake - Mobile Cinema Camera
bluejetty:00142780:ios.developer: Beijing Lingguang Zaixian Information Technology Limited
bluejetty:00142780:ios.summary:
Protake brings the filmmaking experience of professional cinema cameras to your mobile devices.
No matter you're a daily vlogger, a commercial director, or a well-established filmmaker, you will benefit from Protake's features, including:
bluejetty:00142780:ios.description:
Protake brings the filmmaking experience of professional cinema cameras to your mobile devices.
No matter you're a daily vlogger, a commercial director, or a well-established filmmaker, you will benefit from Protake's features, including:
# [NEW] WI-FI VIDEO TRANSMISSION
· In the landscape orientation of AUTO and PRO modes, you can start the brand new Wi-Fi Video Transmission system.
· You can transmit the video from 1 "camera" to 4 "monitors" (yes, we're talking about iPhones and iPads).
· You can watch up to 4 "cameras" on 1 "monitor".
· You can wirelessly start and stop the recording of all "cameras".
· You can even monitor HDR and SDR video streams on the same screen.
· It's a ground-breaking end-to-end mobile recording and monitoring experience.
· It's brought to you by Protake.
# MODES
· AUTO mode: a mode optimized for vloggers and YouTubers, you can use it single-handedly.
· PRO mode: a mode designed for professional filmmakers. All the camera information and control settings are well aligned on the screen.
· DUAL mode: recording video with two cameras working at the same time. Recorded in one file as Picture in Picture or two files.
· PORTRAIT mode: with iPhone Pro and iPad Pro's LiDAR sensor and the devices' powerful processors, you can record "portrait mode video" with real-time blurred background.
# COLOR
· LOG: it's not only a genuine LOG gamma curve -- we strictly matched your mobile device's color to the industrial standard - ALEXA Log C.
· Cinematic Looks: we provided a dozen of cinematic looks for filmmakers -- the styles are categorized into Neutral Styles, Film Emulation (classic Kodak and Fuji cinema film), Movie Inspired (blockbusters and indie masterpieces), and ALEXA Looks.
# ASSISTANTS
· Monitoring tools: Waveform, Parade, Histogram, RGB Histogram, Audio Meter.
· Composition assistants: Aspect Ratios, Safe Area, Thirds, Crosshairs, and 3-axis Horizon Indicators.
· Exposure assistants: Zebra Strips，False Color, Exposure Compensation, Auto Exposure.
· Focus assistants: Focus Peaking and Auto Focus.
· Recording: Record Beeper, Record Flash, Volume Key Record.
· Zooming and Focusing: A-B Point.
# DATA
· Frame Rate Normalization: Mobile devices don't have perfect frame rate control, therefore, it's easy to get non-standard variable frame rate. Protake solves this problem fundamentally and makes strictly constant FPS of 24, 25, 30, 60, 120, etc.
· File-naming: All the video files saved by Protake use the standard naming system: Camera Unit + Reel Number + Clip Count + Date + Suffix. It's something like "A001C00203_200412_IR8J.MOV"... Sounds familiar?
· Metadata: Everything including device model, ISO, shutter angel, white balance, lens, connected accessories, location, are all well recorded in the file's metadata.
· Time code: We provided both options for you -- Free Run and Record Run. It's compatible with your cinema cameras.
# Protake+
· With a Protake+ membership, you can use all the features, including: Pro mode, LOG gamma curve, Protake Cinematic Looks, all the assistant tools, data management, 3rd-party accessories.
· Protake+ provides 1-year membership for you to purchase; 
· Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase;
· Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period;
· Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period;
· The renewal price for 1-year membership is USD 19.99.
· You can manage your subscription and switch off the auto-renewal by accessing your Account Settings after purchase;
· All personal data is handled under the terms and conditions of Protake’s privacy policy. More details can be found here: 
https://terms.alicdn.com/legal-agreement/terms/platform_service/20220621172324148/20220621172324148.html
https://terms.alicdn.com/legal-agreement/terms/privacy/20220704104156634/20220704104156634.html

bluejetty:00026908:ios.description:
Leera — the free reading app millions of readers already love. Thousands of novels across every genre, all completely free. Read wherever, whenever, as much as you want.
We're Leera, and we've got one mission: to make you fall in love with reading. Our library is massive — fantasy, martial arts, romance, love stories, horror, mystery, sci-fi, drama, campus life, urban fiction and so much more. Whatever mood you're in today — a heart-melting romance, an epic adventure that sweeps you away, or a mystery you can't put down — you'll find it right here, totally free.
New chapters and books drop every single day, so you'll never run out of things to read. We also run regular events, activities and surprises to keep your reading life exciting. And we never stop improving — all so we can be the reading companion you reach for every day.
What you get with Leera:
【A Library That Keeps Growing】
Thousands of novels organised into curated recommendation lists. Our smart suggestions learn what you love — the more you read, the better they get at finding your next favourite. Browse rankings, new releases and themed collections.
【A Reading Experience That Feels Real】
Download chapters and take them anywhere, even offline. The page-turning effect feels just like a real book in your hands. Customise your fonts, backgrounds and themes, switch on Night Mode for comfortable evening reading, and adjust brightness to suit your eyes. Everything designed so you can read for hours without strain.
【Your Reader, Your Rules】
Loads of backgrounds and fonts to choose from. One tap and your personalised reading setup is ready. Save your favourites to your library and get recommendations that actually match what you enjoy.
【Smart Sync】
Your reading progress and notes save and sync automatically across all your devices. Start a chapter on your phone during the morning commute, pick it up on your tablet when you get home. Never lose your page again.
【A Community of Readers Like You】
Share your favourite stories, see what others are reading right now, drop a comment on chapters that blew your mind. Reading solo is great — reading together is even better.

• The app offers optional subscriptions. You can read entirely for free.
• Payment: Subscription charges are processed through your iTunes account upon purchase.
• Renewal: Your subscription will automatically renew. You can cancel up to 24 hours before the renewal date.
• Cancellation: You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your account settings.

• User Agreement: https://www.manobook.net/agreement/service_term.html?client_proid=173&mt=1

bluejetty:00070023:ios.name: University Empire Tycoon－Idle
bluejetty:00070023:ios.summary:
Will you be able to manage a whole University and become the best university rector?
Hold the reins of the business and become rich building a college campus!
Start running a small enclosure and work hard to make your reputation grow. Imp
bluejetty:00070023:ios.description:
Will you be able to manage a whole University and become the best university rector?
Hold the reins of the business and become rich building a college campus!
Start running a small enclosure and work hard to make your reputation grow. Improve every detail and build new areas to turn your modest business into an educational institution, and compete with other universities!
Deal with the needs of employees and students, and take the proper decisions to expand your business successfully. Customize the classrooms, improve the administration department, provide the best sports facilities to students, or invest your idle money in hiring the best lecturers. Every single choice you make will have an impact on your growth strategy!
EXPAND YOUR CAMPUS:
Add new areas to your university premises! Build new classrooms, sports grounds, or institutional buildings; open leisure zones, faculty lounges, student clubs; install better basketball hoops or modern blackboards… Inaugurate new faculties and increase the educational program: Maths, Law, Medical college, Philosophy, Literature, Physics, Chemistry, or Engineering. You must grow intelligently to reach the distinguished status that you deserve. Your wise management will allow you to have a huge university campus. Study the situation, have a look at your possibilities, and invest your balance patiently! 
MEET THE STUDENT NEEDS: 
The more prestigious your university is, the more students will come and happily pay their tuition. You must be aware of all their needs and adapt your growth strategy to fulfill their expectations! Provide your pupils with the best didactic materials and scholarships, and engage the most outstanding students. Don’t forget to add after-school activities!
MANAGE YOUR STAFF: 
Your university will need an efficient working team, and you must be a worthy boss. Control your expenses and hire and fire workers depending on your workflow and your strategy. Employ maintenance personnel, builders, janitors, or office workers. Don’t forget to recruit the best teachers for all the school subjects available. Each department will cover basic needs in your business, and you should manage your team wisely to make your university profitable. 
PARTICIPATE IN ONLINE COMPETITIONS: 
Compete against other universities online and work your way up to appear in the rankings! Join the different online contests and improve your status. Create the best possible educational institution and share it with your colleagues. You will have the opportunity of being a worldwide reference in different academic fields thanks to your hard work at the university. 
If you like management and idle games, you will enjoy University Empire Tycoon! A casual easy-to-play game where strategic decisions have to be taken to grow a campus with profitable results. Expand your premises starting from a small and modest campus and unlock visible progress in your facilities. Transform your small business into the most renowned university and become the best university manager of all time!

bluejetty:00157566:ios.name: StepChain
bluejetty:00157566:ios.summary:
StepChain is a responsible fitness app with a main purpose of making the world a better place by decreasing obesity and promoting a healthy way of living.
This application tracks all of your physical activity from walking to running, swimmi
bluejetty:00157566:ios.description:
StepChain is a responsible fitness app with a main purpose of making the world a better place by decreasing obesity and promoting a healthy way of living.
This application tracks all of your physical activity from walking to running, swimming, cycling, dancing, climbing, rope jumping and many more. 
How? StepChain would be linked to Google Fit, retrieving data of steps walked, then converting them into tokens, STEP coins. 
StepChain will definitely motivate you to increase your physical activity, improving your health and lifestyle. Not only have that, your STEP coins could be redeemed with a variety of gifts like gym memberships, sports equipment’s, wearables and electronics. 
StepChain is not only for athletes, StepChain is for every lifestyle. You can benefit from StepChain’s rewarding system when carrying out your daily chores that involves a physical activity. 
All you have to do is download the app now, create an account and start exercising.
To simplify it even more, StepChain is: 
Motivating – Encouraging you to increase your physical activity. Walk more, Earn more. 
Rewarding – Converting your steps into STEP coins. 
Challenging – Pushing you to your limits to challenge yourself and upgrade your fitness level. 
Giving – Donating your STEP coins to contribute in making the world a better place.
Tracking your progress and balance – Keeping record of your advancement and STEP coin wallet. 
Socializing – Chatting and communicating with the vast StepChain Community. 
StepChain is currently available only in the free version which will allow you to walk and earn STEP points instantly.
StepChain tracks your activity by using Apple's HealthKit, to be able to use StepChain you need to connect your apple account.

Achieve focus, calm, and sleep well in minutes with scientifically proven techniques.
Take care of your mind with WeMind – Guided and scientific practices that transform small moments of the day into real improvements for your well-being.
The WeMind method combines mindfulness, hypnosis, tapping (based on acupuncture), and cognitive techniques in practical exercises, so that by following a quick, simple meditation session, you can experience tranquility and focus effectively.
Why choose WeMind?
While other apps mix mindfulness with bedtime stories, self-help, or mystical content, WeMind follows a practical and reliable approach. We use techniques based on recognized studies, developed seriously and focused on generating real results.
Looking for practical solutions to everyday challenges?
Do you want to overcome sleepless nights, relieve tension, or improve your concentration? Had a long day and find it difficult to slow down? WeMind offers tools created by experts to help you find more balance, focus, and quality of life.
Made by experts, based on science
WeMind was developed based on internationally recognized methods and offers a practical and accessible approach to help with mental organization, relaxation, and relief from daily fatigue.
Features
- Proven Techniques: Improve focus, sleep quality, and organize your thoughts with programs that help you observe your experiences and act clearly and efficiently.
- SOS Sessions: Find moments of pause with quick 1- to 5-minute practices that can be done anywhere.
- Practical Programs: Specific modules to solve various issues that impair well-being.
Benefits:
- Moments of Pause and Calm
- Reduce Daily Tension
- Improve Your Rest
- Improve Your Focus and Attention
- Develop Resilience
- Connect Better
Testimonials:
"I tried meditation apps without success, as they were too confusing and meaningless. You really understand the concept in WeMind, which motivated me to move forward and improve my sleep." - M.L., 28 years old, Dentist
"It helped me find moments of peace in my daily life. The sessions are perfect, and I do them quickly between classes." - M.S., 40 years old, Elementary School Teacher
"The WeMind sessions were the ones that worked for me. They helped improve my patience and communication with my children." - J.B., 38 years old, Nurse
"The app helped me change my thought patterns and improve my well-being. This is the app I recommend to all my patients." - B.T., 47 years old, Psychologist
"It helped improve my concentration, reduce nervousness before exams, and make the most of my studies." - L.A., 21 years old, Engineering Student
Frequently Asked Questions:
1- How is WeMind different from other meditation apps? Developed by experts, WeMind uses proven methods.
2- How much time do I need to dedicate daily? Sessions are designed to be quick and to the point, with options ranging from 1 to 20 minutes, making it easy to integrate into your routine. Only one session per day is recommended.
3- Who can use WeMind? Beginners, intermediate, or advanced users. The guides are easy to follow and designed for gradual and practical learning.
Download now and start taking care of yourself with WeMind.
Terms and Subscription
WeMind offers two subscription plans, monthly and annual, which can be purchased from the App Store. bluejetty:00183750:ios.description:
Park National Bank’s mobile banking app is the ultimate connection to your money – and it’s free! Enjoy an updated mobile banking experience with enhanced features and added services, plus the convenience of personal online banking, all at your fingertips. After downloading the app, login with your online banking ID and password.
 In the app, you can:
SEE IT: View account and loan information. See balances, check images, and recent transaction history on your accounts, loans and lines of credit. Use instant balance to choose account balances to see on the login page. With Credit Sense, you can also keep tabs on your credit score and history. Plus, open another deposit account, apply for a loan, reorder checks and stop a payment – all from the palm of your hand.
MOVE IT: With more transfer options, you can move money between accounts, between banks and between people. You can quickly transfer to another Park customer’s account – all you need is the account number.
PAY IT: Schedule, change or cancel payments on the go.
DEPOSIT IT: Use your camera to take a picture and deposit checks into any Park checking or savings account.
SEND IT: Send money to anyone on your contact list with and Zelle® - a fast, safe and easy way to send and receive money.
MANAGE IT: Financial Manager is a robust tool providing a detailed overview of your complete financial picture. Set savings goals, build a budget, categorize transactions, see charts and more.
GUARD IT: Enhanced account alerts notify you about important activity, allowing you to choose from an extensive list of alerts. Plus, we’ve added new security features to keep your account safe. Alerts can be sent via text, email or push notifications in the app.
CONTROL IT: Turn your debit card(s) on or off and create spending controls.
UPDATE IT: With a secure form, you can easily update your profile and contact information. It only takes a minute!
FIND IT: Find a branch or ATM near you.
ASK IT: Use the Contact Us feature to call or live chat with a 24/7 Customer Care specialist any time you have a question or need assistance.

bluejetty:00044391:ios.description:
CurvyHub is a social app designed for BBW and curvy individuals to connect, share, and celebrate their lives in a supportive community. Our mission is to create a safe space for self-expression, meaningful friendships, and confidence-building.
- Key Feature: Mood -
The Mood feature lets you share photos, videos, and text updates that capture your daily experiences and emotions dynamically and authentically.
- Community Focus -
CurvyHub fosters body positivity and self-love, providing a bias-free environment where you can showcase your true self and connect with others who appreciate and support you.
- Connect and Engage -
Find like-minded friends, join interest-based groups, participate in discussions, and attend virtual meetups. Stay connected and share experiences in real-time with our chat functionality.
- Rebuild Confidence -
Draw inspiration, share your journey, and receive encouragement from a community that values you.
- Join CurvyHub Today -
Download CurvyHub and start sharing your Mood with a community that uplifts and inspires you.
- About VIP Subscriptions -
We are excited to introduce a VIP subscription feature to our app, offering users access to advanced functionalities. While most features of the app remain free, subscribing unlocks premium capabilities. Subscription options include 1-month, 3-month, and 6-month plans, all set to auto-renew. Subscriptions can be managed via in-app purchases through Apple ID. For more details, please review our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
Privacy Policy: https://curvyhubs.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://curvyhubs.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00136281:ios.name: Readmio: Kids Books Read Aloud
bluejetty:00136281:ios.summary: Hundreds of enchanting stories brimming with surprises, entertainment, and wisdom, elevated by a captivating audio adventure for kids. When you read aloud, the app responds to your voice with delightful sounds and music. For a child, this i
bluejetty:00136281:ios.description:
Hundreds of enchanting stories brimming with surprises, entertainment, and wisdom, elevated by a captivating audio adventure for kids. When you read aloud, the app responds to your voice with delightful sounds and music. For a child, this is a wondrous audio journey, free from any screen time.
REASONS WHY YOU’LL LOVE READMIO
— We help build a positive attitude towards reading
— We create stories with the intention of supporting the mental and emotional development of children
— Our stories are short and easy to integrate with other activities
— Reading with sounds works offline and with your privacy in mind
— We add new stories every week
— It’s fun not only for your children but for you as well
LISTEN TO AUDIOBOOKS
— Stories and fairy tales also include audiobooks. This is handy when you can’t read or while driving.
— Your presence while listening to audiobooks has a positive effect. If you also maintain physical contact (holding hands, stroking the head), it’s even better.
CREATE YOUR OWN AUDIOBOOKS
— Each fairy tale or story you read aloud can be recorded and automatically transformed into your very own audiobook! With just one click.
— You can listen to the audiobooks while travelling in the car or children can listen to your voice when you are away.
— Audiobooks you create can be shared with your family or friends.
COLOURING AND MORE
— Stories include colouring pages you can print and let your children color them. It’s a great activity children can do while you read to them or the next day.
— You can also print any story and read it without the phone.
BY PARENTS FOR PARENTS
Readmio is an app full of fairy tales that we have enriched with sounds. Just download the app, save a story to the library and start reading! While you read out loud, the app follows along and adds sounds at exactly the right moment. You don’t have to worry about anything, just read at a regular speed and our application will listen to you and enhance your experience. That’s it. For best results, don’t read too fast and avoid noisy environments (e.g. in the car).
A SMALL THEATRE AT HOME
Feel free to put even more into the storytelling, our sounds and music will help you. For example, try making different voices or facial expressions and make a small home theater for your children. Your acting performance is very important for the whole experience. Some parents even prefer to use a Bluetooth speaker to make the sounds and music create a colorful atmosphere throughout the whole room.
WHY THERE AREN’T ANY ILLUSTRATIONS IN THE STORIES?
The fairy tales have beautiful cover illustrations that will help you and your children choose what you are going to read. However, the children's contact with the mobile phone should end there. In the stories themselves, we did not include illustrations intentionally because we do not want to support their time spent in front of the screen. It is better to draw children's attention to you, the sounds, and the story itself.
MEANINGFUL STORIES
We created Readmio because we believe in the power of stories. They form the basis of society and help to spread and maintain wisdom. For children, they are an ideal tool not only for expanding vocabulary but also for explaining complicated topics. We recommend that you use our stories as a conversation starter for topics you care about. You will find inspiration on how to get started in the descriptions of the individual stories.
ABOUT PRIVACY
An internet connection is required to download the fairy tale, but not for the reading itself. Speech recognition works completely offline on your device. No data or voice recordings are stored or transferred anywhere. Your privacy comes first. In addition, you can read on the go or abroad without worrying about expensive roaming charges.
We believe that you and your little ones will enjoy the application and have many magical experiences together.

Dive into intense first person shooter action with cool weapons, 3D locations and pixelated graphics that immerse you in a block-style battle royale world. It’s free, action-packed, and ready to put your survival skills to the test.

Why You’ll Love It:

- Easy Controls: Intuitive interface and easy-to-use touch screen controls let you run, jump, sprint, reload, aim, and shoot with ease.
- Cool Levels: Explore locations and battle in modern blocky arenas.
- Pro Tips: Wanna get a perfect score? Start each level with a game plan and aim for the perfect shot.
- Power Up: Want an edge? Locate the soda cans to get a game-changing power-up. It's totally your call, but why miss out?
-Collectibles: Find all the secrets through the levels and get extra points.
- Smart Enemies: Challenge yourself against tougher, smarter enemies in intense PVP-style combat, and show off your skills in epic hand-to-hand combat and precision aiming.
- Weapon Collection: Collect a stash of blocky, pixelated weapons and show them who’s the boss. Axes, pistols, rifles, shotguns, machine guns, grenade launchers, a flamethrower and more.

Get ready for heart-pounding action and survival like you’ve never seen. Whether you’re flying solo or craving the multiplayer vibe in single-player mode, every battle is a new adventure. Ready to level up and own this game? It's time to gear up and dive into the action!

bluejetty:00029639:ios.description:
Our products can monitor heart rate, record blood pressure and blood sugar data in real time, help users grasp their health status and take care of heart health comprehensively. Personalized analysis, healthy life is at your fingertips.
In this app, you can track vital signs - measure pulse, record blood pressure and blood sugar levels, and view trends over time; and the product also provides a sleep function to help you sleep better, all in one place for easy access.
Main Features
* Track heart rate trends to better understand your overall physical condition.
* Sleep function to help you sleep better
* Record your blood pressure and blood sugar to help you stay healthy.
- How to use
Place one finger on the back of the camera.
Stay still and start measuring your pulse.
Do not move your finger until the measurement is complete.
Wait for a while to get the result.
- Healthy Life Disclaimer
Please note! This application is not for medical use. To get accurate data about your health, please consult your doctor. If you have any health problems, please do not delay seeing a doctor!
About subscription:
You can cancel your subscription at any time
If you purchase on an annual basis, your iTunes account will be deducted. Your account will be automatically charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription, unless you disable auto-renewal. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your Account Settings in the AppStore after purchase.
Payment and Subscription Terms:
Choose from the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features
• Weekly Subscription
• Yearly Subscription
Manage your subscription directly from your iPhone
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings
Open the Settings app
Tap your name.
Tap Subscriptions.
Tap the subscription you want to manage.
For support and more information, please visit:
Privacy Policy: https://ratemeasure.com/Privacys
Terms of Use: https://ratemeasure.com/term

bluejetty:00124259:ios.description:
Enjoy Spider Solitaire, a free classic solitaire card game made for relaxing play, smart moves, and daily brain training. Build card sequences, clear completed suits, and enjoy one of the most popular single player card games anytime, anywhere — even without Wi-Fi.
Classic never fades. Spider Solitaire brings the familiar classic card game experience to your iPhone or iPad with smooth controls, clear cards, calming gameplay, and different difficulty levels for every kind of player. Whether you enjoy an easy card puzzle, a relaxing solitaire game, or a more challenging 4-suit Spider Solitaire deal, this classic solitaire card game gives you a clean and satisfying way to play.
For fans of Spiderette, Spiderwort, Patience, and classic solitaire card games, Spider Solitaire offers a relaxing yet strategic way to relax your mind, sharpen your focus, and train your brain. This relaxing card game is designed for players of all ages, including adults, seniors, solitaire lovers, and classic card game fans.
HOW TO PLAY SPIDER SOLITAIRE:
The goal is simple: arrange cards in descending order, build full suit sequences from King to Ace, and clear them from the table. Clear all the cards to win the deal.
Start with 1-suit Spider Solitaire for a more relaxing experience, try 2-suit or 3-suit mode for a balanced challenge, or take on 4-suit Spider Solitaire for a true classic card game test. Every deal is a new puzzle that rewards focus, planning, and smart strategy.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE SPIDER SOLITAIRE:
• No In-App Purchases
Enjoy the full Spider Solitaire experience without in-app purchases, hidden upgrades, or paid unlocks.
• Play Offline Anytime
Enjoy Spider Solitaire anywhere, even without wifi or an internet connection — perfect for travel, breaks, and relaxing moments.
• Classic Spider Solitaire Gameplay
Enjoy the familiar Spider Solitaire card game you know and love, with classic rules, smooth play, and a relaxing challenge in every deal.
• 1-Suit, 2-Suit, 3-Suit, and 4-Suit Modes
Choose from different Spider Solitaire difficulty levels, from relaxing 1-suit play to challenging 4-suit mode.
• Daily Challenges & Daily Goals
Complete new Daily Challenges and Daily Goals, collect stars, unlock star chest, earn coin rewards, and come back every day for a fresh Spider Solitaire puzzle.
• Unlimited Undo and Hints
Use unlimited undo moves to try a different strategy, or get helpful hints whenever you need a little guidance.
• Large, Clear, Easy-to-Read Cards
Play comfortably with large cards, clear suits, readable numbers, and a clean layout designed for a smooth card game experience.
• Magic Wands for Extra Help
Use Magic Wands to get extra help on difficult deals and keep your Spider Solitaire game moving when the board gets tricky.
• Custom Card Faces, Card Backs, and Backgrounds
Personalize your classic Spider Solitaire game with beautiful card faces, card backs, and backgrounds to match your favorite style.
• Left-Handed Mode
Switch to left-handed mode for a more comfortable layout and easier card control.
• Track Your Spider Solitaire Statistics
Follow your progress with Spider Solitaire statistics, including your wins, performance, and playing history over time.
A CLASSIC CARD GAME FOR EVERY DAY
Spider Solitaire is more than a classic solitaire card game — it is a relaxing card puzzle, a smart brain-training game, and a timeless single player card game you can enjoy every day.
Download the timeless Spider Solitaire card game now and enjoy classic solitaire, Patience-style card fun, relaxing gameplay, and strategic card puzzles on your iPhone or iPad anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00037005:ios.summary:
Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala or Ballerina Cappuccina? Is your brain melting?!

bluejetty:00037005:ios.description:
Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala or Ballerina Cappuccina? Is your brain melting?!
Get ready for a chaotic and hilarious merge puzzle game: Italian Brainrot Merge – where memes like Bananita Dolphinita, Bombardiro Crocodilo, Chimpanzini Bananini meet madness!
Inspired by classic 2048 and watermelon drop games, this version takes things to the next level. Merge your way through iconic brainrot characters like:
Tralalero Tralala, Capuccino Assasino, Blueberrinni Octopussini, Bananita Dolphinita, Boneca Ambalabu, Ballerina Cappuccina, Tung Tung Sahur, Burbaloni Lulilolli, Bombardiro Crocodilo, Chimpanzini Bananini, Lirilì Larilà, Brr Brr Patapim… and many more!
Merge them all to discover the ultimate mystery creature!
GAME MODES:
Brainrot Mode:
Drop and merge absurd, hilarious meme creatures. Watch as your cursed combinations evolve into chaotic forms!
2048 Balls Mode:
Merge identical numbered balls, blast the board with rockets and bombs, and aim for legendary combos like 1024, 2048 and beyond! Number Puzzle, an immersive number merge puzzle game that puts your reflexes to the test and encourages strategic matching of numbers and balls. 
Immerse yourself in this addictive puzzle experience where connecting balls and numbers is the key to success. Start with a base number and merge identical balls to rack up points in this free and offline number matching adventure. 
Watermelon Mode:
Drop and match fruits to grow the juiciest watermelon. It's simple, addictive, and endlessly satisfying.
FEATURES:
Meme Mayhem: Merge viral meme animals and cursed internet creatures.
Strategic Gameplay: Think ahead to avoid overflow and maximize combos.
Funny Sounds & Animations: Each merge triggers hilarious reactions.
Vibrant Visuals: Bright, colorful, and meme-inspired design.
Boosters & Chaos: Use rockets, bombs, and shuffles to stay in control.
Offline Play: No internet? No problem. Play anytime, anywhere.
Leaderboard & Challenges: Compete with friends and meme your way to the top!
● Easy to play, hard to master.
● Minimalistic & Elegantly designed number merge game
● Special graphic design in this number game.
● Share your scores and dare your friends.
● Sharpen your minds
● Brain teasers games and brain games for adults.
● Slide the number up, down, left, right, diagonal in any direction.
● Connect the same balls on the board.
● The game ends when the board is full.
● Adorable fun, and thoughtful game design in this beautiful game about connecting number balls.
● New games and free games are fun if they help to improve the brain and mind.
● Free to play for life.
● Play offline, without Internet.
● Smooth & simple controls.
● Automatic save game
This free, offline game stimulates your brain and enhances cognitive abilities. 
Challenge yourself by connecting balls and enjoy the delightful gameplay. Download Italian Brainrot Merge now and dive into a world of memes, madness, and merging fun!
Remember to keep your mind as sharp as a watermelon and your reflexes quick as a melon as you dive into the addictive gameplay!

Hello farmer! Welcome to our game. Today we are glad to present to you a farm play for children. You have to work a little here. Our domestic animals welcome you.

apple-macos:6788161762.name: European Portuguese Reference
apple-macos:6788161762.description:
Master European Portuguese with a pocket-sized reference and drill companion built for serious learners. Whether you're building fluency for life in Portugal or just love the language, European Portuguese Reference keeps the rules at your fingertips and the drills sharp. We built this app for ourselves because everything else out there seems to teach Brazillian Portuguese; but for those of us living in Portugal, that's not ideal!
Look up conjugation tables for any verb — present, preterite, imperfect, future, conditional, subjunctive, and imperative, plus the personal infinitive — generated on the fly from a complete rule engine that handles all three verb classes, stem changes, and irregular verbs. Browse gender and agreement rules, clitic pronoun placement, preposition contractions, and the constructs that trip up English speakers, all in one place. Contribute to curated vocabulary sections, review and learn with flash cards, learn pronunciation with built-in text-to-speech, and use a built-in dictionary to discover new words you want to learn.
Test yourself with multiple-choice grammar drills targeted to specific verb classes, agreement, and more. A dedicated vocabulary drill randomly asks you to translate Portuguese → English or English → Portuguese. The app tracks which questions you get wrong and prioritises them in future sessions. Your custom vocabulary words, flashcard ratings, and drill history sync automatically across all your Apple devices via iCloud.

apple-macos:6821727907.name: Tick List - Let's go shopping!
apple-macos:6821727907.description:
A shared tick list for the things you actually need: the shopping, the hardware run, what to pack. Built for the moment you are standing in an aisle with a basket in one hand.
SHOPPING MODE
Turn it on and everything already ticked drops out of sight, so what is in front of you is only what you still have to buy. Then tick things off as you go and they stay where they are — nothing disappears under your thumb because you brushed the screen. When you do want a clear-out, "Hide Checked" takes them away in one tap.
TAGS, NOTES AND PHOTOS
Colour-coded tags group the frozen things, or the dairy-free ones, and one tap filters the list down to just those. Add a note when the size matters, or a photo when the brand does — the label on the bottle, or where the part goes.
SHARED, PROPERLY
Share a list with whoever shops. Everyone sees the same list, ticks appear on everyone's phone, and nobody needs an account — it travels over iCloud to the people you choose, and you can stop sharing at any time.
ALSO
• Drag items into the order of the aisles
• Search as you type, and add straight from the search box when it is not there yet
• Remove duplicates in one go after a busy week
• The same lists on iPhone and iPad, and it works offline
HANDS-FREE, WHERE YOUR IPHONE SUPPORTS IT
